US-11086413-B2.name: Context-aware scroll wheel
US-11086413-B2.hook: A mouse whose wheel and buttons change jobs depending on which app and menu level you are in, driven by a cascading on-screen menu.
US-11086413-B2.twist: Pair it with an on-device model that learns your shortcuts per app and remaps the wheel automatically.

US-11113227-B2.name: One-button drive wiper
US-11113227-B2.hook: A standalone box that boots old computers from its own code and securely erases their drives, built so an untrained person can do it safely.
US-11113227-B2.twist: Sell it to e-waste recyclers and schools with a printed certificate of erasure for each drive, stored on the device.

US-11113358-B2.name: Click-anywhere help overlay
US-11113358-B2.hook: A layer that sits on top of any web app so users can click a button or field and get help written for that exact item.
US-11113358-B2.twist: Generate the first draft of every help card with an LLM that reads the page, then let admins edit.

US-11113772-B2.name: Pickup crew finder
US-11113772-B2.hook: An app for forming a crew for an activity at a set time, with a fixed number of open spots others can claim.
US-11113772-B2.twist: Aim it at pickup sports and volunteer shifts, with no-show scores and waitlists that auto-fill.

US-11139976-B2.name: Phone-held verified ID
US-11139976-B2.hook: Your verified identity lives on your phone and is shared, one field at a time, only with requesters who are themselves verified.
US-11139976-B2.twist: Rebuild it on standard mobile driver's licenses and passkeys instead of a custom blockchain.

US-11163826-B2.name: Ask-the-recording archive
US-11163826-B2.hook: Lets someone ask questions in plain language and get answered with clips from a person's recorded videos and audio.
US-11163826-B2.twist: A family-history kit: record grandparents once, and grandkids can ask them questions for decades.

US-11163973-B2.name: Fingerprint PIN pad
US-11163973-B2.hook: A card-terminal add-on that pairs a fingerprint scanner with the keypad, so a PIN alone can't unlock a transaction.
US-11163973-B2.twist: Retrofit kit for gym lockers, pharmacies and gun safes, using cheap capacitive sensors.

US-11189158-B1.name: Hand-hygiene shopping tag
US-11189158-B1.hook: Shoppers carry a small tag that shows how long since they last sanitized, and store stations reset it.
US-11189158-B1.twist: Move it to hospitals and food plants, where compliance data is required, using BLE badges.

US-11190629-B1.name: Bendable wrist phone
US-11190629-B1.hook: A phone made of short hinged segments that curls around your wrist, with a screen that unrolls from an end scroll.
US-11190629-B1.twist: Prototype the hinged-segment case for existing small phones first; flexible screens are now off the shelf.

US-11281302-B2.name: Finger-gesture recorder
US-11281302-B2.hook: Motion sensors worn on the hand let a gesture start a photo, a note or a measurement on your phone.
US-11281302-B2.twist: A ring for machinists and lab techs: tap to log a reading hands-free into a spreadsheet.

US-11282148-B2.name: Barn climate dashboard
US-11282148-B2.hook: Pulls climate and animal-health readings from different farm controllers into one normalized feed.
US-11282148-B2.twist: A cheap LoRa gateway that speaks the common barn controller protocols and alerts by text.

US-11083140-B1.name: Dual-bulb grow hood
US-11083140-B1.hook: A grow-light hood that mixes fluorescent tubes with high-intensity bulbs above them, so seedlings and mature plants get the right light from one fixture.
US-11083140-B1.twist: Swap both bulb types for tunable LED channels and let a phone schedule shift the spectrum by growth stage.

US-11083548-B2.name: Bonded bite stop
US-11083548-B2.hook: A small plate bonded behind an upper front tooth that stops the lower teeth from closing too far during orthodontic treatment.
US-11083548-B2.twist: Scan-to-print custom bite stops made chairside on a dental 3D printer.

US-11083601-B1.name: Handlebar prosthetic grip
US-11083601-B1.hook: A prosthetic hand end that clamps a bike or motorcycle handlebar through steering and braking, yet releases in a fall.
US-11083601-B1.twist: 3D-printed, fitted per rider, with swappable ends for kayak paddles and gym bars.

US-11083660-B2.name: Merry-go-round bed rotator
US-11083660-B2.hook: A motorized central pivot with arms that slowly spins a board or bed in a circle, like a gentle carousel ride.
US-11083660-B2.twist: Market it as a sensory-regulation swing alternative for autistic kids and occupational therapy clinics.

US-11083988-B2.name: Scented furnace filter
US-11083988-B2.hook: A furnace filter with a built-in bar of scented liquid, so the whole house smells fresh every time the air handler runs.
US-11083988-B2.twist: Refillable scent cartridges sold on subscription, clipped to any standard filter size.

US-11086197-B1.name: Eye-contact photo booth
US-11086197-B1.hook: A camera behind a two-way mirror shows people their own live image, so they look straight at the lens without noticing it.
US-11086197-B1.twist: A teleprompter-style desk rig for video calls that fixes the 'looking down at the screen' problem.

US-11086203-B2.name: Floating trail-cam mount
US-11086203-B2.hook: A telescoping pole mount for hunting cameras that floats the camera up if floodwater rises, instead of drowning it.
US-11086203-B2.twist: Sell it to flood researchers and river monitors who need cheap cameras that survive high water.

US-11086354-B1.name: Pop-up car window sign
US-11086354-B1.hook: A display that retracts into a car and extends to show a message or ID to people outside the vehicle.
US-11086354-B1.twist: Rideshare and delivery drivers: show the rider's name or order number on an e-ink panel.

US-11087613-B2.name: Wearable panic network
US-11087613-B2.hook: A wearable that, in an emergency, alerts chosen contacts and authorities with live location through the paired phone.
US-11087613-B2.twist: Build it for lone workers such as home nurses and real-estate agents, sold per seat to employers.

US-11088502-B1.name: Benchtop wire harness station
US-11088502-B1.hook: A work cell with a spring or air-powered press that terminates a whole row of wires into connectors in one stroke.
US-11088502-B1.twist: A small-batch version for drone and robotics shops that build their own harnesses.

US-11109950-B2.name: Brush and flosser in one
US-11109950-B2.hook: A single handheld device that is both a vibrating toothbrush and a battery water flosser, with one tank and one charger.
US-11109950-B2.twist: Travel-size version with a collapsible silicone tank that fits a toiletry bag.

US-11110002-B2.name: Eye-drop aiming mask
US-11110002-B2.hook: A frame worn over the eyes with a grid of holes that guides a dropper so the drop lands in the eye, not on the cheek.
US-11110002-B2.twist: Pair it with a dropper bottle clip for arthritis patients and older adults with glaucoma.

US-11110190-B1.name: UV-sterilizing cash dispenser
US-11110190-B1.hook: A bill dispenser that passes each banknote between UV-C lamps so the cash comes out disinfected.
US-11110190-B1.twist: Countertop version for food trucks and clinics that handle cash and food or patients.

US-11110589-B2.name: Interlocking tool holders
US-11110589-B2.hook: Tool holders with a tongue on one side and a groove on the other, so you can snap any set into one custom rack.
US-11110589-B2.twist: Publish the joint as an open standard and sell printed holders for specific drill and saw models.

US-11112282-B2.name: Hidden smoke-detector mount
US-11112282-B2.hook: A collar-and-tab bracket that hangs a fire detector above a ceiling panel so it is concealed but still works.
US-11112282-B2.twist: Aim it at hotels and museums where visible detectors ruin the look.

US-11112311-B2.name: Press-side color target
US-11112311-B2.hook: A printed target plus light, master and dark swatches that let press operators judge color drift by eye against a proof.
US-11112311-B2.twist: Add a phone app that reads the target with the camera and flags drift in delta-E.

US-11112619-B1.name: Cooling eyeglass frames
US-11112619-B1.hook: Glasses whose frames hold a cooling gel, with conductive material where they touch skin and insulation on the outside.
US-11112619-B1.twist: Sports sunglasses for runners and outdoor workers in heat waves.

US-11114805-B2.name: Shore-power adapter cord
US-11114805-B2.hook: A marina shore-power cord whose plug and boat-end receptacle carry different amp ratings, so one cord bridges mismatched hookups.
US-11114805-B2.twist: Add a built-in meter and ground-fault indicator, a common pain point for boaters.

US-11115702-B1.name: TV video-call box
US-11115702-B1.hook: A camera box on the TV that lets family video-call from a phone and control what the TV shows.
US-11115702-B1.twist: Build it for grandparents: calls auto-answer from approved contacts, no remote needed.

US-11134967-B2.name: Looped clot-removal catheter
US-11134967-B2.hook: A catheter whose tip forms a loop with side ports, used to break up and draw out blood clots.
US-11134967-B2.twist: Regulated device: a path for a med-device startup with clinical partners, not a garage build.

US-11135095-B2.name: Cast toe bumper
US-11135095-B2.hook: A strap-on guard that covers the toes of someone in a foot cast so they stop stubbing them.
US-11135095-B2.twist: Pair with a cast cover for showers; sell in pharmacies next to crutches.

US-11135117-B2.name: Self-adjust spine hoop
US-11135117-B2.hook: A telescoping hoop frame with pressure pads that lets you apply chiropractic-style pressure to your own back.
US-11135117-B2.twist: Fold-flat version for desk workers with guided routines on a phone.

US-11135123-B2.name: Passive worker exoskeleton
US-11135123-B2.hook: An unpowered exoskeleton that supports bending, crouching, lifting and standing up for workers with repetitive tasks.
US-11135123-B2.twist: Lower-cost version for warehouse pickers and farmworkers using spring-steel and printed joints.

US-11135135-B2.name: Pill packager canister
US-11135135-B2.hook: A canister for pharmacy pill-packaging machines that dispenses in bulk, then one pill at a time for exact counts.
US-11135135-B2.twist: A small home version that sorts a week of pills into cups.

US-11135330-B1.name: Sprinkler-line disinfectant mist
US-11135330-B1.hook: Uses a building's existing fire-sprinkler pipes to spray disinfectant through the space.
US-11135330-B1.twist: Standalone ceiling-mounted misting for gyms and locker rooms without touching fire systems.

US-11135973-B2.name: Child-left-in-car pad
US-11135973-B2.hook: A seat pad senses a child or pet and alerts the driver's key fob if they walk away from the car.
US-11135973-B2.twist: Retrofit kit for older cars without rear-seat reminders, with alerts to a phone.

US-11137266-B2.name: Meter-reading camera clip
US-11137266-B2.hook: A small camera that clips over an electric meter's display and reads it, plus a clamp sensor for live current.
US-11137266-B2.twist: Renters and landlords splitting bills: automatic monthly usage reports without a smart meter.

US-11138856-B1.name: Infant sleep-position alert
US-11138856-B1.hook: A camera and deep-learning model that detect when a sleeping baby rolls into a risky position and alert the parent.
US-11138856-B1.twist: Run the model on-device so no video leaves the house, a big selling point for parents.

US-11160649-B2.name: Injectable corneal ring
US-11160649-B2.hook: A continuous, flexible ring that can be injected into the cornea to reshape it and correct vision problems.
US-11160649-B2.twist: Regulated implant: a route for ophthalmic device makers, not hobbyists.

US-11160680-B2.name: Fracture traction robot
US-11160680-B2.hook: A four-motor robot that holds and pulls a patient's fractured foot to the exact alignment during surgery.
US-11160680-B2.twist: Start as a manual, lockable traction frame; add motors later.

US-11160696-B2.name: Layered potty liner
US-11160696-B2.hook: A disposable liner with channeled layers that locks in liquid and solids for potty chairs and bedpans.
US-11160696-B2.twist: Compostable version for camping toilets and caregivers.

US-11160701-B1.name: Heated gurney cover
US-11160701-B1.hook: Roll-out body and head covers that clip onto a gurney, with optional heating to keep patients warm in transit.
US-11160701-B1.twist: Sell to EMS and ski patrols for cold-weather transport.

US-11160718-B2.name: Spine acupressure roller
US-11160718-B2.hook: A springy device that follows the bumps of the spine and presses along them to relieve back and neck pain.
US-11160718-B2.twist: Pair with a heated version and sell as a desk-worker neck tool.

US-11163376-B2.name: Tilt-anything keyboard
US-11163376-B2.hook: A keyboard whose halves adjust in height, tilt, pitch and yaw to fit the user's body.
US-11163376-B2.twist: Open-source split mechanical keyboard with printed, lockable ball-joint feet.

US-11164397-B2.name: CCTV parking tracker
US-11164397-B2.hook: Cameras on each side of every parking bay identify cars by grouping images, so a lot knows who parked where.
US-11164397-B2.twist: Cheap solar camera posts for small lots that bill by the minute with no gates.

US-11188725-B2.name: Tracked keepsake gift
US-11188725-B2.hook: Turns a personal message into a physical keepsake with a secure tag that links back to the digital message.
US-11188725-B2.twist: NFC-tagged wedding and memorial keepsakes that play a recorded video when tapped.

US-11188790-B1.name: Synthetic fashion image generator
US-11188790-B1.hook: Generates large sets of synthetic garment images to train visual-search models for fashion retail.
US-11188790-B1.twist: Use modern image models to build training sets for small resale shops' search.

US-11233795-B2.name: Safety-first dating flow
US-11233795-B2.hook: A dating app flow that finishes safety checks before one person's identity is revealed to the other.
US-11233795-B2.twist: Add ID verification and a check-in timer for first dates.

US-11257243-B2.name: Camera-scored paper targets
US-11257243-B2.hook: Paper targets printed with markers and barcodes so a camera can find the target and score every shot automatically.
US-11257243-B2.twist: A phone-on-tripod app for ranges and archery clubs, targets sold as print-at-home PDFs.

US-11257257-B1.name: Multi-sensor stud finder
US-11257257-B1.hook: A wall scanner that combines sensing modes to detect wood, metal, wires and pipes behind a wall and show them on a display.
US-11257257-B1.twist: Stream the scan to a phone and overlay a map of what's inside the wall.

US-11282406-B2.name: Dropped-object reaction trainer
US-11282406-B2.hook: A tube rig that drops an object from above to show workers how little time they have to react to falling tools.
US-11282406-B2.twist: Sell it to safety trainers for construction and oil-and-gas orientation days.

US-11283745-B2.name: One email, many messages
US-11283745-B2.hook: Write a single email where each recipient sees a different message section meant only for them.
US-11283745-B2.twist: A Gmail add-on for teachers and managers sending individual feedback in one go.

US-20190141462-A1.name: DIY hearing test and tune
US-20190141462-A1.hook: An app-driven hearing test that plays calibrated tones and uses the results to tune a wireless hearing aid.
US-20190141462-A1.twist: Now that hearing aids are sold over the counter, ship it as a self-fitting kit for earbuds.

US-20190142342-A1.name: Smart hospital bed rail
US-20190142342-A1.hook: Sensors around the bed rim collect vitals and room data, and onboard processors correlate them into alerts.
US-20190142342-A1.twist: A clip-on rail kit that adds fall and vitals monitoring to existing beds in care homes.

US-20190183361-A1.name: Two-point circulation check
US-20190183361-A1.hook: Measures the pulse at two places on the body and compares timing to flag poor blood circulation.
US-20190183361-A1.twist: Wearable ankle-and-wrist bands for diabetics to screen for circulation problems at home.

US-11136225-B1.name: Crane hook angle readout
US-11136225-B1.hook: A sensor on a crane's pulley block that shows the operator, live, how far the hook line is swinging off vertical.
US-11136225-B1.twist: A clip-on wireless version with a tablet display for rental cranes and small rigging crews.

US-11137239-B2.name: Magnetic pipe square level
US-11137239-B2.hook: An angle-iron square with magnets and bubble levels that clamps onto pipe so welders and fitters can square and level in one step.
US-11137239-B2.twist: Add a digital inclinometer readout and sell through welding supply shops.

US-11137274-B1.name: Magnetic gauge stand
US-11137274-B1.hook: A magnetic stand that sticks to equipment so an HVAC tech can hang gauges at eye level and work hands-free.
US-11137274-B1.twist: Fold-flat version with a phone holder for wireless manifold gauges.

US-20190183405-A1.name: Allergy test microneedle patch
US-20190183405-A1.hook: A patch of microneedles coated with allergens that tests for allergies through the skin without the usual scratch-test needles.
US-20190183405-A1.twist: Regulated diagnostic: a path for allergy clinics and device startups, not a home build.

US-20190216362-A1.name: Tumor-finding clip marker
US-20190216362-A1.hook: A clip placed at a tumor through an endoscope carries an electronic marker that a surgeon's probe can locate later.
US-20190216362-A1.twist: Regulated device for surgical oncology teams.

US-20190244233-A1.name: Surprise refund after checkout
US-20190244233-A1.hook: After you pay, the store gives you a random extra discount between 1% and 100% of the price, refunded later.
US-20190244233-A1.twist: A plug-in for small online stores that turns every order into a lottery ticket.

US-20190278800-A1.name: Picture mnemonic maker
US-20190278800-A1.hook: Takes two words you need to remember and builds a memorable image linking them, picking which word is the subject.
US-20190278800-A1.twist: Pair it with an image model to make flashcards for vocab and med-school terms.

US-20190298251-A1.name: Pocket skin-aging meter
US-20190298251-A1.hook: A portable instrument that shines light on skin and measures fluorescent compounds that build up with age and blood sugar.
US-20190298251-A1.twist: Sell it to skincare counters and diabetes coaches as a quick lifestyle score.

US-20190311387-A1.name: Empty-seat coupon camera
US-20190311387-A1.hook: A camera spots empty seats in a restaurant or venue and automatically sends nearby people a coupon to fill them.
US-20190311387-A1.twist: Run it on a cheap camera plus an on-device model, feeding a Google Maps offer.

US-20190329257-A1.name: Sperm-test microfluidic chip
US-20190329257-A1.hook: A small microfluidic chip that sorts and counts sperm from a sample to screen for male infertility.
US-20190329257-A1.twist: A home kit read by a phone camera, the kind now sold over the counter.

US-20190343273-A1.name: Sliding monitor desk
US-20190343273-A1.hook: A desk whose monitor platform slides and adjusts on a column separately from the work surface.
US-20190343273-A1.twist: A clamp-on retrofit that turns any desk into a sit-stand monitor rig.

US-20190363547-A1.name: Adaptive fast charger
US-20190363547-A1.hook: Charges a battery at the highest current it can take moment to moment, instead of a fixed rate, to charge faster with less heat.
US-20190363547-A1.twist: A charger module for e-bike and power-tool packs, sold to small battery builders.

US-8507778-B2.name: Self-assembling virus models
US-8507778-B2.hook: Magnetic or snap-fit tiles that shake together into closed polyhedra, the way virus shells assemble themselves.
US-8507778-B2.twist: A 3D-printed classroom kit for biology and geometry, sold with lesson plans.

US-8510650-B2.name: Readable formula editor
US-8510650-B2.hook: Shows a spreadsheet formula as plain text, a tree and a visual layout at once, and edits in any view update the others.
US-8510650-B2.twist: A browser extension for Google Sheets that untangles long nested formulas.

US-8529265-B2.name: Talking spelling keyboard
US-8529265-B2.hook: A keyboard where each key plays its letter sound and lights up the keys a child needs to spell the lesson word.
US-8529265-B2.twist: A tablet app plus a cheap USB keyboard with LEDs for dyslexia tutoring.

US-8532866-B1.name: Car port splitter
US-8532866-B1.hook: One transceiver on a car's diagnostic port serves many devices at once, so a scanner, a logger and an insurance dongle can all connect.
US-8532866-B1.twist: A BLE hub for fleets that lets several apps read the OBD port without swapping dongles.

US-8554781-B2.name: Vowel-only search
US-8554781-B2.hook: Type only the vowels (or another small letter set) of a name and the database still finds the match.
US-8554781-B2.twist: A fast one-hand search mode for phone contacts and smartwatch keyboards.

US-8600008-B2.name: Emergency party line
US-8600008-B2.hook: When an emergency starts, everyone on your contact list is joined into one call so they can coordinate together.
US-8600008-B2.twist: Group-call button for families of people with epilepsy or dementia, triggered from a watch.

US-8620728-B2.name: Shop-floor pace scoreboard
US-8620728-B2.hook: A big display with one button: workers tap it each cycle and it shows cycle time and output against target.
US-8620728-B2.twist: An ESP32 kit with a big LED display for small factories without MES software.

US-9775512-B1.name: Webcam eye tracker
US-9775512-B1.hook: Tracks both eyes' 3D position and gaze from ordinary video, with no calibration and no special hardware.
US-9775512-B1.twist: Accessibility cursor control and reading-study tools using a laptop camera.

US-9779088-B2.name: Two-language interview booth
US-9779088-B2.hook: A booth where two people who speak different languages hold an interview through live translation on shared screens.
US-9779088-B2.twist: A tablet pair for hospital intake and police stations, running current speech translation models.

US-11083181-B2.name: Swap-on lure weights
US-11083181-B2.hook: Weights that clip on and off a fishing lure in seconds, so you can change how deep it runs without retying.
US-11083181-B2.twist: Sell color-coded, lead-free tungsten sets as a tackle-box kit.

US-11083262-B2.name: Press-buckle wearable case
US-11083262-B2.hook: A small case worn on the body that pops open and snaps shut with one press of a buckle.
US-11083262-B2.twist: Earbud or insulin-pen case that clips to a strap and opens one-handed.

US-11083266-B2.name: Magnetic purse feet
US-11083266-B2.hook: Pairs of magnets, one inside and one outside, that add protective feet to any purse without piercing it.
US-11083266-B2.twist: Sell as a set for thrifted designer bags and backpacks.

US-11083307-B1.name: Plush bedside clip
US-11083307-B1.hook: A soft, spring-loaded clamp that holds things to a bed frame or headboard.
US-11083307-B1.twist: A clip-on phone and bottle holder for hospital beds and bunk beds.

US-11083318-B2.name: Self-locking parcel box
US-11083318-B2.hook: A porch delivery box whose lid locks automatically once a package is dropped in.
US-11083318-B2.twist: Add a keypad code the courier gets in the delivery app, plus a photo when it closes.

US-11083347-B2.name: Flip-lock toilet roll holder
US-11083347-B2.hook: A toilet paper holder that locks the roll over or under, settling the household argument for good.
US-11083347-B2.twist: A novelty gift product with a printed 'over' and 'under' dial.

US-11083615-B1.name: Magnetic knee unloader
US-11083615-B1.hook: A knee brace that uses permanent magnets to resist load evenly and relieve both sides of a damaged knee while walking.
US-11083615-B1.twist: Pair with a pressure sensor insole to show how much load it removes.

US-11084161-B2.name: No-spin telescoping pole
US-11084161-B2.hook: A telescoping cleaning pole with non-round tubes so the sections can't twist while you scrub.
US-11084161-B2.twist: One pole standard for window squeegees, dusters and paint rollers.

US-11084180-B2.name: Notched brush-cutter blade
US-11084180-B2.hook: A trimmer blade with a raised center and notched, curved cutting edges that bite into thick brush.
US-11084180-B2.twist: Sell as an aftermarket blade for battery string trimmers.

US-11084188-B2.name: Pin-wound resin lattice
US-11084188-B2.hook: Resin-coated filament is wound around a grid of pins and cured into a strong, light 3D lattice.
US-11084188-B2.twist: A desktop fiber-winding machine for drone frames and bike parts.

US-11084277-B1.name: Shirt straightener for printing
US-11084277-B1.hook: A curved plexiglass guide that clips to a screen-printing press so every shirt lands straight.
US-11084277-B1.twist: Laser-cut versions sized for popular home heat presses.

US-11084317-B1.name: Desk pen dock
US-11084317-B1.hook: A decorative pen holder with a mating base that grips the desk and keeps the pen upright and within reach.
US-11084317-B1.twist: Magnetic, 3D-printed docks for Apple Pencil and fountain pens.

US-11085145-B2.name: Steam hanger
US-11085145-B2.hook: A clothes hanger with a water spout and steam holes that de-wrinkles the garment hanging on it.
US-11085145-B2.twist: Travel hanger that clips to a hotel kettle or runs on USB-C heat.

US-11085202-B1.name: Runway light puller
US-11085202-B1.hook: A jack-and-collar tool that pulls airport runway light fixtures out of their pavement cans.
US-11085202-B1.twist: Rental tool for airport maintenance contractors.

US-11085217-B2.name: Spring-assist tailgate
US-11085217-B2.hook: Springs on a trailer tailgate take most of the weight, so one person can lower and raise it safely.
US-11085217-B2.twist: Bolt-on kit for utility trailers and landscaping rigs.

US-11085893-B2.name: Soil suction sensor
US-11085893-B2.hook: A moisture probe wrapped in a porous ceramic jacket that measures how hard roots must pull to get water from soil.

US-6568940-B2.twist: Riding schools could sell color-coded straps for beginners.

US-6579197-B2.name: Moving training platform
US-6579197-B2.hook: A wheeled platform carrying training implements that athletes play against, with a built-in control that sets how it moves for each drill.
US-6579197-B2.twist: Cheap motor controllers and phone apps make programmable drills possible.

US-6626336-B1.name: Snap-lock case mount

US-6712371-B2.name: Solid-tire plastic-wheel bike
US-6712371-B2.hook: A bicycle whose molded plastic wheels carry one-piece solid tires with a raised center dome and tapered side wings.
US-6712371-B2.twist: Puncture-proof wheels suit bike-share fleets and kids' bikes.

US-6715760-B2.name: Impact-sensing target

US-6796469-B2.name: Seatbelt pot carrier

US-6866594-B2.name: Polo practice simulator
US-6866594-B2.hook: A dummy horse with conveyor belts on each side that move a ball past the rider, with horse and belt speeds linked to mimic riding.

US-6425765-B1.name: Archery aiming stand

US-6461283-B1.name: Spring-panel back trainer

US-6634844-B2.name: Thick-panel crossbar fastener

US-6691905-B2.name: Clip-on golf kit

US-6691905-B2.twist: Golf gift shops and course pro shops sell compact accessories.

US-6779674-B1.name: Disposable splash pan liner
US-6779674-B1.hook: A snug disposable liner for a laboratory splash pan, with a reservoir for polishing agents, so the pan needn't be disinfected after each use.

US-8595976-B1.name: Swing-proof magnetic pet door

US-8596006-B2.name: Snap-cap exterior shutter

US-8599018-B2.name: Intrusion-timer warning light
US-8599018-B2.hook: An alarm that lights an indicator outside an enclosed space when sensors detect movement inside, showing how long ago the intrusion happened.

US-6401952-B1.name: Snap-together storage canister

US-8596453-B2.name: Safe scalpel blade remover

US-6564679-B1.name: Appliance clutch tool

US-6530510-B2.name: Golf cart cigar holder

US-8595865-B2.name: Wrist-mounted rear mirror
US-8595865-B2.hook: A loop worn on the hand or wrist that holds a small side mirror upright, so a rider can glance behind without turning around.

US-8596399-B1.name: Lean-steer powered ski vehicle

US-8597702-B1.name: Bake-in-container shelf life

US-9826729-B2.name: Decorative humane mouse trap

US-9827862-B2.name: Auto-plug EV charging stand

US-9829216-B2.name: Opaque-cover solar collector

US-9850877-B2.name: River turbine discharge housing
US-9850877-B2.hook: A housing for an underwater power turbine that takes in part of a current, extracts energy, and shapes how the spent flow rejoins the stream.

US-6379156-B1.name: Coach playbook binder
US-6379156-B1.hook: A ring binder with a write-on field diagram, magnetic player pieces, and a roster grid tracking each player's position and time played.

US-6500043-B1.name: Motorized jointed toy figure

US-10000091-B2.name: Static-draining layered tire tread

US-10000119-B2.name: Constant velocity driveline kit

US-10000146-B2.name: Folding pickup bed loading deck

US-10000146-B2.twist: Small-shop aluminum fabrication and online truck accessory sales make short-run builds viable.

US-10000283-B2.name: Negative spring bearing compensator

US-10000931-B1.name: Roof moss treatment sock

US-10000943-B1.name: Interlocking chain-link privacy panels

US-10005527-B2.twist: High fuel prices and electric boats make hull efficiency matter more to owners.

US-10005579-B2.name: Membrane-filtered sterile liquid packing
US-10005579-B2.hook: A packaging line that filters low-acid liquids through a micro sieve membrane, fills them aseptically, and cleans itself in place.
US-10005579-B2.twist: Cold-filtered drinks like plant milks and cold brew avoid heat that changes taste.

US-10005601-B2.name: Pull-out display box
US-10005601-B2.hook: A display box whose inner tray slides out of an outer sleeve, held by a flexible strip fixed to both parts.
US-10005601-B2.twist: Unboxing videos have made premium product packaging a selling point.

US-10005633-B2.name: Adjustable roll dispenser
US-10005633-B2.hook: A dispenser case with an internal axle whose movable stops lock in place to fit rolls of different widths.
US-10005633-B2.twist: Small sellers and crafters use many roll sizes of tape, ribbon and labels.

US-10005654-B2.name: Valved container transfer fitting
US-10005654-B2.hook: A container fitting with a built-in valve that stays shut until a transfer tube pushes it open to fill or drain.
US-10005654-B2.twist: Bulk refill stores and closed chemical transfer rules both need spill-free fittings.

US-10005658-B2.name: Side-connect water jug dispenser
US-10005658-B2.hook: A water dispenser whose detachable jug connects through a socket at its bottom side rather than being flipped upside down.
US-10005658-B2.twist: Bottom-load dispensers are popular because users cannot lift heavy jugs overhead.

US-10005809-B2.name: Plant-derived antioxidant compound
US-10005809-B2.hook: A newly identified glucoside antioxidant compound from plant foods, proposed for nutraceutical products.
US-10005809-B2.twist: Contract labs now make small batches of natural extracts for supplement startups.

US-10006208-B2.name: Pivoting cladding mount strip
US-10006208-B2.hook: Mounting strips with fold-out tile clips and weather flaps that ship flat and pivot into place to hang cladding tiles.
US-10006208-B2.twist: Rainscreen and facade retrofits are growing with energy upgrade programs.

US-10006219-B1.name: Soft-story seismic steel frame
US-10006219-B1.hook: Two steel half-frames that wrap an existing wooden column and beam to strengthen soft-story buildings against earthquakes.
US-10006219-B1.twist: California cities now mandate soft-story retrofits for many apartment buildings.

US-10006227-B1.name: Bolt-down cable lock housing
US-10006227-B1.hook: A housing bolted to a surface that holds a cable lock's body so the cable end cannot be pulled free while locked.
US-10006227-B1.twist: Shared e-bikes and scooters need cheap fixed anchoring points.

US-10006595-B2.name: Rechargeable magnifier ring light
US-10006595-B2.hook: A rechargeable LED ring that slips around a round magnifying lens, with a light guide spreading the light evenly.
US-10006595-B2.twist: Aging populations and hobby crafts both drive demand for lit magnifiers.

US-10006642-B2.name: Room-by-room hydronic flow control
US-10006642-B2.hook: Flow valves and sensors on each radiator or coil, plus room thermostats, coordinated with a controller at the heating or cooling source.
US-10006642-B2.twist: Heat pump retrofits need low flow temperatures that reward fine room-level control.

US-10006651-B1.name: Portable evaporative cooler
US-10006651-B1.hook: A water-filled container with a wick and a fan that pulls air through side holes to blow cooled air out the top.
US-10006651-B1.twist: Hotter summers and USB-C power banks make personal coolers an easy seller.

US-10006838-B2.name: Valve-switched fluid sampler
US-10006838-B2.hook: A sampling device whose valve switches between taking a sample and pumping it out to an extraction channel.
US-10006838-B2.twist: Automated water and bioprocess monitoring needs cheap repeatable samplers.

US-10006897-B1.name: Spherical water sensor buoy
US-10006897-B1.hook: A sealed spherical capsule with water sensors, a logger, a battery and an acoustic or radio beacon for monitoring water quality.
US-10006897-B1.twist: Low-cost sensors and LoRa radios make citizen water monitoring practical.

US-10006933-B2.name: Laser-microwave doping profiler
US-10006933-B2.hook: A method that injects laser pulses into a semiconductor and reads the resulting microwave comb to map carrier density at about 0.2 nm resolution.
US-10006933-B2.twist: Shrinking chip features need sub-nanometer doping measurement tools.

US-10006998-B2.name: Sparse-array acoustic camera
US-10006998-B2.hook: A way to lay out flat microphone arrays and tune their filters so one array beamforms sound well across low and high frequencies.
US-10006998-B2.twist: MEMS microphones are cheap enough to build large arrays for leak and noise finding.

US-10007010-B2.name: Gamma detector depth sensing
US-10007010-B2.hook: A way to find how deep a gamma ray hit a pixelated detector crystal by comparing light arrival times in neighboring pixels.
US-10007010-B2.twist: Fast silicon photomultipliers make time-based PET detectors more practical.

US-10008080-B1.name: Findable pacifier
US-10008080-B1.hook: A pacifier with a small built-in module that beeps and lights up when triggered from a phone so a lost one can be found.
US-10008080-B1.twist: Tiny Bluetooth tracker chips are cheap and phone-finder networks are widespread.

US-10008189-B1.name: Guitar neck case clamp
US-10008189-B1.hook: A two-part clamp in a guitar case that grips the neck over the strings to keep the guitar from shifting.
US-10008189-B1.twist: Musicians traveling with gear want lighter cases that still protect the neck.

US-10008816-B2.name: Desk power unit speakerphone
US-10008816-B2.hook: A desk-mounted power outlet unit with a built-in wireless speaker and microphone that works as a speakerphone for a paired phone.
US-10008816-B2.twist: Hybrid offices and hot desks need built-in conference audio.

US-10009211-B1.name: Relay radio chirp blocker
US-10009211-B1.hook: Two relays cut and ground the data line between a gas flow meter and its radio so signals stop bouncing back as noise.
US-10009211-B1.twist: Cheap solid-state relays and microcontrollers make this a tiny retrofit board for field telemetry.

US-10009589-B2.name: Front-service LED wall panel
US-10009589-B2.hook: LED display cabinets with built-in connectors on their sides so neighbouring boxes join directly into one large screen.
US-10009589-B2.twist: Fine-pitch LED walls are now common in studios and retail, where quick tiling matters.

US-10010054-B1.name: Self-moving cutting horse decoy
US-10010054-B1.hook: A decoy that tracks a horse's position with sensors or cameras and moves itself to train cutting horses without a person.
US-10010054-B1.twist: Cheap GPS, IMUs and camera tracking make an autonomous training rig affordable for small ranches.

US-10010057-B2.name: Shepherd hook feeder plate
US-10010057-B2.hook: A drilled plate that mounts on top of a shepherd's hook and holds several feeding cups with perches around the edge.
US-10010057-B2.twist: Easy to 3D print or laser cut and sell as a garden accessory.

US-10010069-B2.name: Moving decoy carousel
US-10010069-B2.hook: A motor-driven belt loops around posts staked in the ground or strapped to trees, carrying decoys in a circle to mimic flying birds.
US-10010069-B2.twist: Small brushless motors and battery packs make a quiet, portable field rig.

US-10010090-B2.name: Neutralised sanitiser food line
US-10010090-B2.hook: Adds an antimicrobial agent to food before a heat exchanger and neutralises it downstream so the line stays clean during processing.
US-10010090-B2.twist: Food plants face tighter pathogen rules and want cleaning without stopping production.

US-10010115-B2.name: Underarm phone pocket shirt
US-10010115-B2.hook: A shirt with a side pocket below the armhole so the upper arm presses a phone in place while moving.
US-10010115-B2.twist: Running and athleisure brands sell phone-carrying apparel to people who skip armbands.

US-10010123-B2.name: One-piece lifting grip strap
US-10010123-B2.hook: A single strap folded and stitched into a loop with a non-slip V-shaped pad that wraps a bar or handle.
US-10010123-B2.twist: Home gyms and CrossFit created steady demand for cheap, simple grip aids.

US-10010138-B1.name: Elastic shoe lace bars
US-10010138-B1.hook: Curved rigid bars with stretchy bands that pass through shoe eyelets, replacing laces with snap-in closures.
US-10010138-B1.twist: Slip-on, no-tie shoes are popular for kids, older adults and runners.

US-10010157-B2.name: Shower wall wig dryer
US-10010157-B2.hook: A wire wig frame with an absorbent panel that sticks to the shower wall with suction cups so a washed wig air dries.
US-10010157-B2.twist: Wig wearers buy care accessories online and this is cheap to make.

US-10010214-B2.name: Folding pan tilt stand
US-10010214-B2.hook: Hinged wedge-shaped legs that fold out to hold a pan or pot at an angle, with a stop and optional lid holder.
US-10010214-B2.twist: A kitchen gadget suited to small-batch injection moulding or 3D printing.

US-10010215-B2.name: Chain-driven skewer cooker
US-10010215-B2.hook: A four-walled cooking box where a removable skewer is turned by a chain drive for even roasting.
US-10010215-B2.twist: Outdoor cooking gear sells well and small gear motors are cheap.

US-10010219-B1.name: Kamado vent topper
US-10010219-B1.hook: A cone-shaped vent top for kamado smokers with adjustable side openings and a chimney socket for decorative smokestacks.
US-10010219-B1.twist: Kamado grill owners are a keen accessory market reachable online.

US-10010246-B2.name: Collar-linked steerable endoscope
US-10010246-B2.hook: An endoscope whose bendable shaft is two parallel tubes held by spaced collars, steered from a base at the other end.
US-10010246-B2.twist: Disposable endoscopes created demand for simpler, cheaper steering structures.

US-10010300-B2.name: Disposable dental x-ray holder
US-10010300-B2.hook: A disposable bite block that holds dental film or a sensor, linked to an aiming ring on the x-ray camera.
US-10010300-B2.twist: Digital sensors are standard and single-use holders cut infection control time.

US-10010641-B2.name: Fold-open container caddy
US-10010641-B2.hook: A base with hinged side panels whose tops cap the containers inside when closed and uncap them when folded open.
US-10010641-B2.twist: Suits condiment or supplement stations where caps get lost.

US-10010644-B2.name: Mini-split photocatalytic purifier
US-10010644-B2.hook: A UV light and coated catalyst unit fitted at the air intake of a ductless mini-split to clean room air.
US-10010644-B2.twist: Mini-split heat pumps are spreading fast and buyers now care about indoor air quality.

US-10010682-B2.name: Self-retracting safety syringe
US-10010682-B2.hook: A syringe whose inner barrel and needle pull back inside the housing after injection, using latching arms and discs on the plunger.
US-10010682-B2.twist: Needlestick rules and mass vaccination raised demand for retractable syringes.

US-10010687-B2.name: Flat capsule powder inhaler
US-10010687-B2.hook: A flat inhaler with a swing-out capsule holder and spring button that pierces the capsule so the powder is inhaled through a mouthpiece.
US-10010687-B2.twist: Generic inhaler makers look for simple device designs free of patents.

US-10010776-B2.name: Goal roller clamp
US-10010776-B2.hook: A stronger clamp for weighted roller sets that bolt to a sports goal's ground bar so it can be rolled off the field.
US-10010776-B2.twist: Schools and clubs moving goals for mowing and turf care are a steady buyer.

US-10010777-B1.name: Sweet-spot sensor bat pad
US-10010777-B1.hook: A pad stuck on a bat's sweet spot with an electronic faceplate inside to sense impacts during swing training.
US-10010777-B1.twist: Cheap accelerometers and phone apps make swing feedback easy to deliver.

US-10010779-B2.name: Surf paddling trainer
US-10010779-B2.hook: A platform with hand harnesses and cables that resists the paddle stroke but not the return, to build surfing muscles on land.
US-10010779-B2.twist: Wave pools and surf tourism grew the number of people training to surf.

US-10010786-B1.name: Roll and stand-up toy
US-10010786-B1.hook: A rolling tube toy with an inner roller on a helical guide, used in a floor game where it rolls and stands up.
US-10010786-B1.twist: Small toy brands can prototype this with 3D printing and sell direct.

US-10010956-B2.name: Breathing air chainsaw feed
US-10010956-B2.hook: An adapter that feeds a chainsaw's air intake from a firefighter's compressed air supply via a demand valve regulator.
US-10010956-B2.twist: Smoke-filled rescues and wildfire work still need cutting tools that keep running.

US-10010989-B2.name: Tool debris vacuum shroud
US-10010989-B2.hook: A double-walled enclosure around a tool's work spot with a vacuum port so drilling or grinding debris is pulled away.
US-10010989-B2.twist: Silica dust rules make dust capture on drills and grinders a requirement.

US-10011003-B1.name: Parallel-link pen vice
US-10011003-B1.hook: A vice with two parallel link mechanisms driving sliding jaws to clamp a pen barrel squarely.
US-10011003-B1.twist: Hobby pen turners buy affordable holding tools online.

US-10011033-B2.name: Clip-on tape cutter
US-10011033-B2.hook: A thin cutting blade that clips to a tape roll without changing how the roll looks or adding much cost.
US-10011033-B2.twist: Packaging and e-commerce use huge amounts of tape and favour cheap add-ons.

US-10011142-B1.name: Large whiteboard wall film
US-10011142-B1.hook: A vinyl film laminated with a hard, low-energy polyester top that turns large walls into erasable writing surfaces.
US-10011142-B1.twist: Hybrid offices and classrooms want big writable walls without rigid boards.

US-10011220-B1.name: Car door switch cover
US-10011220-B1.hook: A clear plastic shield over a car door's control panel that protects the buttons while still letting them be pressed, with lighting.
US-10011220-B1.twist: Rideshare and rental fleets want cheap protection from wear and spills.

US-10011292-B2.name: Shopping cart hook bag
US-10011292-B2.hook: A collapsible container with swappable hooks that hangs on a shopping cart to hold bags or items.
US-10011292-B2.twist: Reusable bag rules made shoppers carry their own carrying gear.

US-10011311-B2.name: Four-limb prone walker
US-10011311-B2.hook: A chassis with four jointed legs ending in feet, skis or floats that a person lying on top moves with arms and legs.
US-10011311-B2.twist: Cheap actuators and controllers make the optional power assist practical.

US-10011312-B2.name: Reinforced rocker panel process
US-10011312-B2.hook: A car rocker panel made by welding a reinforcement patch to a flat sheet, then bending both together.
US-10011312-B2.twist: EV battery protection puts new demands on strong, light sill sections.

US-10011321-B2.name: Push-pull hand drive
US-10011321-B2.hook: Two hand bars connected to rope drums that turn a shaft on both push and pull strokes, for hand-powered tricycles.
US-10011321-B2.twist: Adaptive cycling and e-assist hybrids are growing for people with limited leg use.

US-10011332-B2.name: Electronic life vest inflator
US-10011332-B2.hook: An inflator for rafts and life vests that punctures a gas cartridge using a solenoid, triggered manually, by pressure or by water.
US-10011332-B2.twist: Low-power electronics allow selectable triggers in safety gear.

US-10011501-B1.name: Water treatment chemical trailer
US-10011501-B1.hook: A secure trailer with pumps, valves and a networked controller that injects several treatment chemicals into a pipeline at once.
US-10011501-B1.twist: Remote monitoring over cellular links makes unattended dosing practical.

US-10011646-B2.name: DcR3 spinal injury therapy
US-10011646-B2.hook: Treating spinal cord injury by giving recombinant decoy receptor 3 protein to improve recovery of movement.
US-10011646-B2.twist: Recombinant protein manufacturing costs have fallen since filing.

US-10011939-B2.name: Washer drum divider
US-10011939-B2.hook: Arch-shaped inserts locked into a washer-dryer drum to split it into separate compartments for different loads.
US-10011939-B2.twist: Small-apartment washer-dryer combos are common and users want to wash small loads apart.

US-10011945-B2.name: Melted-end vehicle cable
US-10011945-B2.hook: A vehicle control cable whose filament ends are melted together into one solid end for positioning.
US-10011945-B2.twist: Bicycle and e-scooter makers use many control cables and want simpler end fittings.

US-10011966-B1.name: Cable-reinforced flexible dam
US-10011966-B1.hook: A non-inflatable flexible wall dam raised and lowered by cables and strengthened with a net layer to control water flow.
US-10011966-B1.twist: More extreme floods raise demand for adjustable river and canal barriers.

US-10011998-B1.name: Roll-out deck tile patio
US-10011998-B1.hook: Landscape fabric with wooden sleepers attached, onto which prefabricated deck tiles fasten with hook and eye strips.
US-10011998-B1.twist: Renters and DIY buyers want patios that need no digging and can be moved.

US-10012142-B2.name: Pocket-chamber rotary engine
US-10012142-B2.hook: A rotary combustion engine where a spinning power wheel compresses air and fuel and fires it into pockets cut in the cylinder wall.
US-10012142-B2.twist: Small rotary engines suit range extenders and drones, where size and weight matter most.

US-10012145-B1.name: Inline-rod two-stroke engine
US-10012145-B1.hook: A two-stroke engine with opposed cylinders whose piston rods run straight through the bore axis to a shared yoke.
US-10012145-B1.twist: Compact opposed engines are back in interest for generators and hybrid range extenders.

US-10012323-B2.name: Dry-suit exhaust valve
US-10012323-B2.hook: A valve for diving dry suits that vents air automatically above a set pressure and can also be pressed to vent by hand.
US-10012323-B2.twist: Desktop CNC and resin printing make small-run dive hardware feasible for niche brands.

US-10012549-B2.name: Wireless probe for bulk material
US-10012549-B2.hook: A spike pushed into a material such as grain or compost that reports its temperature, position and tilt wirelessly.
US-10012549-B2.twist: Cheap IMU chips and low-power radios make such probes a few dollars each.

US-10012564-B2.name: MPO fiber test switch
US-10012564-B2.hook: A switch box that routes light through every fiber pair in a multi-fiber MPO connector so all paths can be tested at once.
US-10012564-B2.twist: Data center buildouts for AI clusters use huge numbers of MPO links needing testing.

US-10013574-B2.name: Searchable encrypted cloud drive
US-10013574-B2.hook: A system that indexes keywords from documents before encrypting them, so files stored in a public cloud stay searchable.
US-10013574-B2.twist: Privacy rules push firms to encrypt cloud files without losing search.

US-10013897-B1.name: Time-tracking expiry label
US-10013897-B1.hook: A layered label whose reactive layer changes over time to show when a perishable item has passed its use-by period.
US-10013897-B1.twist: Meal-kit and home-fermentation buyers want low-cost freshness indicators.

US-10014095-B1.name: Magnetic cable mount
US-10014095-B1.hook: A hinged clip with a built-in magnet that holds a cable in place on any metal surface.
US-10014095-B1.twist: Easy to 3D print and sell for desk and workshop cable management.

US-10014484-B2.name: Woven solar fabric
US-10014484-B2.hook: A textile woven from two kinds of solar-cell tapes that touch so the weave itself collects and conducts power.
US-10014484-B2.twist: Flexible thin-film cells have dropped in price, suiting tents, bags and awnings.

US-10014820-B2.name: Fold-in solar panel stand
US-10014820-B2.hook: A mount that folds inside a solar panel frame for transport and swings out to any tilt angle without tools.
US-10014820-B2.twist: Portable power stations made camp and van solar a large hobby market.

US-10015091-B2.name: Header-stripping data transport
US-10015091-B2.hook: A network method that removes protocol headers at the first switch and sends compact substitute packets to the end device.
US-10015091-B2.twist: Satellite and IoT links with tight bandwidth benefit from smaller packet overhead.

US-10015531-B1.name: Live broadcast ad insertion
US-10015531-B1.hook: A method to insert a virtual sign into live video using a slight delay so players never appear hidden behind the graphic.
US-10015531-B1.twist: Computer vision tools now do match moving in real time on ordinary GPUs.

US-10015576-B1.name: Beat-synced light headphones
US-10015576-B1.hook: Over-ear headphones whose outer shells light up and pulse in time with the music being played.
US-10015576-B1.twist: Cheap addressable LEDs and audio chips make this a simple add-on product.

US-10015629-B2.name: Dining companion finder app
US-10015629-B2.hook: An app that finds nearby users willing to share a meal at a chosen restaurant based on location.
US-10015629-B2.twist: Loneliness apps and solo travelers form a growing audience for social dining.

US-10015929-B1.name: Combine sickle guard
US-10015929-B1.hook: A clip-on guard that covers the cutting sickle of a combine harvester head, with a unit to store it.
US-10015929-B1.twist: Farm safety rules and insurance push for guards on stored headers.

US-10015955-B2.name: Tackle box with slide-out cooler
US-10015955-B2.hook: A fishing tackle box with a two-chamber cooler underneath that slides out to either side.
US-10015955-B2.twist: Kayak fishing growth rewards compact all-in-one gear.

US-10016003-B2.name: Fuel pump hand guard
US-10016003-B2.hook: A glove-shaped cover stored on the gas cap or charge port lid that shields the hand while fueling or charging.
US-10016003-B2.twist: EV charging handles are shared surfaces at public stations.

US-10016018-B2.name: High-heel support insole
US-10016018-B2.hook: An insole for high heels with a wedge-shaped heel zone and a teardrop pad under the midfoot for support.
US-10016018-B2.twist: Foot scanning apps make custom-fit insoles a direct-to-consumer business.

US-10016030-B2.name: Jewelry safety tether
US-10016030-B2.hook: A short line with elastic loops at each end that backs up a bracelet or necklace clasp so the piece is not lost.
US-10016030-B2.twist: Cheap to make and sell online as an add-on for jewelry stores.

US-10016034-B2.name: Pivot-open suitcase
US-10016034-B2.hook: A suitcase with an inner buffer module, telescoping handle and wheels set in recesses, whose halves pivot open.
US-10016034-B2.twist: Direct-to-consumer luggage brands compete on small design details.

US-10016043-B1.name: Cordless UV nail lamp
US-10016043-B1.hook: A UV LED lamp for curing gel nail polish with a detachable battery-powered top that lifts off its charging base.
US-10016043-B1.twist: Home gel manicure kits are a large online category.

US-10016049-B1.name: Wearable pencil sharpener holder
US-10016049-B1.hook: A holder that clips through clothing or a bag strap and keeps a pencil sharpener and its shavings in a closed pocket.
US-10016049-B1.twist: Simple to 3D print for artists and students.

US-10016062-B2.name: Pole chair with torso support
US-10016062-B2.hook: A seat on a single pole with a four-footed base, both quick-release, that also works as a torso support.
US-10016062-B2.twist: Small-space and portable seating suits workshops and fieldwork.

US-10016082-B1.name: Shirt removal aid
US-10016082-B1.hook: Clips on cables anchored to a fixed point hold a shirt so the wearer can step away and pull it off.
US-10016082-B1.twist: Aging populations and limited-mobility users need simple dressing aids.

US-10016091-B1.name: Sandwich bread toaster grill
US-10016091-B1.hook: A stovetop plate with a raised curved rib that toasts the inside of a sliced roll and shapes a groove for fillings.
US-10016091-B1.twist: Easy to cast or stamp and sell as a kitchen gadget.

US-10016295-B2.name: Guided sleeve gastrectomy
US-10016295-B2.hook: A weight-loss surgery technique using a surgeon-made safety pocket and tunnel to guide division of the stomach.
US-10016295-B2.twist: Sleeve gastrectomy is now one of the most common bariatric operations.

US-10016305-B2.name: Clip-on cap earmuffs
US-10016305-B2.hook: Earmuffs joined by a clip that fastens over the headband of a baseball cap.
US-10016305-B2.twist: Cheap to make and sell to outdoor workers and runners.

US-10016318-B2.name: Pad with detachable isolation layer
US-10016318-B2.hook: An absorbent hygiene pad with a separate rear pad that keeps bacteria away from the front, plus clean gripping tabs.
US-10016318-B2.twist: Reusable and specialty hygiene brands seek features to stand out.

US-10016324-B1.name: Walker with fold-down foot platforms
US-10016324-B1.hook: A walker with foot platforms that fold down to the floor so the user stands on them to steady it while rising.
US-10016324-B1.twist: Aging populations drive demand for fall-prevention aids.

US-10016327-B2.name: Open-sided outer coffin
US-10016327-B2.hook: An outer coffin with base and cover that lets an inner coffin slide out from one end while other sides stay reachable.
US-10016327-B2.twist: Eco burials with simple inner coffins could pair with a reusable display outer.

US-10016644-B2.name: Sprinkler ceiling bracket
US-10016644-B2.hook: A set of frames and brackets above a ceiling that fix a fire sprinkler head in exact position.
US-10016644-B2.twist: Prefab and modular building favors fast-fit fixings.

US-10016648-B2.name: Squat rack leg press add-on
US-10016648-B2.hook: An attachment that hangs on squat rack hooks to become a pivoting leg press and converts to a push sled.
US-10016648-B2.twist: Home gyms built around a single rack want multi-use add-ons.

US-10016672-B2.name: Step-in telemark binding
US-10016672-B2.hook: A ski binding for telemark, touring and cross-country boots that locks automatically when the heel presses down.
US-10016672-B2.twist: Backcountry skiing has grown fast and buyers pay for convenience.

US-10016879-B2.name: Reinforced adjustable wrench
US-10016879-B2.hook: An adjustable wrench whose movable jaw has a support portion bearing on the frame to reduce flex under load.
US-10016879-B2.twist: Tool brands sell on small strength gains made cheap by modern forging.

US-10016930-B2.name: Stacked-bed 3D printing method
US-10016930-B2.hook: A 3D printing method that prints on one bed, then stacks new beds above it to keep printing without stopping.
US-10016930-B2.twist: Print farms want continuous batch printing with less manual bed swapping.

US-10016999-B2.name: Lay-flat step binding
US-10016999-B2.hook: A book binding method using slits, punched holes and staples parallel to the spine so pages lie flat when open.
US-10016999-B2.twist: Print-on-demand photo books and notebooks want lay-flat at low cost.

US-10017057-B2.name: Dual battery bank switcher
US-10017057-B2.hook: A controller that runs a load from one battery bank in series while charging the other in parallel, then swaps them.
US-10017057-B2.twist: Cheap microcontrollers and relays suit trolling motors and off-grid setups.

US-10017095-B2.name: Vehicle cable spool lift
US-10017095-B2.hook: A vehicle-mounted rig with lift arms that raise and carry spools of cable or tubing, with jacks for support.
US-10017095-B2.twist: Fiber and EV charger rollouts need crews moving cable spools daily.

US-10017096-B1.name: Truck bed boat hauler
US-10017096-B1.hook: A folding cradle in a pickup bed with an electric winch that carries, launches and retrieves a small boat without a trailer.
US-10017096-B1.twist: Small electric boats and kayaks suit trailer-free transport.

US-10017149-B2.name: Retracting piston airbag igniter
US-10017149-B2.hook: An airbag inflator igniter whose piston breaks the seal on firing, then gets pushed back so gas can flow out.
US-10017149-B2.twist: Airbags are spreading to motorcycles, wearables and drones.

US-10017217-B2.name: Track Transport Cover
US-10017217-B2.hook: A wrap-around cover for the tracks of a tracked vehicle that keeps dirt from falling off while it is hauled.
US-10017217-B2.twist: Cheap tough fabrics and printed magnet pockets suit small contractors hauling mini excavators.

US-10017220-B2.name: Folding Training Wheel
US-10017220-B2.hook: A bicycle training wheel on a tube that folds up out of the way when the child no longer needs it.
US-10017220-B2.twist: Lightweight printed parts could make it a cheap add-on for balance-bike conversions.

US-10017233-B2.name: Jet Oar
US-10017233-B2.hook: A paddle with a built-in battery-powered jet pump that pushes a paddle board when the paddler tires.
US-10017233-B2.twist: Modern lithium packs and brushless pumps make it light enough to be a real accessory.

US-10017235-B2.name: Pontoon Deck Extension
US-10017235-B2.hook: A sliding platform that attaches to a pontoon boat and carries grills, chairs, a motor mount and a ramp.
US-10017235-B2.twist: Electric trolling motors and aluminum extrusions make a bolt-on kit practical for boat dealers.

US-10017902-B2.name: Rail Ballast Compactor
US-10017902-B2.hook: A machine that packs stone ballast under railway ties while crews replace the ties.
US-10017902-B2.twist: Sensors could log compaction quality for each tie and prove the work to track owners.

US-10017904-B2.name: Foam Turf Marker
US-10017904-B2.hook: A spreader fitted with a foam dispenser that lays a temporary foam line on grass.
US-10017904-B2.twist: GPS guidance could draw sports field lines and event layouts without paint.

US-10017928-B1.name: Dual-Flow Flapper Valve
US-10017928-B1.hook: A flapper valve with a stopper through its center, so flow can be controlled in two ways.
US-10017928-B1.twist: Resin 3D printing allows low-volume custom valves for toilets and small pumps.

US-10017935-B2.name: Snap Frame Connector
US-10017935-B2.hook: A protrusion and matching detent on building members that snap together to join modular frames.
US-10017935-B2.twist: CNC-cut panels and flat-pack housing make tool-free joints more valuable.

US-10017942-B2.name: Rebar Wall Setter
US-10017942-B2.hook: A vertical rod with notched supports that holds horizontal rebar in place while a wall grid is tied.
US-10017942-B2.twist: Reusable steel jigs could speed up crews as skilled labor gets harder to find.

US-10017958-B1.name: Key-Trap Lock Insert
US-10017958-B1.hook: A lock insert that stops the key from being pulled out while the lock is unlocked.
US-10017958-B1.twist: Rental and shared-equipment padlocks could use it to make sure locks are never left open.

US-10018000-B2.name: Pump Rod Latch
US-10018000-B2.hook: A spring latch with two prongs that clips a top piece onto a pump valve rod guide.
US-10018000-B2.twist: Oilfield and water well operators could swap parts faster with printed or machined latches.

US-10018125-B2.name: Skip-Fire Engine Control
US-10018125-B2.hook: An engine whose cylinders each switch between burning fuel and idling to save fuel and cut pollution.
US-10018125-B2.twist: Fast electronics and hybrid drivetrains make cylinder-by-cylinder control cheap to run.

US-10018383-B2.name: Triple-Effect Chiller
US-10018383-B2.hook: An absorption chiller with a layout of three regenerators that gets more cooling from the same heat.
US-10018383-B2.twist: Waste heat and solar heat are cheaper than before, and data centers need cooling.

US-10018800-B2.name: Three-Axis Lens Mover
US-10018800-B2.hook: A magnet and coil mount that moves a camera lens along three axes, including along its optical axis.
US-10018800-B2.twist: Phone cameras now want focus and stabilization together, and this does both in one frame.

US-10018856-B1.name: Bug Screen Sunglasses
US-10018856-B1.hook: A mesh screen that attaches to sunglasses with magnets to keep insects away from the eyes.
US-10018856-B1.twist: Cyclists and anglers could buy it as a cheap clip-on kit sold online.

US-10018986-B2.name: Weighed Conveyor Feeder
US-10018986-B2.hook: A conveyor feed system that combines belt speed with bin weight to control how much material flows.
US-10018986-B2.twist: Cheap load cells and microcontrollers bring this accuracy to small food and recycling plants.

US-10019042-B1.name: Pi Rack Server
US-10019042-B1.hook: A rack-mounted server that holds several single board computers in a stackable bracket.
US-10019042-B1.twist: Cheap, powerful single board computers make small home and edge clusters appealing.

US-10019519-B2.name: Shared Contact Lookup
US-10019519-B2.hook: Software that searches a global collection of entities and copies the chosen record into a user's own data.
US-10019519-B2.twist: Modern APIs and AI matching could keep copied records synced and deduplicated.

US-10019711-B1.name: Entitlement Payment Service
US-10019711-B1.hook: An online payment service where merchants register an entitlement and users pay against its identifier.
US-10019711-B1.twist: Digital wallets and subscriptions give small publishers a new use for it.

US-10020087-B1.name: Neutron Crystal Press
US-10020087-B1.hook: A way to make neutron monochromator crystals by heating and pressing them to get high reflectivity.
US-10020087-B1.twist: Growing neutron research and compact sources create new buyers for cheaper crystals.

US-10020623-B1.name: Test Jumper Bundle
US-10020623-B1.hook: A bundle of connected leads with shielded tips for quickly testing several circuits at once.
US-10020623-B1.twist: Hobbyist electronics and EV service shops could use a cheap multi-lead tester.

US-10020702-B2.name: Parallel-Tooth Stator
US-10020702-B2.hook: An electric motor stator whose teeth have parallel sides so shaped bars fit tightly in the slots.
US-10020702-B2.twist: EV motors favor hairpin windings, which makes this slot shape of interest.

US-10020999-B2.name: Broadband Advice Checker
US-10020999-B2.hook: Software that checks upgrade or downgrade suggestions for a broadband plan before showing them to the customer.
US-10020999-B2.twist: Language models could explain the suggestion in plain words and catch bad advice.

US-10021476-B2.name: Swap-Shell Earphones
US-10021476-B2.hook: Earphones whose outer housing pops off and is replaced with a different look or feel.
US-10021476-B2.twist: Printed shells and fan merchandise suit a custom earphone market.

US-10021868-B2.name: Custom Hoof Boot
US-10021868-B2.hook: A horse boot formed to a particular hoof using a rigid 3D model of that hoof.
US-10021868-B2.twist: Phone 3D scans and printing make custom fit affordable for horse owners.

US-10021886-B2.name: Lobster Deshelling Line
US-10021886-B2.hook: An automated line where robots and a water knife cut and remove the shell from lobsters.
US-10021886-B2.twist: Better machine vision could raise yields and cut hand labor in seafood plants.

US-10021911-B2.name: Resealable Vape Cartridge
US-10021911-B2.hook: A disposable vaporizer cartridge with a trapdoor that can be closed again after use.
US-10021911-B2.twist: Tight regulation of vaping makes sealed, tamper-resistant cartridges more attractive.

US-10021943-B2.name: Magnet Charm Clip
US-10021943-B2.hook: A fastener that holds a swappable ornament by magnet and attaches to an accessory with a loop.
US-10021943-B2.twist: Fans of collectible charms and bag accessories could sell interchangeable designs online.

US-10021948-B1.name: Suitcase Shelf Insert
US-10021948-B1.hook: A folding shelf inside a suitcase that holds clothes so they can be reached without unpacking.
US-10021948-B1.twist: Short-stay travel and rental luggage make a built-in shelf easy to market.

US-10021956-B2.name: Layered Water Bottle
US-10021956-B2.hook: A water bottle with an inner bottle, an outer shell and a design insert you can swap.
US-10021956-B2.twist: Print-on-demand inserts allow personalized bottles at small volumes.

US-10021967-B2.name: Clamp-On Counter Extension
US-10021967-B2.hook: A detachable board that sits on a counter, shelf or vanity to add working surface.
US-10021967-B2.twist: Small apartments and remote workers could use a cheap flat-pack work surface.

US-10021971-B2.name: Adjustable Display Stand
US-10021971-B2.hook: A portable stand that expands or contracts to show objects of many sizes without tools.
US-10021971-B2.twist: Market sellers and pop-up shops can use light, flat-packed stands.

US-10021979-B2.name: Deep-Recline Chair
US-10021979-B2.hook: A chair mechanism that tilts the support under the seat for a wider range of recline.
US-10021979-B2.twist: Powered recliners with simple sensors are common now, so a mechanical tilt can be upgraded.

US-10021983-B2.name: Bungee Ball Chair
US-10021983-B2.hook: A seat cushion held on an exercise ball by four adjustable elastic cords, on a swivel plate.
US-10021983-B2.twist: Standing-desk users want movement while seated, and this gives it cheaply.

US-10021990-B2.name: Cooler Bed
US-10021990-B2.hook: A cooler with a hinged bed panel that unfolds from the lid and rests on adjustable legs.
US-10021990-B2.twist: Camping and van-life buyers like gear that does two jobs.

US-10022002-B2.name: Travel Head Rest
US-10022002-B2.hook: A Z-shaped travel rest with a pillow platform and ports for accessories, on a base that sits on a table.
US-10022002-B2.twist: Phone and tablet holders and battery packs can now be built into the accessory ports.

US-10022007-B1.name: Plow-Proof Mailbox Shield
US-10022007-B1.hook: A shell on a base that deflects snow thrown by a plow away from a mailbox.
US-10022007-B1.twist: Cheap molded plastic or recycled materials suit a seasonal product for snowy regions.

US-10022016-B1.name: Tailgate Barbecue
US-10022016-B1.hook: A vehicle tailgate with swappable modules such as a grill, cutting board, cooler, TV and speakers.
US-10022016-B1.twist: Pickup owners spend heavily on accessories, and modular bolt-in kits are easy to sell.

US-10022083-B2.name: Sleep Apnea Surgery Kit
US-10022083-B2.hook: A method and kits for doing several nose, mouth and throat operations in one session, using hemostatic sheets and gel.
US-10022083-B2.twist: Sleep apnea is better known now and surgeons want fewer, shorter operations.

US-10022274-B1.name: Airflow Wound Dressing
US-10022274-B1.hook: A wound dressing with a conduit and a window that lets air flow to the wound surface, held by a flexible wrap.
US-10022274-B1.twist: Home care and portable pumps make airflow wound care possible outside hospitals.

US-10022283-B2.name: Gurney add-on platform
US-10022283-B2.hook: A slide-out platform that clips onto a hospital gurney to carry extra equipment or support a patient.
US-10022283-B2.twist: Cheap 3D-printed and aluminum parts make a clip-on tray easy to customize for ambulance crews.

US-10022611-B2.name: Flexible rink fence mount
US-10022611-B2.hook: A support for sports safety fences that lets the fence tilt back when players hit it, softening the impact.
US-10022611-B2.twist: Impact-absorbing polymers and simple sensors could now log collisions in youth sports facilities.

US-10022640-B2.name: Magnetic toy train set
US-10022640-B2.hook: Toy train track pieces joined by hidden magnets, with magnetic scenery that snaps together in many layouts.
US-10022640-B2.twist: Cheap neodymium magnets and 3D printing let small makers sell custom magnetic track kits.

US-10022642-B1.name: Sew-your-own sandwich kit
US-10022642-B1.hook: A kit of fabric panels that a child sews into a play sandwich with slices of food and bread.
US-10022642-B1.twist: Sell it as a craft subscription box or a classroom sewing lesson.

US-10022644-B1.name: Brick plate with hatch
US-10022644-B1.hook: A building brick base plate with a hinged panel that opens a hole in the plate.
US-10022644-B1.twist: Print it for hobby builders who want hidden wiring or lighting access in brick models.

US-10022875-B1.name: Magnetic pickup clamp
US-10022875-B1.hook: A spring-loaded hand tool that grips metal bits on a magnet plate and drops them when you open it.
US-10022875-B1.twist: Sell it to 3D printer and electronics hobbyists for handling screws and small parts.

US-10022888-B2.name: Aerogel fireproof wood
US-10022888-B2.hook: A method of soaking wood in an aerogel solution so it gels inside and makes the wood resist fire.
US-10022888-B2.twist: Cheaper aerogel chemistry and fire-code pressure on timber buildings create new buyers.

US-10023094-B2.name: Boat trailer debris shield
US-10023094-B2.hook: An adjustable frame and canvas that shields a boat and trailer from road debris during towing.
US-10023094-B2.twist: Lightweight, UV-stable fabrics and quick-clip frames suit small online boat-accessory shops.

US-10023095-B2.name: Motorized vehicle mover
US-10023095-B2.hook: A ramped frame with motors and rollers that pulls a vehicle onto it and moves it around.
US-10023095-B2.twist: Cheap high-torque battery motors make tight-space car repositioning practical for small garages.

US-10023209-B2.name: Rotating railway junction
US-10023209-B2.hook: A turntable platform that links incoming rail tracks to several outgoing tracks, shrinking a junction.
US-10023209-B2.twist: Automated controls and sensors suit compact light-rail depots and factory rail yards.

US-10023213-B1.name: Disc golf bag cart
US-10023213-B1.hook: A three-wheel pull cart with adjustable arms that holds your existing backpack for carrying discs.
US-10023213-B1.twist: Folding aluminum frames and rugged wheels now come cheap enough for a direct-to-player brand.

US-10023248-B1.name: Under-bed sliding tailgate
US-10023248-B1.hook: A tailgate that opens normally or slides back underneath the truck bed for easier loading.
US-10023248-B1.twist: Powered slides and soft-close dampers could make it a premium truck accessory.

US-10023255-B1.name: Motorcycle cargo box
US-10023255-B1.hook: A foldable storage box that slides out of the rear seat of a motorcycle on a telescoping shaft.
US-10023255-B1.twist: Touring riders and delivery couriers are a larger market than when this was filed.

US-10023257-B2.name: Bike head tube cap
US-10023257-B2.hook: A threaded waterproof cap that seals the open end of a bicycle head tube against water.
US-10023257-B2.twist: Print or mold it for e-bike makers and sell it as a cheap repair part.

US-10023261-B2.name: Aerodynamic motorcycle trailer
US-10023261-B2.hook: A small box trailer for motorcycles with a hinged, curved lid and a side latch.
US-10023261-B2.twist: Electric motorbike tourers need extra range, so a low-drag trailer has new appeal.

US-10023272-B1.name: Two-seat pedestal
US-10023272-B1.hook: One pyramid-shaped pedestal that holds two seats at right angles without more support.
US-10023272-B1.twist: Laser-cut steel makes it a simple product for outdoor cafes and waiting areas.

US-10023276-B1.name: Storage canoe outrigger
US-10023276-B1.hook: An outrigger shaped like a mini canoe with covered storage, attached to a canoe by telescoping arms.
US-10023276-B1.twist: Rotomolded plastic and kayak-fishing popularity open a market for stability plus gear space.

US-10023369-B2.name: Bottle mixing attachment
US-10023369-B2.hook: A clamp-on attachment for a liquid container that blends a second liquid from a small reservoir into the flow.
US-10023369-B2.twist: Fits refill stations and dispensers where dosing a concentrate matters.

US-10023648-B2.name: Anti-TOSO CAR T-cell
US-10023648-B2.hook: Engineered T-cells that attack TOSO-positive blood cancers while sparing normal B cells.
US-10023648-B2.twist: CAR-T manufacturing has since matured, but any use is clinical and heavily regulated.

US-10024013-B2.name: Floating concrete island
US-10024013-B2.hook: A way to build floating dams or islands from hollow modules joined by poured concrete.
US-10024013-B2.twist: Floating solar and sea-level rise raise demand for modular floating platforms.

US-10024021-B2.name: Suction hollow-pile anchor
US-10024021-B2.hook: An undersea anchor of hollow piles under a cap that sinks into the seabed by suction.
US-10024021-B2.twist: Floating wind farms need many cheaper anchors, which gives it a new buyer.

US-10024030-B2.name: Tilting front-dump scraper
US-10024030-B2.hook: An earth scraper that tips to dump its dirt in front of the vehicle instead of behind.
US-10024030-B2.twist: Compact electric tractors could use it for small-site grading.

US-10024037-B2.name: Hot water return diverter
US-10024037-B2.hook: A valve module that sends cold water in the hot pipe back to the tank until the water runs hot.
US-10024037-B2.twist: Water-saving rules and cheap smart valves make a retrofit add-on easy to sell.

US-10024039-B2.name: Decorative sink strainer
US-10024039-B2.hook: A three-part drain strainer that catches hair and dirt and doubles as a kitchen or bath decoration.
US-10024039-B2.twist: Print or cast it in designer finishes for the home-renovation market.

US-10024045-B2.name: Pipe-clog cutting bit
US-10024045-B2.hook: An arrowhead drill bit for drain snakes that cuts a solid clog apart instead of gripping it.
US-10024045-B2.twist: Sell it as an add-on for the cheap handheld drain machines plumbers now use.

US-10024141-B2.name: Spinning well-bore cleaner
US-10024141-B2.hook: A cleaning tool for oil wells whose angled fluid jets make parts of it spin and scrub the wall.
US-10024141-B2.twist: Plugged and abandoned wells need cleaning by the thousands, which creates a service market.

US-10024354-B2.name: Bolt protection cap
US-10024354-B2.hook: A plastic clip-on cap that covers bolts and nuts to protect them from weather and damage.
US-10024354-B2.twist: Cheap injection molding makes it simple to sell for solar racking and outdoor structures.

US-10024453-B2.name: Latching dual solenoid valve
US-10024453-B2.hook: A solenoid valve that controls two flows at once and uses a permanent magnet to hold position, saving power.
US-10024453-B2.twist: Battery-powered irrigation and gas sensors need valves that draw no holding current.

US-10024479-B2.name: Pipe freezing kit
US-10024479-B2.hook: A hand-installed pipe freezing device using dry ice, with tools for swapping underground valves.
US-10024479-B2.twist: Aging water mains make valve replacement without shutting down a street more valuable.

US-10024576-B2.name: Solar steam water heater
US-10024576-B2.hook: A solar water heater whose steam flows into a second tank to be vented or recovered.
US-10024576-B2.twist: Cheap evacuated-tube collectors and heat-reuse designs suit off-grid homes.

US-10024584-B1.name: Chilled vial cabinet
US-10024584-B1.hook: An insulated tray with a cooling element and fan that keeps vials and beakers cold, with a condensate drip pan.
US-10024584-B1.twist: Small Peltier coolers now make portable lab storage cheap.

US-10024694-B1.name: Entangled-clock motion sensor
US-10024694-B1.hook: A device that measures the position and motion of one object relative to another using entangled clocks and photo detectors.
US-10024694-B1.twist: Chip-scale atomic clocks and quantum sensing research make the idea testable, though still a lab project.

US-10025079-B2.name: EUV mask inspection microscope
US-10025079-B2.hook: A scanning microscope that checks chip photomasks with extreme ultraviolet light through the protective pellicle.
US-10025079-B2.twist: EUV chipmaking has grown, so inspection tools are in demand.

US-10025116-B1.name: Glass-and-plastic safety lens
US-10025116-B1.hook: A lens for protective eyewear with a plastic body and glass pieces set inside it.
US-10025116-B1.twist: Cheap laser cutting and bonding make light, scratch-resistant lenses easier for small eyewear brands.

US-10025974-B1.name: Boxing coach video game
US-10025974-B1.hook: A boxing video game with body sensors that compare your punches to champion moves and suggest fixes.
US-10025974-B1.twist: Cheap motion sensors and phone cameras now make this a home fitness app.

US-10026008-B2.name: Customs parcel classifier
US-10026008-B2.hook: A system that gathers parcel data and groups it into clusters to help customs classify and inspect packages.
US-10026008-B2.twist: Booming e-commerce parcels and modern image models make automated screening far more feasible.

US-10026268-B2.name: Bluff-and-guess party game
US-10026268-B2.hook: A betting game where a phone briefly shows a picture or plays music and players bluff about who can name it.
US-10026268-B2.twist: Make it a free party app with picture and song packs.

US-10026382-B2.name: Tension-held guitar bridge
US-10026382-B2.hook: A removable bridge for string instruments that stays in place only through string tension.
US-10026382-B2.twist: Print it in wood-like materials for quick tone experiments on cheap instruments.

US-10027071-B2.name: One-piece cable plug socket
US-10027071-B2.hook: A single conductor piece with a built-in socket that connects a power cable plug to a grid installation.
US-10027071-B2.twist: Fast EV charger and battery rollouts need simpler, cheaper high-current connectors.

US-10027098-B1.name: Panel snake guard cap
US-10027098-B1.hook: A cap and nut that fit on electrical conduit to stop a cable snake from poking into a panel.
US-10027098-B1.twist: Sell it as a cheap safety accessory for electricians.

US-10027202-B2.name: Rolling magnet generator
US-10027202-B2.hook: A magnet rotor rolls along a moving guide, spinning inside a stator that travels with it to make electricity.
US-10027202-B2.twist: Cheap neodymium magnets and 3D-printed housings make small test builds easy.

US-10027221-B1.name: Ripple feedback for regulators
US-10027221-B1.hook: A switching power regulator takes its feedback from the switching node through a resistor and capacitor, saving a controller pin.
US-10027221-B1.twist: Pin-limited tiny regulator chips for wearables and IoT still chase every saved pin.

US-10028346-B1.name: LED head auto-identifier
US-10028346-B1.hook: A power supply reads an ID resistor inside each LED light head to tell which light source type is plugged in.
US-10028346-B1.twist: Interchangeable UV curing and machine vision lights need cheap plug-and-play detection.

US-10028442-B1.name: Self-driving grain cart
US-10028442-B1.hook: An electric, self-propelled grain cart drives alongside a combine on its own and unloads grain, with a cab for manual use.
US-10028442-B1.twist: RTK GPS and farm autonomy kits have become affordable for mid-size farms.

US-10028528-B2.name: Smoke exhale filter tube
US-10028528-B2.hook: A handheld tube you breathe smoke into, with a carbon filter and scented fabric to cut secondhand smoke and odor.
US-10028528-B2.twist: Smoking restrictions in rentals and shared housing create buyers for odor control.

US-10028579-B2.name: Fold-flat file organizer
