US-10028579-B2.hook: A desktop file holder whose nesting supports open on a scissor hinge and collapse to a fraction of an inch.
US-10028579-B2.twist: Laser cutting and 3D printing make small-batch desk goods easy to sell online.

US-10028618-B1.name: Electric herb grinder
US-10028618-B1.hook: A battery-powered cylindrical grinder with blades, a light strip and a dispensing cone for grinding cannabis.
US-10028618-B1.twist: Legal cannabis markets in more US states have grown the accessory buyer base.

US-10028624-B1.name: Wrist sanitizer dispenser
US-10028624-B1.hook: A strap-worn sanitizer cartridge with buttons and sensors that logs each use and reports it to a server.
US-10028624-B1.twist: Hospitals track hand-hygiene compliance; cheap BLE chips make logging easy.

US-10028625-B2.name: Pop-up sink towel bar
US-10028625-B2.hook: A towel bar slides up through the countertop to hang over the sink so drips fall into it, then retracts below.
US-10028625-B2.twist: Small kitchens and compact apartments reward hidden fixtures.

US-10028860-B2.name: Capsule-gripping lens implant
US-10028860-B2.hook: An eye lens implant with a groove around its edge that clips onto the edge of a single opening cut in the lens capsule.
US-10028860-B2.twist: Femtosecond lasers now cut very precise capsule openings for implants to lock into.

US-10028877-B2.name: Inner-outer coffin coupling
US-10028877-B2.hook: An outer coffin frame with sliding pins that slot into holes in an inner coffin to carry its weight.
US-10028877-B2.twist: Rental caskets with replaceable inner liners for cremation are a growing option.

US-10028997-B2.name: Brain cancer cell trap
US-10028997-B2.hook: An implanted system that draws brain cancer cells to one site where radiation, surgery or drugs can destroy them.
US-10028997-B2.twist: Better implantable biomaterials and imaging have revived interest in tumor traps.

US-10029019-B1.name: Gold cluster bone treatment
US-10029019-B1.hook: A treatment for bone loss in animals using tiny metallic gold cluster molecules given by injection or by mouth.
US-10029019-B1.twist: Nanoparticle synthesis has become cheaper and more reproducible since filing.

US-10029074-B2.name: Lockable catheter steering handle
US-10029074-B2.hook: A steerable catheter handle with a pivoting lever that bends the tip and a slide lock to hold the bend in place.
US-10029074-B2.twist: Growth in catheter ablation and structural heart procedures needs simple steering handles.

US-10029147-B2.name: Forearm swim paddle
US-10029147-B2.hook: A swim paddle strapped to the forearm that bends out of the way into a stowed position when not in use.
US-10029147-B2.twist: Open-water swimming and swimrun events have grown a buyer base for training gear.

US-10029149-B2.name: Backstroke view goggles
US-10029149-B2.hook: Swim goggles with a mirror window so backstrokers see the wall ahead, plus motion sensing and a speaker for music and reports.
US-10029149-B2.twist: Bone-conduction audio and tiny IMUs now fit easily in swim gear.

US-10029166-B2.name: Single-wheel ring skate
US-10029166-B2.hook: A roller skate with one large wheel made of an outer and inner ring with rollers between, holding the shoe inside.
US-10029166-B2.twist: Small hub-motor makers could add electric assist to novelty skates.

US-10029170-B1.name: Face-up casino poker
US-10029170-B1.hook: A table poker game with all cards face-up where the dealer folds a strong hand and players pay to complete theirs.
US-10029170-B1.twist: Online and live-dealer casinos need fresh poker variants.

US-10029348-B2.name: Indexed grinder guard
US-10029348-B2.hook: An angle grinder guard that rotates to set positions and locks with a torque-sensitive mechanism.
US-10029348-B2.twist: Cordless grinders have spread to DIY users who need safer guards.

US-10029351-B2.name: Multi-position C-clamp
US-10029351-B2.hook: A C-clamp with several threaded holes for the screw and several backstop positions to clamp in different spots.
US-10029351-B2.twist: Home woodworking growth and direct-to-consumer tool brands make niche clamps viable.

US-10029508-B2.name: Formed synthetic paper strips
US-10029508-B2.hook: A way to heat-shape synthetic paper into holding strips used to bind calendars, sheet dispensers and cards.
US-10029508-B2.twist: Tear-proof synthetic papers replace laminated stock in more printed goods.

US-10029523-B2.name: Pin-through clevis hitch
US-10029523-B2.hook: A tractor drawbar clevis where one pin passes through clevis, drawbar and implement tow bar to hitch them.
US-10029523-B2.twist: Small hobby farms buy compact tractors and simple hitch hardware.

US-10029526-B2.name: Composite suspension arm
US-10029526-B2.hook: A car suspension spring arm made from two fiber composite flanges joined by an angled-fiber composite web.
US-10029526-B2.twist: EV makers want lighter suspension parts to offset battery weight.

US-10029599-B2.name: Tailgate hidden ladder
US-10029599-B2.hook: A pickup tailgate with a collapsible ladder or ramp stored inside its hollow walls.
US-10029599-B2.twist: Electric pickups add buyers wanting built-in bed access features.

US-10029708-B2.name: Rail scout robot
US-10029708-B2.hook: A small motorized vehicle runs on the rails ahead of a train, scanning the track and reporting problems.
US-10029708-B2.twist: Cheap LiDAR, cameras and cellular links make autonomous rail inspection practical.

US-10029750-B2.name: Cross-cable trailer brace
US-10029750-B2.hook: Crossed tension cables under a trailer frame, joined by a plate, stiffen the trailer against twisting.
US-10029750-B2.twist: Lightweight trailers for EV towing benefit from cheap stiffening.

US-10029768-B2.name: Balloon hole plug
US-10029768-B2.hook: A plug that seals a hole in a wall by squeezing an inflatable balloon against it with a bar and plate on a rope.
US-10029768-B2.twist: Tank and hull leak response kits want fast, tool-free plugs.

US-10029774-B1.name: Outboard tiller brake
US-10029774-B1.hook: A hydraulic damper and brake for an outboard motor tiller, using valves to hold steering or let it move smoothly.
US-10029774-B1.twist: Electric outboards bring new small-boat owners who want easier steering.

US-10029822-B2.name: Rotating divider canister
US-10029822-B2.hook: A round container with a removable radial divider that splits contents into wedge compartments and turns by a top disc.
US-10029822-B2.twist: Meal-prep and craft storage buyers like modular containers sold online.

US-10030314-B1.name: Air-pocket engine coating
US-10030314-B1.hook: A plasma oxidation process that grows an oxide coating with trapped air on engine parts to control heat flow.
US-10030314-B1.twist: Hybrid engines with frequent starts benefit from fast-warming combustion surfaces.

US-10030321-B1.name: Equal-channel extrusion die
US-10030321-B1.hook: An extrusion die with equal-length branching channels that spreads melt evenly to make film, fibers and nanofibers.
US-10030321-B1.twist: Demand for nanofiber filter media rose sharply after the pandemic.

US-10030389-B2.name: Panel opening insert
US-10030389-B2.hook: A pre-formed insert that fits into an existing hole in a building panel to reshape it for a new fitting.
US-10030389-B2.twist: Retrofitting insulated panels for heat pumps and solar needs neat penetrations.

US-10030412-B2.name: Handcuff keyhole shield
US-10030412-B2.hook: A channel-shaped cover that locks onto handcuffs to block the keyhole and ratchet from tampering.
US-10030412-B2.twist: Transport and corrections agencies buy low-cost restraint add-ons.

US-10030486-B1.name: Borehole liner pumping method
US-10030486-B1.hook: A method to roll a flexible liner down or up a tight borehole by pumping water out of or into the hole below it.
US-10030486-B1.twist: Groundwater contamination monitoring for PFAS increases demand for sealed boreholes.

US-10030642-B1.name: Ribbed pump diaphragm
US-10030642-B1.hook: A rubber pump diaphragm with thickened ribs in its angled wall that stop it rolling and make it last longer.
US-10030642-B1.twist: Diaphragm pumps are common in chemical dosing and food plants that value longer service intervals.

US-10030674-B2.name: Single-use sterile pump
US-10030674-B2.hook: A pump with two chambers driven by air pressure and vacuum, plus pinch valves on disposable tubing, for sterile liquids.
US-10030674-B2.twist: Single-use bioprocessing lines for cell and gene therapy keep growing.

US-10030812-B2.name: Wall cargo carrier mount
US-10030812-B2.hook: A wall-mounted frame with a hitch receiver for storing a hitch cargo carrier off the floor.
US-10030812-B2.twist: Garage storage products sell well through online marketplaces.

US-10030832-B1.name: Swappable LED warning lamp
US-10030832-B1.hook: A vehicle warning light whose LED elements clip in and out of the base individually, with cushioning lugs.
US-10030832-B1.twist: Fleet operators want field-repairable lights instead of replacing whole units.

US-10030859-B2.name: Animated light switch
US-10030859-B2.hook: A figure on the wall plate moves the light switch lever and plays a sound when someone turns lights on or off.
US-10030859-B2.twist: Cheap sound modules and 3D printing suit kids' room novelty products.

US-10030897-B1.name: Thin-film air-water exchanger
US-10030897-B1.hook: Closely spaced plate conduits carry thin films of water to swap heat with outdoor air, feeding a water source heat pump.
US-10030897-B1.twist: Heat pump adoption incentives create buyers for new outdoor heat exchangers.

US-10031421-B2.name: Wet e-beam nanopatterning
US-10031421-B2.hook: Etches or prints nanoscale patterns with an electron beam through a thin layer of water or water-based solution on the surface.
US-10031421-B2.twist: Benchtop electron-beam tools now suit university labs and small foundries.

US-10032269-B2.name: Implant stability predictor
US-10032269-B2.hook: Predicts how firmly a planned bone implant will hold by analysing bone texture in a CT or X-ray image before surgery.
US-10032269-B2.twist: Dental cone-beam CT is now routine, so the image input already exists in most clinics.

US-10032355-B2.name: Under-appliance leak mat
US-10032355-B2.hook: A thin pad placed under a water heater or washer that sounds an alarm when leaking water bridges two conductors.
US-10032355-B2.twist: Cheap Wi-Fi chips could send the alarm to a phone.

US-10032372-B1.name: Timed traffic signal
US-10032372-B1.hook: A red, yellow and green traffic light with a timer unit connected to the green and yellow lights.
US-10032372-B1.twist: Low-cost LED modules and controllers suit small private roads and sites.

US-10033144-B1.name: Rotating outlet receptacles
US-10033144-B1.hook: A wall outlet whose two sockets rotate and click into set positions so two bulky plug adapters fit side by side.
US-10033144-B1.twist: More chargers ship as bulky wall bricks than ever.

US-10033203-B1.name: Cord-tap USB charger
US-10033203-B1.hook: A clip that pierces an appliance power cord with two contacts and offers a port for charging a phone.
US-10033203-B1.twist: Small USB power converters are now tiny and cheap.

US-10034026-B2.name: Slice-ordered video memory
US-10034026-B2.hook: Stores each video frame as vertical slices of a set width so hardware can process the stream in narrow strips.
US-10034026-B2.twist: Edge AI chips with small on-chip memory benefit from strip-based processing.

US-10034452-B2.name: First-in first-out pet feeder
US-10034452-B2.hook: An airtight pet food bin filled from the top and dispensed from the bottom so older food is always used first.
US-10034452-B2.twist: Easy to 3D print and sell direct to pet owners.

US-10034468-B1.name: Fishing rod backpack
US-10034468-B1.hook: A shoulder-strap bag with a built-in carrier that holds several fishing rods.
US-10034468-B1.twist: Fits the growing market for walk-in and travel fishing gear.

US-10034502-B2.name: Sleeve mitten cord
US-10034502-B2.hook: An adjustable cord through a jacket's sleeves with a cord lock and fastener at each end to hold gloves or mittens.
US-10034502-B2.twist: Sells well as a simple add-on for kids' winter jackets.

US-10034523-B2.name: Boat ski-pylon umbrella mount
US-10034523-B2.hook: An arm that clamps into a boat's ski pylon mount and holds an umbrella shaft for shade.
US-10034523-B2.twist: Wake boats with pylon mounts are now common on lakes.

US-10034533-B1.name: Chest-load backpack frame
US-10034533-B1.hook: A backpack frame that replaces shoulder straps with a semi-rigid core and hooks meeting at the breastbone, shifting load off the shoulders.
US-10034533-B1.twist: Carbon composite parts are now affordable for small outdoor brands.

US-10034563-B2.name: Portable dual-lobe head rest
US-10034563-B2.hook: A portable head support shaped with two raised lobes and a lower middle section to cradle the head.
US-10034563-B2.twist: Foam can be cut or molded to order cheaply.

US-10035036-B2.name: Two-wall strap trainer
US-10035036-B2.hook: Anchor rails with hooks fixed to two walls, with straps clipped to different hooks to set exercise difficulty.
US-10035036-B2.twist: Home gyms in small rooms grew a lot since 2020.

US-10035055-B2.name: Cart golf club rack
US-10035055-B2.hook: A tubular rack that fixes to a cart and holds golf clubs upright in sockets with clips at the top.
US-10035055-B2.twist: Golf cart accessories sell well online to communities with private carts.

US-10035056-B1.name: Grip-ribbed golf tee
US-10035056-B1.hook: A one-piece golf tee with a cup top, straight shaft and ribbed grasping section for stability and easier handling.
US-10035056-B1.twist: Injection molding of biodegradable plastics makes eco tees practical.

US-10035154-B2.name: Angled twin-nozzle fogger
US-10035154-B2.hook: Two heated atomizer nozzles aimed at each other so their sprays collide into a fine mist, on a wheeled mast unit.
US-10035154-B2.twist: Demand for disinfection and dust-control fogging grew after 2020.

US-10035256-B1.name: Twin-spring toolbox latch
US-10035256-B1.hook: A toolbox latch that uses two torsion springs and a lever to keep the buckle biased open or closed.
US-10035256-B1.twist: Modular stackable tool storage is a busy product category.

US-10035271-B2.name: Poke-lever lock knife
US-10035271-B2.hook: A folding knife whose blade is locked open by a pivoting lever with a slot that catches a pin on the blade.
US-10035271-B2.twist: Small knife makers can CNC parts in short runs.

US-10035465-B2.name: Convertible cargo platform
US-10035465-B2.hook: A hinged platform that clamps to a vehicle's seat brackets and folds into a cargo barrier, table, or sleeping deck.
US-10035465-B2.twist: Car camping and van life created a large accessory market.

US-10035468-B2.name: Spring clamp rack
US-10035468-B2.hook: A rack with pivoting front supports pulled shut by a tensioner, used to clamp an item to an object.
US-10035468-B2.twist: Fits modular mounting systems on trucks and e-bikes.

US-10035471-B2.name: Trunk-clamp carrier
US-10035471-B2.hook: A load carrier that clamps inside a car trunk and braces against the rear bumper, with no hitch needed.
US-10035471-B2.twist: Many EVs lack tow hitches, so hitch-free carriers have new buyers.

US-10035493-B1.name: Rail car brake lock
US-10035493-B1.hook: A lock that secures a rail car's hand brake wheel to its housing to stop unauthorised use.
US-10035493-B1.twist: Railroads face growing pressure on yard security.

US-10035571-B1.name: Hull-flush trim planes
US-10035571-B1.hook: Flat surfaces along each side of a planing boat hull, moved by actuators near the transom to control trim and roll.
US-10035571-B1.twist: Cheap motion sensors allow automatic trim control.

US-10035612-B2.name: Cardboard twine bundler
US-10035612-B2.hook: A disposable cardboard holder with a pre-cut twine loop for quickly tying stacks of boxes or papers for recycling.
US-10035612-B2.twist: Home delivery means far more boxes to bundle.

US-10035630-B1.name: Odor-absorbing hamper cover
US-10035630-B1.hook: A fitted fabric cover for hampers and bins with odor-eliminating sheets built in or attached.
US-10035630-B1.twist: Easy direct-to-consumer product for small apartments.

US-10036131-B2.name: Bridge joint waterproofing
US-10036131-B2.hook: A layered method of sealing a bridge expansion joint with primer, a dome-shaped elastic membrane, waterproof and reinforced membranes, then repaving.
US-10036131-B2.twist: Infrastructure funding is driving bridge repair work.

US-10036167-B1.name: Skylight pop-up canopy
US-10036167-B1.hook: A pop-up canopy with skylights and built-in electric lights, filed together with several unrelated home gadget ideas.
US-10036167-B1.twist: Small solar panels and LED strips could power the lights off-grid.

US-10036563-B2.name: Portable confined-space AC
US-10036563-B2.hook: A modular air conditioner in one chassis that blows cooled air into tanks, vaults and other confined work spaces.
US-10036563-B2.twist: Heat-safety rules for workers are getting stricter.

US-10036564-B2.name: Container humidifier
US-10036564-B2.hook: A humidifier made from a container and cover with a hood opening and a vent.
US-10036564-B2.twist: Simple to mold and pair with a cheap ultrasonic module.

US-10037110-B2.name: Two-layer touch grid
US-10037110-B2.hook: A touch panel with two layers of transparent wiring, each with parts running along both axes that overlap.
US-10037110-B2.twist: Touch panels are in appliances, cars and kiosks now.

US-10037419-B2.name: Behavior-based phone ID
US-10037419-B2.hook: Learns how the owner moves and handles a phone from its sensors, then estimates whether the current holder is the owner.
US-10037419-B2.twist: On-device machine learning makes this private and cheap to run.

US-10037453-B2.name: Flex fingerprint sensor module
US-10037453-B2.hook: A fingerprint sensor built on a flexible circuit board with conductive adhesive layers and a positioning frame.
US-10037453-B2.twist: Fingerprint readers now appear in locks, laptops and payment cards.

US-10037596-B2.name: In-car camera stabilizer
US-10037596-B2.hook: Uses one motion sensor on an in-car camera and another on the object it films to steady the image with a movable lens element.
US-10037596-B2.twist: Driver-monitoring cameras are now required in new cars in Europe.

US-10038250-B2.name: Frameless mesh dish antenna
US-10038250-B2.hook: A satellite dish whose one-piece expanded mesh reflector holds its parabolic shape without a support frame.
US-10038250-B2.twist: Lighter dishes cut shipping costs for rural installers.

US-10039181-B2.name: Touch electrode connector layout
US-10039181-B2.hook: A touch sensor layout where each electrode has a wide connecting end that its signal wire overlaps for a reliable joint.
US-10039181-B2.twist: Larger touch surfaces need more reliable edge connections.

US-11085198-B2.name: Rolling car canopy
US-11085198-B2.hook: A fabric canopy on U-shaped frames that roll along floor tracks to fold back or cover a parked car.
US-11085198-B2.twist: Suits renters and EV owners without a garage.

US-11087594-B2.name: Pick-or-stop bonus game
US-11087594-B2.hook: A gaming machine bonus where players choose award groupings, some of which raise or lower the chance the bonus continues.
US-11087594-B2.twist: Fits online casino and social gaming platforms.

US-11089774-B1.name: Retractable pet furniture guard
US-11089774-B1.hook: A cylinder with a pull-out band that stretches across furniture to keep pets off it.
US-11089774-B1.twist: Pet owners buy such add-ons online in large numbers.

US-11089822-B2.name: Clothing buckle pairing band
US-11089822-B2.hook: Two elastic bands with a snap-together buckle that hold two pieces of clothing to each other, like a shirt to trousers.
US-11089822-B2.twist: Small-batch injection molding and online shops make niche apparel accessories cheap to launch.

US-11089825-B1.name: Step-activated shoe lights
US-11089825-B1.hook: A battery module for footwear that flashes lights when a motion sensor detects a step, with a manual switch for steady light.
US-11089825-B1.twist: Tiny accelerometers and USB-C rechargeable cells now cost cents, enabling safety-focused running gear.

US-11089852-B2.name: Retractable suitcase wheels
US-11089852-B2.hook: A suitcase whose wheels pop out when the handle is extended and tuck away when it is pushed down, keeping dirty wheels hidden.
US-11089852-B2.twist: Carry-on and business luggage brands compete on cleanliness and sleek looks indoors.

US-11089856-B2.name: Magnetic-close hair straightener
US-11089856-B2.hook: A flat iron whose heated jaws are pulled shut by electromagnets at the press of a button, so the user does not squeeze.
US-11089856-B2.twist: Helps users with weak grip or arthritis, a growing accessible-beauty market.

US-11089873-B1.name: Whiteboard with hidden wheels
US-11089873-B1.hook: A freestanding writing board whose wheels stay inside a base housing while parked and extend out when it needs to move.
US-11089873-B1.twist: Flexible offices and classrooms rearrange rooms often and want boards that stay put when parked.

US-11089889-B2.name: Edge-lit artwork frame
US-11089889-B2.hook: A picture frame with lights and collimating lenses hidden in slots along its sides that evenly illuminate the artwork.
US-11089889-B2.twist: Slim LED strips and cheap molded optics make museum-style lighting feasible for home frames.

US-11090143-B2.name: Dental syringe purge clip
US-11090143-B2.hook: A clip that holds down the buttons of a dental air/water syringe and a container that catches the flushed water during line purging.
US-11090143-B2.twist: Stricter dental waterline infection-control rules make routine purging a daily chore worth simplifying.

US-11090150-B2.name: Corneal ring segment injector
US-11090150-B2.hook: A spring-loaded injector with a disposable preloaded head that pushes a curved implant segment into a channel cut in the cornea.
US-11090150-B2.twist: Femtosecond lasers now cut corneal channels routinely, widening keratoconus treatment.

US-11090189-B2.name: Eye drop aiming ring
US-11090189-B2.hook: A ring that holds an eye drop bottle with adjustable legs resting on the eyelids, keeping lids open and the bottle aimed.
US-11090189-B2.twist: Aging populations self-administering glaucoma drops; 3D printing allows cheap fitted versions.

US-11090193-B2.name: Reusable cotton swab
US-11090193-B2.hook: A swab with a reusable support rod and washable caps on each end, one with textured bumps, replacing disposable cotton buds.
US-11090193-B2.twist: Single-use plastic bans pushed shoppers toward reusable personal-care items.

US-11090345-B2.name: Inhaled mucus-clearing blend
US-11090345-B2.hook: A mixture of agents chosen to activate the body's mucus-clearing pathway, delivered by inhaler, mister or vaporizer.
US-11090345-B2.twist: Smoking-cessation products are a large market, though drug claims need clinical trials.

US-11090429-B2.name: Dual-outlet perfusion cannula
US-11090429-B2.hook: A blood vessel cannula with a second side duct that sends some fluid toward the limb downstream of the insertion point.
US-11090429-B2.twist: Wider use of ECMO raised awareness of limb ischemia from femoral cannulas.

US-11090503-B2.name: Nerve stimulation by spin resonance
US-11090503-B2.hook: Proposes applying nuclear quadrupole resonance frequencies to sodium and potassium ions to change how they pass through nerve ion channels.
US-11090503-B2.twist: Cheap software-defined radio makes testing the claimed frequency effects inexpensive for researchers.

US-11090530-B1.name: Swappable putter shafts
US-11090530-B1.hook: Adapters that let a flexible putter shaft and a stiff shaft of different diameters mount in the same putter head with one fastener.
US-11090530-B1.twist: Golf fitting studios and direct-to-consumer club makers sell customization.

US-11090626-B2.name: Droplet-based nanoparticle maker
US-11090626-B2.hook: Makes metal nanoparticles by spraying droplets of metal salt and ligand through a gas into a reducing liquid, where particles self-assemble.
US-11090626-B2.twist: Demand for gold and silver nanoparticles in diagnostics and inks needs consistent, scalable synthesis.

US-11090775-B2.name: Quick-lock fixture mount
US-11090775-B2.hook: A workstation adapter with sockets where fixtures lock in by rods driven by an opposite-threaded shaft and spring back when released.
US-11090775-B2.twist: High-mix small-batch machining and cobot cells need fast fixture changeovers.

US-11090783-B2.name: Offset torque wrench drive
US-11090783-B2.hook: A slim gear housing that transfers wrench torque sideways to reach fasteners in channels or other places a socket cannot fit.
US-11090783-B2.twist: Dense EV battery packs and aircraft assemblies have more hard-to-reach fasteners.

US-11090832-B1.name: Chainsaw-powered pump kit
US-11090832-B1.hook: A short bar and sprocket assembly that lets a chainsaw motor drive a portable water pump, plus a cooling setup for the chain drive.
US-11090832-B1.twist: Wildfire crews and off-grid landowners want pumps from engines they already carry.

US-11090973-B2.name: Raised-ramp paint tray
US-11090973-B2.hook: A paint pan with a raised plate for rolling off excess paint and a support rod that steadies it and doubles as a hanger.
US-11090973-B2.twist: DIY home renovation and easily molded plastic trays keep demand high.

US-11090988-B2.name: Dual tire chain ramp
US-11090988-B2.hook: A sloped block a truck drives onto to lift the outer tire of a dual pair, so snow chains can be fitted, with a chain stopping slip.
US-11090988-B2.twist: Stricter mountain-pass chain laws for trucks make fast chain fitting more valuable.

US-11091020-B2.name: Hybrid drive chain housing
US-11091020-B2.hook: A hybrid module where an electric motor drives the engine crankshaft by chain, inside a housing with an oil reservoir and service lid.
US-11091020-B2.twist: Mild-hybrid retrofits for engines and small vehicles are a growing aftermarket niche.

US-11091097-B1.name: Cup holder accessory mast
US-11091097-B1.hook: A base that fills a car cup holder and holds a telescoping, lockable post for supporting personal items like a phone or tablet.
US-11091097-B1.twist: Rideshare drivers and road trippers want adjustable mounts that need no drilling.

US-11091183-B2.name: Folding camp wagon
US-11091183-B2.hook: A pull wagon with front and rear guardrails joined by side tubes, a support plate and a pull rod, for hauling camping gear.
US-11091183-B2.twist: Beach and festival culture made collapsible wagons a big seasonal retail category.

US-11091224-B2.name: Clutched two-speed bicycle drive
US-11091224-B2.hook: A bicycle drivetrain with a transmission box between front and rear gears and a clutch lever to switch between low and high gear.
US-11091224-B2.twist: E-bikes and cargo bikes create demand for simple, robust gear changing.

US-11091283-B2.name: Gas flush for granular packaging
US-11091283-B2.hook: An apparatus that flushes residual air out of a stream of granular product as it is packaged to keep it fresh longer.
US-11091283-B2.twist: Specialty coffee and pet food brands sell freshness and longer shelf life.

US-11091295-B2.name: Stackable egg cosmetics case
US-11091295-B2.hook: An egg-shaped container sliced into detachable layers, each holding removable tins or trays for cosmetics.
US-11091295-B2.twist: Indie beauty brands use distinctive refillable packaging to stand out on social media.

US-11091301-B2.name: Tamper-evident tub lid
US-11091301-B2.hook: A resealable container whose lower rim has a break line that must tear to open it first, showing it was opened.
US-11091301-B2.twist: Food delivery apps want tamper proof containers so customers trust sealed orders.

US-11091349-B2.name: Truck tarp motor controller
US-11091349-B2.hook: Wiring and control for truck tarp motors that uses the vehicle body as ground and briefly raises battery voltage to cut heavy cable.
US-11091349-B2.twist: Cheap MOSFET switching and smart controllers make lighter tarp systems easy to build.

US-11091703-B2.name: Liquid-catalyst heavy oil cracker
US-11091703-B2.hook: A continuous thermal cracking process that turns heavy crude into lighter oil, using a liquid catalyst to prevent coke buildup.
US-11091703-B2.twist: Upgrading heavy crude near the well could cut diluent and pipeline costs.

US-11091891-B1.name: Towed plastic trash nets
US-11091891-B1.hook: Nets hung from beams on a boat, or from posts on a riverbank, collect floating plastic, with flaps letting fish escape.
US-11091891-B1.twist: River cleanup nonprofits and plastic credit schemes now fund collection at scale.

US-11091927-B2.name: Car roof hammock frame
US-11091927-B2.hook: A rigid frame clamped to vehicle roof bars with fold-out arms that hold a cloth for one or more people to lie on.
US-11091927-B2.twist: Overlanding and car camping made roof-mounted sleeping gear popular.

US-11092128-B2.name: Key fob power cutoff
US-11092128-B2.hook: A car component with circuitry that cuts or allows power to vehicle parts, switched wirelessly by a key fob.
US-11092128-B2.twist: Rising keyless car theft creates demand for cheap aftermarket immobilizers.

US-11092180-B2.name: Glueless locking dowel
US-11092180-B2.hook: A dowel made of two half inserts and a toothed retainer that snaps into cups in two wood pieces, joining them without glue or screws.
US-11092180-B2.twist: Flat-pack furniture sellers want joints customers can assemble without tools.

US-11092188-B2.name: Key-bolt locking fastener
US-11092188-B2.hook: A bolt with a threaded hole in its head where a second key bolt screws in, so it resists loosening from vibration.
US-11092188-B2.twist: Vibration-heavy machines like e-scooters and drones need simple anti-loosening hardware.

US-11092281-B2.name: Recessed wall mount bracket
US-11092281-B2.hook: A bracket set into the wall against a stud, with aligned holes and a slot so articles such as TVs mount flush and secure.
US-11092281-B2.twist: Thin wall-mounted TVs and displays favor near-flush mounting.

US-11092298-B2.name: Slide-on ceiling fixture mount
US-11092298-B2.hook: A two-part ceiling mount where an appliance slides sideways onto a fixed plate, making both the physical and electrical connections.
US-11092298-B2.twist: Smart lights and fans are swapped more often, so tool-free fixture changes matter.

US-11092316-B2.name: Circular frame with light
US-11092316-B2.hook: A round frame with a lighted display mounted at its center.
US-11092316-B2.twist: Ring-shaped LED decor is popular for content creators and room styling.

US-11092528-B2.name: Calibrated concrete slump meter
US-11092528-B2.hook: A slump meter that converts mixer motor work into a common reading across trucks, by calibrating each mixer running empty.
US-11092528-B2.twist: Ready-mix fleets now track loads with telematics, making cross-truck readings useful.

US-11092686-B2.name: MIMO radar Doppler correction
US-11092686-B2.hook: A method for a time-switched MIMO radar to estimate its own speed from detected objects and correct Doppler errors in the image.
US-11092686-B2.twist: Low-cost automotive radar chips are spreading into drones, robots and smart infrastructure.

US-11093286-B2.name: Rule-enforcing resource tier
US-11093286-B2.hook: A computer design with a programmable layer that manages resources and enforces behavior rules separately from the running algorithms.
US-11093286-B2.twist: Isolating workloads on shared AI accelerators and cloud chips is a pressing need.

US-11094191-B2.name: Smart pole street warnings
US-11094191-B2.hook: Sensors on street poles detect pedestrians and vehicles, then broadcast their positions so nearby road users get warnings.
US-11094191-B2.twist: Cheap edge AI cameras and V2X radios make pole-mounted sensing affordable for cities.

US-11094214-B1.name: Bite-size core courses
US-11094214-B1.hook: An online school splits math, science, social studies and English into small modules students can take in any order.
US-11094214-B1.twist: AI tutors and captioning tools could fill each micro-module cheaply.

US-11094227-B1.name: Magnetic shutter decorations
US-11094227-B1.hook: Decorative cutouts stick to exterior house shutters with magnets, so they can be swapped without drilling.
US-11094227-B1.twist: Laser cutters and print-on-demand make custom seasonal cutouts easy to sell online.

US-11094297-B2.name: Sensing violin sound post
US-11094297-B2.hook: An adjustable sound post for violins and cellos that measures the force on the top and back, and can change its own length.
US-11094297-B2.twist: Tiny load cells and Bluetooth chips let luthiers log and tune setups from a phone.

US-11094300-B2.name: Through-body guitar strings
US-11094300-B2.hook: Guitar strings run from the bridge straight through a tailpiece body, aiming to capture more string vibration.
US-11094300-B2.twist: Small-batch CNC shops can sell boutique guitar hardware direct to players.

US-11094420-B1.name: Personal space alert belt
US-11094420-B1.hook: A belt with infrared sensors notices people coming within a set distance and alerts the wearer's phone.
US-11094420-B1.twist: Low-cost thermal sensor arrays could serve blind users or crowd-wary workers.

US-11095013-B1.name: On-wafer terahertz tuner
US-11095013-B1.hook: A slim waveguide impedance tuner, moved by piezo actuators, that mounts on wafer probes for testing terahertz chips.
US-11095013-B1.twist: 6G research and sub-THz radar chips are creating new demand for on-wafer test gear.

US-11095104-B2.name: Flex-open cable organizer
US-11095104-B2.hook: A flexible board with slots that open when you bend it, letting you snap cords in, then grip them when released.
US-11095104-B2.twist: Desk-setup buyers pay for tidy cable gear, and it can be molded or 3D printed.

US-11095144-B2.name: Foam phone charging block
US-11095144-B2.hook: A squishy block with a phone-shaped recess, a wireless charging pad at the bottom and a slot for a removable battery.
US-11095144-B2.twist: Qi2 magnetic charging and cheap power banks make a portable bedside dock simple.

US-11095287-B1.name: Voltage-switched logic gates
US-11095287-B1.hook: Clockless logic gates that perform one function at a higher supply voltage and a different one at a lower voltage.
US-11095287-B1.twist: Hardware security and low-power IoT chips could use dual-function circuits to hide or save logic.

US-11096039-B2.name: Permissioned phone locator
US-11096039-B2.hook: One phone can request another's location, and gets exact or vaguer location depending on what the owner allowed.
US-11096039-B2.twist: Family safety apps now compete on privacy controls like tiered location sharing.

US-11096047-B2.name: SCTP network mapper
US-11096047-B2.hook: Sends probe packets over the SCTP protocol, fingerprints the replies and maps network nodes, flagging rogue devices.
US-11096047-B2.twist: 5G core networks run on SCTP, so telecom security teams need this kind of scanner.

US-11096378-B2.name: Self-bundling dog leash
US-11096378-B2.hook: A light leash with a built-in strap stored in a pocket that wraps around the coiled leash to keep it compact.
US-11096378-B2.twist: Ultralight hiking gear brands sell well direct online to dog-owning backpackers.

US-11096426-B2.name: Teething sleeve bodysuit
US-11096426-B2.hook: A baby bodysuit with curved teething surfaces at the sleeve ends, backed by a water-resistant layer.
US-11096426-B2.twist: Food-grade silicone printing on fabric makes chewable patches easier to attach.

US-11096434-B1.name: Fog-free flip mask
US-11096434-B1.hook: A face mask with a tight top seal so glasses don't fog, which flips between worn and standby without touching the filter.
US-11096434-B1.twist: Wildfire smoke seasons keep demand alive for comfortable reusable masks.

US-11096440-B2.name: Stick-on visor lens
US-11096440-B2.hook: An extra lens plate, such as anti-fog or tint, that sticks to a motorcycle helmet visor with layered adhesive and studs.
US-11096440-B2.twist: Smart helmet makers could mount display or tint films the same way.

US-11096448-B1.name: Swappable sneaker tongue
US-11096448-B1.hook: A shoe tongue split in two, where the upper half detaches along a hidden seam and can be swapped for another design.
US-11096448-B1.twist: Sneaker customization is a big resale and fan market; swap parts fit it.

US-11096450-B2.name: Cam lace lock
US-11096450-B2.hook: A small latch on the shoe that pinches the lace with a cam to hold tension, and flips open to release it.
US-11096450-B2.twist: Runners and older adults want no-tie shoes; 3D printing allows quick prototypes.

US-11096459-B2.name: Suitcase wheel guards
US-11096459-B2.hook: Strap-on covers that enclose a suitcase's wheels while it is loaded and handled in transit, to keep them from breaking.
US-11096459-B2.twist: Airlines rough-handle more bags than ever, and travel accessories sell well online.

US-11096480-B2.name: Pocket tray table
US-11096480-B2.hook: A tray table for tight seats with swappable legs for different heights that store flat under the top.
US-11096480-B2.twist: Remote workers on planes and in cars want laptop surfaces that pack flat.

US-11096486-B1.name: Tool-free gasket shelving
US-11096486-B1.hook: Shelving where tapered gaskets clamp each shelf onto grooved posts, letting shelves be set at any groove without tools.
US-11096486-B1.twist: Flat-pack direct-to-consumer furniture favors parts that assemble without tools.

US-11096510-B2.name: Pop-up Christmas tree
US-11096510-B2.hook: An artificial tree whose telescoping pole rises at a switch, pulling a spiral branch up into a tree shape, then retracts.
US-11096510-B2.twist: Small-apartment buyers want holiday decor that stores in a box.

US-11097142-B2.name: Thigh-to-foot band trainer
US-11097142-B2.hook: Straps on the thigh and foot connected by elastic bands, with several anchor rings to vary resistance during leg exercises.
US-11097142-B2.twist: Home and physical therapy workouts with app-guided routines fit simple band kits.

US-11097153-B1.name: Rotating balance board
US-11097153-B1.hook: A standing board that twists on a base, with adjustable force returning it to center and limits on how far it turns.
US-11097153-B1.twist: Golfers and athletes training rotation are a ready niche for home gear.

US-11097165-B2.name: Racket string weaving tool
US-11097165-B2.hook: A frame of pivoting guide bars that lifts alternate strings in a tennis racket so each cross string slides straight through.
US-11097165-B2.twist: Pickleball and padel growth means more home stringers and shops to sell to.

US-11097456-B2.name: Hollow molded heat sink
US-11097456-B2.hook: A way to make hollow metal heat sinks by molding powder around a removable insert, removing it, then sintering.
US-11097456-B2.twist: Data center and EV cooling need complex internal channels at volume.

US-11097601-B2.name: Portable fan scent warmer
US-11097601-B2.hook: A portable unit that heats a scented insert and uses a small fan to spread the fragrance, with a rotating cover.
US-11097601-B2.twist: USB-C batteries make cordless scent diffusers simple to build and sell.

US-11097797-B1.name: Ratchet wheel lock
US-11097797-B1.hook: A ratcheting brace that wedges between a vehicle's wheel well and wheel to hold the wheel in place.
US-11097797-B1.twist: Cheap anti-theft gear for cars and trailers sells steadily as theft rises.

US-11097815-B2.name: Canal weed harvester boat
US-11097815-B2.hook: A shallow-water boat that lifts aquatic weeds and trash on a conveyor, grinds them and sends them to shore.
US-11097815-B2.twist: Invasive water hyacinth and city canal cleanups need affordable small harvesters.

US-11097819-B1.name: Window snorkel float
US-11097819-B1.hook: An inflatable hand-held float with a see-through viewing window, usable either side up, for watching underwater.
US-11097819-B1.twist: Action cameras can mount on it for easy underwater filming by casual snorkelers.

US-11097869-B2.name: Slide-lock aluminum pallet
US-11097869-B2.hook: An aluminum pallet assembled from plates joined by sliding connectors, without welding.
US-11097869-B2.twist: Hygienic, reusable pallets suit pharma and food logistics moving away from wood.

US-11097875-B2.name: Two-valve straw lid
US-11097875-B2.hook: A drink lid with two rotating ball valves, one for the straw and one for air, linked so they open and close together.
US-11097875-B2.twist: Reusable bottle brands compete on leakproof lids, a crowded but big market.

US-11098467-B2.name: Seat-braced power plunger
US-11098467-B2.hook: A toilet plunger with fold-out arms that rest on the seat, and a handle that drives the plunging action.
US-11098467-B2.twist: Cordless tools could power the plunging for people with limited strength.

US-11098470-B2.name: Tankless low-flush toilet
US-11098470-B2.hook: A toilet body with no tank, using a rim water loop and a bottom jet nozzle fed from a flushing device in the back.
US-11098470-B2.twist: Water-scarce regions and compact bathrooms push demand for tankless designs.

US-11098499-B2.name: Porch package lockbox
US-11098499-B2.hook: A container that locks onto a post when slid past a flange, so delivered packages can't be lifted off without unlocking.
US-11098499-B2.twist: Porch theft keeps rising and couriers already photograph drop-offs.

US-11098522-B1.name: Clear door-mounted gate
US-11098522-B1.hook: A rigid see-through gate hinged to a door, so people can talk across the doorway with a barrier between them.
US-11098522-B1.twist: Clinics and pickup counters still want simple barriers for flu season.

US-11098722-B2.name: Flat-disk combustion turbine
US-11098722-B2.hook: An internal combustion engine where exhaust drag on stacked flat disks of different sizes turns a shaft, a Tesla-style turbine.
US-11098722-B2.twist: Metal 3D printing makes thin disk stacks feasible for hobby and drone engines.

US-11098810-B2.name: Fast pneumatic trigger valve
US-11098810-B2.hook: A valve where a hammer strikes a piston to vent a control chamber, quickly opening high-pressure gas to an outlet.
US-11098810-B2.twist: Fast valves suit compressed-air tools, testing rigs and soft robotics.

US-11098952-B2.name: Grain bin loop duct
US-11098952-B2.hook: A perforated duct loop on a stand inside a grain bin, with a blower pulling air down through the grain to dry it.
US-11098952-B2.twist: Cheap bin moisture sensors could switch the blower only when needed.

US-11099070-B2.name: Terahertz resonant cavity
US-11099070-B2.hook: A Fabry-Perot cavity for terahertz waves with side cavities that guide the wave in, for high-precision resonance.
US-11099070-B2.twist: Terahertz sensing for security and 6G research needs compact resonators.

US-11099108-B2.name: Randomized sampling planner
US-11099108-B2.hook: Software that builds a random sampling plan for material in a container and shows which parts of a 3D container model to sample.
US-11099108-B2.twist: Browser 3D rendering is free now, so this fits a tablet app for QA staff on the plant floor.

US-11099222-B2.name: Capacitive plate data link
US-11099222-B2.hook: Two metal plates pass data without contact: one changes its capacitance with a PIN diode, the other senses the change.
US-11099222-B2.twist: Cheap microcontrollers with built-in touch sensing can act as the receiver with no extra parts.

US-11099407-B2.name: Swap-lens eyewear frames
US-11099407-B2.hook: Glasses with a soft lens casing that holds insertable lenses, plus an online flow for customers to design and order a pair.
US-11099407-B2.twist: Direct-to-consumer eyewear brands could offer lens swaps without new frames.

US-11100049-B2.name: Rule-based file highlighter
US-11100049-B2.hook: A file browser that changes icons, fonts and colors of files by rules, and auto-saves email attachments from chosen senders to set folders.
US-11100049-B2.twist: Desktop file-manager plugins and mail rules make this a small open-source utility.

US-11100545-B2.name: Health habit cost calculator
US-11100545-B2.hook: A web tool that puts a dollar cost on each health measure and shows how much changing habits would save.
US-11100545-B2.twist: Wearables now feed biometrics automatically, so the inputs fill themselves.

US-11100700-B2.name: GPU curve shape renderer
US-11100700-B2.hook: Draws vector shapes by splitting curves into simple pieces and computing a signed distance per pixel in a buffer.
US-11100700-B2.twist: WebGPU makes signed-distance vector rendering practical in the browser.

US-11101626-B2.name: Hinged cable conduit
US-11101626-B2.hook: A corrugated cable tube made of two hinged half shells that lock together, so wires can be laid in instead of threaded through.
US-11101626-B2.twist: Small-batch injection molding and EV wiring retrofits create a fresh buyer.

US-11101650-B2.name: Add-on DC source wiring
US-11101650-B2.hook: A wiring method that adds extra DC sources in series to keep voltage up when a circuit's load grows.
US-11101650-B2.twist: Cheap modular battery packs make this an easy hobby power setup.

US-11102934-B2.name: Hemp bale decorticator line
US-11102934-B2.hook: A processing line that rakes apart bales of fibrous crops, separates the material with roller sets, then strips fiber from stalk.
US-11102934-B2.twist: Legal industrial hemp in the US created many small growers with no local processing.

US-11102964-B1.name: Solar rattling fishing lure
US-11102964-B1.hook: A fishing lure with a small solar motor that rattles inside a chamber, making the lure shake and click like live prey.
US-11102964-B1.twist: Tiny solar cells and vibration motors cost cents now.

US-11103048-B2.name: Folding magnifying mirror set
US-11103048-B2.hook: A portable set of hinged mirrors, each with stronger magnification, that fold out to the one you need.
US-11103048-B2.twist: Sells well as a travel accessory through online marketplaces.

US-11103050-B2.name: Sink shaving catch sheet
US-11103050-B2.hook: A thin sheet with peel-off adhesive corners that sticks over a sink to catch hair shavings for easy disposal.
US-11103050-B2.twist: Compostable films make a biodegradable version easy to source.

US-11103070-B2.name: Tilting chair base
US-11103070-B2.hook: A chair support with a ball joint between upper and lower frames so the seat can tilt while the floor base takes the weight.
US-11103070-B2.twist: Active sitting is a growing niche for home office buyers.

US-11103088-B2.name: Camp chair team sleeve
US-11103088-B2.hook: A slip-on sleeve with straps and display panels that fits over folding camp chairs to show a team or sponsor message.
US-11103088-B2.twist: Print-on-demand makes one-off custom panels cheap.

US-11103096-B1.name: Scan-to-open parcel box
US-11103096-B1.hook: A locked parcel box that unlocks once when it scans a package's code, and takes a photo as proof of delivery.
US-11103096-B1.twist: Cheap camera boards and delivery APIs make one-time codes easy to wire up.

US-11103112-B1.name: Boys potty with urinal back
US-11103112-B1.hook: A potty training bowl with a removable receptacle and an upright urinal back that drains into it, plus two cup holders.
US-11103112-B1.twist: Direct-to-parent brands launch simple plastic goods quickly through online stores.

US-11103167-B2.name: Body-heat glucose sensor
US-11103167-B2.hook: A noninvasive glucose monitor that reads the body's own mid-infrared emission through an array of resonant optical filters.
US-11103167-B2.twist: Cheaper mid-infrared detectors and wafer-scale optics make filter arrays easier to make.

US-11103252-B2.name: Mixed-wire aneurysm braid
US-11103252-B2.hook: A braided implant of shape memory wires in two diameters with a rough noble metal coating, used to treat vascular defects.
US-11103252-B2.twist: Generic device makers could use it as a starting design for low-cost markets.

US-11103331-B2.name: Fixed-to-removable denture kit
US-11103331-B2.hook: Implant abutments that hold a screwed-in denture while healing, then accept snap-in housings for a removable denture using the same threads.
US-11103331-B2.twist: Chairside 3D printing lets clinics make the housings in-house.

US-11103332-B2.name: Low-profile denture clasp
US-11103332-B2.hook: A short implant abutment with a dimple and a C-shaped clip so an overdenture snaps on and off.
US-11103332-B2.twist: Dental labs with metal printers can produce small runs.

US-11103335-B2.name: Livestock semen collector
US-11103335-B2.hook: An artificial cervix tube with a detachable handle for collecting semen from animals for artificial insemination.
US-11103335-B2.twist: Small breeders increasingly do their own artificial insemination.

US-11103390-B2.name: Chute-fed napkin bin
US-11103390-B2.hook: A disposal box with a spring-closed side door that drops used sanitary napkins down a chute into a hidden space.
US-11103390-B2.twist: Workplace and school restroom upgrades are a steady buyer.

US-11103393-B2.name: Hand-wheeled load carrier
US-11103393-B2.hook: A manually wheeled carrier where rollers on the upper frame press on the wheels of a separate lower frame to move heavy goods.
US-11103393-B2.twist: Small fabricators can build it with off-the-shelf wheels and rollers.

US-11103501-B2.name: Inhaled antifungal powder
US-11103501-B2.hook: A spray-dried inhalable powder holding an azole antifungal in amorphous form with a sugar matrix so it dissolves fast.
US-11103501-B2.twist: Contract spray-drying services make small formulation runs possible.

US-11103770-B1.name: Table-edge tile sweeper
US-11103770-B1.hook: A device that clips onto a table edge so game tiles can be swept down a channel into a detachable bag.
US-11103770-B1.twist: Mahjong and tile games have a growing hobby market online.

US-11103813-B2.name: Trigger-release skimmer basket
US-11103813-B2.hook: A pool skimmer basket with a handle trigger that opens the bottom to dump debris without tipping it over.
US-11103813-B2.twist: Pool owners buy upgrade baskets online; 3D printed prototypes are quick.

US-11103982-B2.name: Folding hex and square wrench
US-11103982-B2.hook: Two wrench bodies on a pivot, one with a hex hole and a square drive head, that fold into different working shapes.
US-11103982-B2.twist: Cheap CNC and casting suppliers can turn out small batches.

US-11104231-B2.name: EV battery life manager
US-11104231-B2.hook: A system meant to keep electric vehicle batteries lasting as long as a combustion vehicle's useful life.
US-11104231-B2.twist: Used EV battery health is now a resale concern for owners and fleets.

US-11104247-B2.name: Switchable dual EV battery
US-11104247-B2.hook: An electric vehicle with two batteries and a dashboard panel to pick which one drives the motor and which one charges.
US-11104247-B2.twist: Electric conversion kits for old cars and boats could use a simple two-pack setup.

US-11104259-B2.name: Truck bed motorcycle cradle
US-11104259-B2.hook: A frame that lies in a pickup bed, wedges against the wheel wells, and holds a motorcycle upright by its wheel.
US-11104259-B2.twist: Welding shops can sell these direct through online marketplaces.

US-11104358-B1.name: Roof-rib cargo cart
US-11104358-B1.hook: A track mounted to the ribs of corrugated roof panels with carts that lift loads and move them across the roof in two directions.
US-11104358-B1.twist: Large rooftop solar installs need to move panels across metal roofs.

US-11104366-B2.name: Snowmobile wheel deployer
US-11104366-B2.hook: A mechanism that lowers and raises wheel units on snowmobile skis with little manual effort.
US-11104366-B2.twist: Thinner winters make crossing bare pavement a common problem.

US-11104406-B2.name: Two-chamber snorkel mask
US-11104406-B2.hook: A full-face snorkel mask with separate upper and lower chambers and one-way valves so fresh air comes in and exhaled air goes out a separate channel.
US-11104406-B2.twist: Full-face masks drew safety concerns over rebreathing, which this layout addresses.

US-11104488-B2.name: Nipple cream pad applicator
US-11104488-B2.hook: A soft pad tip that fits a squeeze tube and spreads cream through a slit, with a sealing cap.
US-11104488-B2.twist: Direct-to-consumer baby care brands could add it to their own creams.

US-11104495-B1.name: Bucket lid drywall hawk
US-11104495-B1.hook: A removable handle that turns a joint compound bucket lid into a hawk for holding mud while you work.
US-11104495-B1.twist: Tool brands sell small add-ons to DIY buyers online at low cost.

US-11104548-B2.name: Stair climbing aid
US-11104548-B2.hook: A device that helps people with motor disabilities go up and down stairs.
US-11104548-B2.twist: An aging population wants to stay in multi-story homes.

US-11105030-B1.name: Sacrificial needle bar stud
US-11105030-B1.hook: An embroidery machine part with a built-in weak point and replaceable insert so a jam breaks it instead of the costly slide block.
US-11105030-B1.twist: Small embroidery shops could stock cheap 3D printed or machined spares.

US-11105055-B1.name: Ledge climb blocker
US-11105055-B1.hook: A clamp-on barrier with bars across an overhanging ledge to stop people from moving along it past a point.
US-11105055-B1.twist: Building owners and parking garages look for retrofit fall-prevention fixes.

US-11105059-B2.name: Linkable snow melting mat
US-11105059-B2.hook: A heated mat with anti-slip grooves and plug-and-socket edges so several mats link into a longer path.
US-11105059-B2.twist: Cheaper heating cable makes modular walkway mats affordable for homes.

US-11105083-B2.name: Drain fixture with flange
US-11105083-B2.hook: A drain fitting with inlet and outlet conduits and an outer peripheral flange, made to sit in a waste plumbing line.
US-11105083-B2.twist: Simple molded part that could be 3D printed for prototypes before tooling.

US-11105177-B2.name: Debris-catching tubing plug
US-11105177-B2.hook: A tool that seals a well tubing string at a set point, with prong and plug cavities that trap debris and holes to equalize pressure.
US-11105177-B2.twist: Fits ongoing well plugging and abandonment work as old wells are retired.

US-11105460-B1.name: Slotted fence post mount
US-11105460-B1.hook: A fence post with a protruding rib that slides into a slot in a support stud, which is then fastened in place.
US-11105460-B1.twist: Suits DIY fencing kits sold online with fewer tools needed.

US-11105625-B1.name: Level that lights up
US-11105625-B1.hook: A spirit level whose gravity switch, using a pendulum, ball, roller or liquid, turns on lights when it sits level.
US-11105625-B1.twist: Cheap LEDs and coin cells make the light-up version nearly free to add.

US-11106737-B2.name: Context-based search suggestions
US-11106737-B2.hook: Suggests searches by reading the information flow on a user's device to guess what they need when they start a search.
US-11106737-B2.twist: On-device language models can do this privately without sending data to a server.

US-11107341-B2.name: Air-left light sleeve
US-11107341-B2.hook: A sleeve that clips onto a firefighter emergency breathing connection and shows remaining cylinder air with a row of lights.
US-11107341-B2.twist: Low-power pressure sensors and LEDs make a retrofit add-on practical.

US-11107348-B1.name: Portable race start lights
US-11107348-B1.hook: A stand with two sets of countdown lights placed at a start line and triggered by a wireless remote.
US-11107348-B1.twist: Phone apps could control it and log reaction times for youth races.

US-11107376-B2.name: Wind-permeable media facade
US-11107376-B2.hook: A building display made of thin, spaced light elements on suspension lines that can tilt so wind passes through.
US-11107376-B2.twist: Cheap addressable LED strips make sparse large facades affordable.

US-11107446-B2.name: Guitar restringing plate
US-11107446-B2.hook: A plate that fits on a guitar bridge with string holes and ferrules that hold strings in place for quicker restringing.
US-11107446-B2.twist: Small batch CNC or printed parts sell well to hobbyist players online.

US-11108197-B2.name: Lamp cord with outlets
US-11108197-B2.hook: A lamp power cord with an inline housing holding two surge-protected power ports for charging devices.
US-11108197-B2.twist: Swap the ports for USB-C to charge phones at the bedside.

US-11108767-B2.name: Secure invention capture kit
US-11108767-B2.hook: Web, app and a secure hardware unit that capture an inventor's evidence and send it encrypted to patent offices for a filing date.
US-11108767-B2.twist: Patent offices now accept more electronic filing, easing direct submission.

US-11108903-B2.name: Phone float pad
US-11108903-B2.hook: A light buoyant pad that attaches to a phone's back, within its footprint, so it floats if dropped in water.
US-11108903-B2.twist: Fits boating and kayaking accessory shops that sell phone gear.

US-11109184-B2.name: In-store location alerts
US-11109184-B2.hook: Detectors in a store identify a shopper's phone at a spot and send notifications tied to products nearby.
US-11109184-B2.twist: Bluetooth beacons and store apps make spot-level detection cheap.

US-11110319-B1.name: Sliding plank foot cradle
US-11110319-B1.hook: A foot cradle with heel stop and leg support on sliding coasters, used to do plank exercise variations.
US-11110319-B1.twist: Home fitness buyers want small gear that fits under a bed.

US-11110575-B2.name: Nail and dowel gun
US-11110575-B2.hook: A pneumatic gun fed by a belt of alternating nails and dowels, made for tilt-up concrete construction.
US-11110575-B2.twist: Labor shortages in construction push demand for faster fastening tools.

US-11111669-B1.name: Magnetic stud track holder
US-11111669-B1.hook: A magnet-held hanger that sticks under steel decking and holds steel stud top track so one person can install it.
US-11111669-B1.twist: Strong rare-earth magnets are cheap now, keeping the tool light.

US-11111675-B1.name: Flashing forming tool
US-11111675-B1.hook: A rod with a handle and a twin-spade end with a gap between the spades for bending flashing.
US-11111675-B1.twist: Simple to sell directly to roofers and siding installers online.

US-11111709-B1.name: Clamp-on door hinge repair
US-11111709-B1.hook: A replacement hinge whose door side clamps both faces of a damaged door with spikes, screws and a ratchet.
US-11111709-B1.twist: Fits landlords and handymen fixing doors without replacing the slab.

US-11112161-B1.name: Cabinet ice machine
US-11112161-B1.hook: An ice machine cabinet with a door-mounted harvesting housing, multi-level floor, drain, chute and container hanger.
US-11112161-B1.twist: Small-scale ice sales and bars want compact self-serve units.

US-11114070-B2.name: Clip-on string dampener
US-11114070-B2.hook: A clip-on body with an angled adjustment rod that presses a fabric-topped dampener against strings to change their tone.
US-11114070-B2.twist: Desktop CNC and printing allow small runs for niche players.

US-11114072-B2.name: Drapable guitar pad
US-11114072-B2.hook: A flexible sheet with a compressible face that drapes over part of a guitar to support it while playing.
US-11114072-B2.twist: Easy add-on product for guitar teachers and online shops.

US-11114611-B2.name: Implant-defined MRAM cells
US-11114611-B2.hook: Makes small magnetic memory cells by implanting oxygen ions to isolate pillars and leads, needing no etch steps.
US-11114611-B2.twist: MRAM is now used as embedded memory in chips, raising interest in cheaper processing.

US-11116144-B2.name: Spray-on hedging boom
US-11116144-B2.hook: A hedging or topping vehicle with nozzles that apply treatment liquid onto fresh cuts of trees to prevent infection.
US-11116144-B2.twist: Precision spraying controls cut chemical use on orchards.

US-11116175-B2.name: Ventilated animal house
US-11116175-B2.hook: An animal house with a temperature-equalizing passage through the culture layer, vent holes, and exhaust extraction.
US-11116175-B2.twist: Cheap sensors could automate airflow in small livestock barns.

US-11116181-B2.name: Heated pet repellent collar
US-11116181-B2.hook: A collar pod with a battery and heater that warms a repellent-loaded pad so it releases through vent holes.
US-11116181-B2.twist: Small rechargeable cells make a lighter, longer-running pod possible.

US-11116190-B2.name: Hook-hiding casting float
US-11116190-B2.hook: A float that encloses the hook and bait during casting, then releases the hook to a set depth once in the water.
US-11116190-B2.twist: Pier and family fishing sellers look for safer casting gear.

US-11116194-B2.name: Propeller tail lure
US-11116194-B2.hook: A fishing lure with a free-spinning vertical propeller between two tail fins that throws spray and moves lifelike.
US-11116194-B2.twist: 3D printing lets small makers test lure shapes quickly.

US-11116200-B1.name: Magnetic field pest control
US-11116200-B1.hook: Drives current through a wire loop near a nest of magnet-sensitive insects to expose eggs and pupae until the colony shrinks.
US-11116200-B1.twist: Chemical-free pest control appeals to homeowners and organic farms.

US-11116201-B1.name: Bucket spiral mouse trap
US-11116201-B1.hook: A bucket lid with a rolling bar over the opening and a spiral ramp that leads mice up the bucket side.
US-11116201-B1.twist: Low-cost molded kit sold to farms and garages.

US-11116259-B1.name: Removable underwire bra
US-11116259-B1.hook: A breast support garment with one-piece underwires that can be removed, plus a strap system tied to the sides.
US-11116259-B1.twist: Fits direct-to-consumer lingerie brands focused on comfort and washing.

US-11116267-B2.name: False eyelash applicator
US-11116267-B2.hook: A finger-ring tool with a cable-driven slider that closes two parallel applicators to apply or remove false lashes.
US-11116267-B2.twist: Lash sales through social media create a ready buyer base.

US-11116268-B2.name: Hands-free seam ripper
US-11116268-B2.hook: A grippy ovoid base with a pivoting stitch ripper that sets at different angles, so you pull fabric across it.
US-11116268-B2.twist: Sewing hobby growth makes small notion tools easy to sell online.

US-11116277-B2.name: Slipper with swap covers
US-11116277-B2.hook: A slipper that takes removable full covers in different colors to change its look.
US-11116277-B2.twist: Print-on-demand fabric makes custom covers cheap to offer.

US-11116320-B2.name: Solar shade chair
US-11116320-B2.hook: A folding chair with a fold-out sun shade topped by a solar panel that feeds charging ports.
US-11116320-B2.twist: Thin, cheap solar panels make this light enough for beach use.

US-11116342-B1.name: Telescoping pocket straw
US-11116342-B1.hook: A reusable straw that telescopes to adjust length and has end caps to close it for carrying.
US-11116342-B1.twist: Plastic straw bans created a market for reusable straws.

US-11116349-B2.name: Stick cooking machine
US-11116349-B2.hook: A rod-shaped appliance with touch screen, motor-driven stirring rod and heater that cooks food in a cylinder.
US-11116349-B2.twist: Cheap touch screen modules and app recipes suit small kitchens.

US-11116363-B2.name: Wall-mount fluid dispenser
US-11116363-B2.hook: A dispenser system that fastens securely to walls in washrooms and workshops to give controlled amounts of soap or oil.
US-11116363-B2.twist: Touch-free dispensing demand stayed after the pandemic.

US-11116612-B2.name: Step-by-step denture method
US-11116612-B2.hook: A denture-making method with ordered impressions, custom tray, bite registration and molding steps.
US-11116612-B2.twist: Intraoral scanners and printed trays could shorten the steps.

US-11116667-B1.name: Dial-fit goggles strap
US-11116667-B1.hook: Protective goggles with a rotating dial that tightens or loosens the headband in small steps.
US-11116667-B1.twist: Dial systems are now common and cheap from boot and helmet suppliers.

US-11116679-B2.name: Arc patient turning device
US-11116679-B2.hook: A 180-degree arc with levers and harnesses that holds a bedbound patient and mechanically helps turn them.
US-11116679-B2.twist: Caregiver shortages raise demand for one-person patient handling aids.

US-11116697-B1.name: Locking pill dispenser tube
US-11116697-B1.hook: A tube with an authenticated locking cap and two motorized doors that releases controlled prescription items one at a time.
US-11116697-B1.twist: Cheap fingerprint modules and microcontrollers make a home opioid lockbox affordable.

US-11116946-B2.name: Self-unblocking urinary catheter
US-11116946-B2.hook: A catheter whose drain hole can be widened by inflating a small chamber in its wall, clearing blockages without removal.
US-11116946-B2.twist: Veterinary clinics could adopt it first, since it is described for animals.

US-11117006-B1.name: Heat-triggered fire canister
US-11117006-B1.hook: A pressurized tank of fire-retardant gas that bursts open automatically when the room reaches a set temperature.
US-11117006-B1.twist: Fits unattended spaces like battery cabinets and EV chargers that need passive fire suppression.

US-11117009-B2.name: One-piece loop exerciser
US-11117009-B2.hook: A curved, continuous loop frame used on the floor, a chair or a table for resistance exercises without any adjustment.
US-11117009-B2.twist: Home fitness buyers want small, single-piece gear that ships flat and stores easily.

US-11117018-B2.name: Weight stack rep tracker
US-11117018-B2.hook: A clip-on sensor stand that reads the weight and reps on any gym machine and logs them per user via NFC or face recognition.
US-11117018-B2.twist: Gyms can retrofit old machines cheaply instead of buying connected equipment.

US-11117033-B2.name: Sensor golf practice kit
US-11117033-B2.hook: Golf clubs, a ball cup and a motion sensor that report swing and putting data wirelessly to a computer for practice or simulated play.
US-11117033-B2.twist: Phone apps and cheap IMUs now replace the dedicated computer the patent assumed.

US-11117268-B2.name: Ball-joint robot wrist
US-11117268-B2.hook: A robot hand whose carpal bones are linked by double-ball connectors seated in sockets, mimicking a human wrist.
US-11117268-B2.twist: 3D-printed humanoid hands are a fast-growing hobby and research market.

US-11117366-B1.name: Inkjet-to-UV screen imager kit
US-11117366-B1.hook: A kit that swaps an inkjet screen printer's print head for a light-emitting head that exposes emulsion screens directly.
US-11117366-B1.twist: Cheap UV LEDs and laser diodes make the retrofit head inexpensive.

US-11117629-B1.name: Slide-out trailer dolly
US-11117629-B1.hook: An undercarriage tucked under a highway trailer that slides out to become the converter dolly for towing a second trailer.
US-11117629-B1.twist: Double-trailer freight and driver shortages reward faster hook-ups.

US-11117702-B2.name: Collapsible tissue box
US-11117702-B2.hook: A folded tissue box with tear-away strips so the top half drops down around the bottom, keeping the last tissues reachable.
US-11117702-B2.twist: Packaging brands look for small fixes that cut waste and annoyance.

US-11117705-B1.name: Carton flap slide lock
US-11117705-B1.hook: A slider on a beverage carton's pour flaps that locks them shut after opening and slides back to pour.
US-11117705-B1.twist: Plant milk and juice cartons dominate shelves and still reseal poorly.

US-11117714-B2.name: Double-lock storage box
US-11117714-B2.hook: A storage container whose lid is held by both a snap-fit and a hinged latch.
US-11117714-B2.twist: Meal prep and tool organizer buyers want containers that survive drops.

US-11117719-B2.name: Twist-to-pour bottle cap
US-11117719-B2.hook: A two-part cap that opens and closes flow by rotating its halves to line up partial openings.
US-11117719-B2.twist: Tethered-cap rules push brands toward caps that never come off the bottle.

US-11117723-B2.name: Beverage can cover
US-11117723-B2.hook: A disc with a drinking opening and raised lip that covers an open can to keep out insects and hold fizz and cold.
US-11117723-B2.twist: Easy to 3D print or mold as a branded giveaway.

US-11118293-B2.name: Dye, steam and dry unit
US-11118293-B2.hook: One machine that applies dye evenly to textiles, fixes it with steam, then blows the fabric dry.
US-11118293-B2.twist: Small-batch and on-demand textile makers need compact dye lines.

US-11118320-B2.name: Heat-seal poop grabber
US-11118320-B2.hook: A gripper whose heated fingertips melt a bag around animal waste, sealing it as it is picked up.
US-11118320-B2.twist: Yard robots and pet-waste services could build this into automated cleanup.

US-11118339-B2.name: Urine-diverting toilet
US-11118339-B2.hook: A toilet bowl divided into liquid and solid zones, with urine piped to a separate storage tank.
US-11118339-B2.twist: Urine is drawing interest as a fertilizer source, and off-grid builds want water savings.

US-11118455-B2.name: Inflatable night-driving tunnel
US-11118455-B2.hook: Inflatable dark-lined arches that join into a tunnel so drivers can train in simulated night conditions during the day.
US-11118455-B2.twist: Useful for testing night vision cameras and driver-assist sensors on demand.

US-11118504-B2.name: Linked dual-piston engine
US-11118504-B2.hook: An engine with upper and lower pistons joined through a linkage to the crankshaft, aiming for more torque per stroke.
US-11118504-B2.twist: Range-extender generators for EVs reward compact high-torque engines.

US-11118570-B2.name: Precast concrete wind tower
US-11118570-B2.hook: A wind turbine tower stacked from post-tensioned precast concrete rings whose wall pieces carry loads independently.
US-11118570-B2.twist: Taller turbines outgrow steel towers that can be trucked, making precast concrete attractive.

US-11118654-B2.name: Cam rope lock
US-11118654-B2.hook: A housing with a spring cam and trigger that grips a rope securely and releases it on demand.
US-11118654-B2.twist: Arborists, climbers and cargo straps all want simpler one-hand rope locks.

US-11118709-B2.name: Pull-tab tube clamp
US-11118709-B2.hook: A tube clamp with a sliding block and pivoting lever that tightens onto a tube when the tab is pulled.
US-11118709-B2.twist: Modular tube frames for tents, carts and displays need tool-free clamps.

US-11118725-B2.name: Swing-arm device stand
US-11118725-B2.hook: An extendable parallel-arm support with a rotating table for holding computers and electronics during repair.
US-11118725-B2.twist: Repair shops and right-to-repair hobbyists need flexible bench arms.

US-11118783-B2.name: Auto candle snuffer
US-11118783-B2.hook: An enclosure that shuts doors over a burning candle after a chosen time, putting it out and shielding it from objects.
US-11118783-B2.twist: Candle fires are common; a smart timer version fits the home-safety market.

US-11119136-B1.name: Wideband harmonic load tuner
US-11119136-B1.hook: A lab instrument combining a signal coupler and two slide-screw tuners to set impedances at several harmonics for testing transistors.
US-11119136-B1.twist: 5G and GaN power amplifier testing needs multi-octave tuning.

US-11119140-B1.name: Fast noise parameter test
US-11119140-B1.hook: A method that measures amplifier noise parameters faster by sweeping frequency slightly instead of moving the tuner mechanically.
US-11119140-B1.twist: Software-defined test setups can apply this to cut RF lab time.

US-11120651-B2.name: Borescope inspection logger
US-11120651-B2.hook: A method for recording borescope inspections using a module and part hierarchy with standard defect and evaluation templates.
US-11120651-B2.twist: Templates like these are ready-made labels for training defect-detection AI.

US-11120683-B2.name: Knob remote for web actions
US-11120683-B2.hook: A handheld remote with a screen and rotary knob that triggers user-configured internet requests to smart home devices and web APIs.
US-11120683-B2.twist: Home Assistant users want physical buttons for their automations.

US-11121427-B1.name: Sliding battery stabilizer
US-11121427-B1.hook: A vehicle battery mounted on rails that slides sideways during turns to improve stability.
US-11121427-B1.twist: Heavy EV battery packs make weight placement a bigger handling lever.

US-11121642-B2.name: Simpler multilevel inverter control
US-11121642-B2.hook: A space vector modulation method for multilevel power converters that avoids computing the many redundant switch states.
US-11121642-B2.twist: Solar inverters and EV drives use multilevel converters on cheap microcontrollers.

US-11121650-B2.name: Multi-motor swappable EV drive
US-11121650-B2.hook: Several DC motors on a shared drive shaft, each fed by its own swappable battery cassette in the vehicle or boat.
US-11121650-B2.twist: Battery swapping is spreading for scooters, boats and small EVs.

US-11122156-B2.name: One-hand phone mount
US-11122156-B2.hook: A phone holder with symmetric grippers that lock the device and release it with a single-hand motion.
US-11122156-B2.twist: Delivery riders and drivers need mounts they can use with one hand.

US-11122356-B1.name: Dog calming headphones
US-11122356-B1.hook: Strap-on headphones for dogs that play stored music to soothe them during distressing sounds like fireworks.
US-11122356-B1.twist: Pet owners spend heavily on anxiety products for fireworks and storms.

US-11122368-B1.name: Headphones with built-in player
US-11122368-B1.hook: Headphones with an integrated media player, AM/FM radio and a transceiver for connecting other audio sources.
US-11122368-B1.twist: Phone-free audio for kids and gym users is a growing niche.

US-11122445-B2.name: Phone test rig
US-11122445-B2.hook: An automated station that tests several phones at once for display, microphone, speakers, ports and wireless charging.
US-11122445-B2.twist: The refurbished phone trade needs fast grading at volume.

US-11122722-B2.name: Powered spike soil loosener
US-11122722-B2.hook: A handheld powered tool that extends and retracts spikes into soil to roughen it for seeding or ease weeding.
US-11122722-B2.twist: Cordless battery platforms make new garden tools easy to launch.

US-11122750-B1.name: Screw-in plant watering well
US-11122750-B1.hook: An open-ended in-ground sleeve with a bowl top, stabilizing fins and screw threads that directs water to a plant's roots.
US-11122750-B1.twist: Water restrictions push gardeners toward targeted root watering.

US-11122780-B2.name: Flood-floating beehive platform
US-11122780-B2.hook: A floating platform for beehives that rides up and down on anchored poles so hives survive flooding.
US-11122780-B2.twist: More frequent floods threaten apiaries in low-lying farmland.

US-11122782-B1.name: Floating oyster crate frame
US-11122782-B1.hook: A frame of divided crates with a buoyant member that grows oysters either on the seabed or at the surface.
US-11122782-B1.twist: Oyster farming is expanding as low-impact aquaculture and reef restoration.

US-11122788-B2.name: Magnetic fly box
US-11122788-B2.hook: A fly fishing case where magnets hold each fly by its eyelet, with guides that line up the line for tying.
US-11122788-B2.twist: Strong small neodymium magnets and 3D printing make short custom runs cheap.

US-11122845-B2.name: Channeled sweatband
US-11122845-B2.hook: A sweatband with side wings and a surface channel that carries sweat away from the eyes.
US-11122845-B2.twist: Knit-to-shape textiles allow channels without extra sewing steps.

US-11122848-B2.name: Crush-foam helmet layer
US-11122848-B2.hook: A helmet with a layer of open-cell foam between shell and pad that crushes permanently above a set impact pressure.
US-11122848-B2.twist: Lattice foams printed to a tuned crush pressure are now made at helmet scale.

US-11122876-B2.name: Tamper-proof zipper bag
US-11122876-B2.hook: Luggage whose zipper slider end fits through a hole in a built-in padlock so the opening cannot be forced apart.
US-11122876-B2.twist: Fits travelers worried about bag tampering who now track luggage with item trackers.

US-11122877-B2.name: Backlit art handbag
US-11122877-B2.hook: An evening handbag with a dimmable flexible LED panel that backlights a swappable printed transparency.
US-11122877-B2.twist: Thin flexible LED sheets and USB-C batteries are cheap now.

US-11122887-B1.name: Air-lift rolling table
US-11122887-B1.hook: A table whose feet lift onto roller balls with compressed air to move it, then settle back firmly on the floor.
US-11122887-B1.twist: Small quiet compressors suit flexible offices and workshops that rearrange often.

US-11122941-B2.name: Wall-mount soap scrubber
US-11122941-B2.hook: A shower scrubber held on the wall by suction cups that releases liquid soap through its brushes.
US-11122941-B2.twist: Fits accessibility products for people who struggle to reach their back.

US-11123087-B1.name: Ventriculostomy aiming guide
US-11123087-B1.hook: A curved frame resting on the skull with two tube guides that aim a drill, needle or catheter into the brain's ventricle.
US-11123087-B1.twist: Patient-specific 3D-printed guides from CT scans are now routine in some hospitals.

US-11123138-B2.name: Hooked vein treatment tip
US-11123138-B2.hook: A probe for treating varicose veins from inside the vein, ending in a soft hooked hydrophilic tip that delivers the treatment.
US-11123138-B2.twist: Outpatient vein clinics favor catheter treatments over surgery.

US-11123169-B2.name: Up-down electric toothbrush
US-11123169-B2.hook: An electric toothbrush whose cam mechanism swings the head up and down, like vertical manual brushing.
US-11123169-B2.twist: Small brushless motors and molded cams cut the cost of new brush motions.

US-11123214-B2.name: Articulated lifting back brace
US-11123214-B2.hook: A back brace made of linked vertebra-like segments on ball joints, with supports that keep a safe lifting posture.
US-11123214-B2.twist: Warehouses are buying passive exoskeletons to cut lifting injuries.

US-11123583-B2.name: Smoke-filter oxygen mask
US-11123583-B2.hook: An aircraft passenger oxygen mask with a sealing liner and filters that block smoke and fumes during a cabin fire.
US-11123583-B2.twist: Cabin fume events get more attention, and smoke hoods are now sold to travelers.

US-11123591-B2.name: Plank foot positioner
US-11123591-B2.hook: A curved board with a block and foot pegs that holds the feet in a set position for plank exercises.
US-11123591-B2.twist: Home workout gear sells well online for small, flat-shipping items.

US-11123599-B2.name: Running strength machine
US-11123599-B2.hook: A frame with pivoting leg assemblies and resistance members that trains the muscles used in running.
US-11123599-B2.twist: Sports science teams buy specialist trainers, and sensors can now log every stride.

US-11123607-B2.name: Sensor squat rack
US-11123607-B2.hook: A weightlifting rack with sensors on the uprights, scales in the bar hooks and a barbell accelerometer feeding a coaching app.
US-11123607-B2.twist: Cheap Bluetooth sensors and phone apps make smart gym hardware affordable for small gyms.

US-11123623-B1.name: Kick angle trainer
US-11123623-B1.hook: A packable frame that gives a football kicker a visual target to practice kicks at a consistent upward angle.
US-11123623-B1.twist: Phone video can now measure each kick's launch angle against the frame.

US-11123648-B1.name: Rolling ball ring fidget
US-11123648-B1.hook: A hollow ring with a gap, where a small hand wobble keeps a ball rolling around inside it.
US-11123648-B1.twist: Fidget toys sell well in small runs through online shops.

US-11123649-B1.name: Wiggling segment fidget
US-11123649-B1.hook: A fidget toy of wedge-shaped segments on bearings that seem to dance when squeezed and wiggled between the fingers.
US-11123649-B1.twist: Desktop 3D printers can produce small runs with off-the-shelf bearings.

US-11123756-B1.name: Spatter texture applicator
