US-11123756-B1.hook: A tool with swappable rotary inserts whose flexible fingers flick texture material onto walls and ceilings.
US-11123756-B1.twist: Drywall repair DIY keeps growing, and inserts can be molded cheaply.

US-11123856-B2.name: Quick-spin wrench arm
US-11123856-B2.hook: A ratchet wrench head with a side arm you can push to spin the head quickly.
US-11123856-B2.twist: Fits tool brands looking for small features that stand out in retail.

US-11124081-B2.name: Solar shopping scooter
US-11124081-B2.hook: A seated mobility scooter with a basket and a solar panel that tops up its battery, plus a wall plug.
US-11124081-B2.twist: Solar panels and lithium batteries cost far less than when this was filed.

US-11124103-B1.name: Snap-on console cover
US-11124103-B1.hook: A molded cover that snaps over a car's console and cup holders, with its own cup holder recesses.
US-11124103-B1.twist: Vehicle-specific accessories can be scanned and molded for each model.

US-11124105-B2.name: Truck bed push-out wall
US-11124105-B2.hook: A movable wall driven along a shaft or chain that pushes waste out of a truck bed or trailer.
US-11124105-B2.twist: Small contractors and landscapers want unloading without a dump truck.

US-11124161-B2.name: Heated license plate frame
US-11124161-B2.hook: A license plate holder with a heating element under an insulating layer to keep the plate clear of snow and ice.
US-11124161-B2.twist: Plate readers on toll roads need plates to stay readable in winter.

US-11124216-B1.name: Auto-braking stroller
US-11124216-B1.hook: A stroller that brakes itself when it rolls on a slope with nobody holding the handle.
US-11124216-B1.twist: Low-cost tilt and grip sensors and hub motors are now common.

US-11124283-B1.name: Modular ground-effect craft
US-11124283-B1.hook: A wing-in-ground-effect vehicle with swappable cockpit, energy and wing modules for quick turnaround.
US-11124283-B1.twist: Electric seagliders have revived interest in ground-effect coastal transport.

US-11124681-B2.name: Low-heat laminating film
US-11124681-B2.hook: A laminating film with an EVA-based adhesive layer that bonds at lower temperatures, with the recipe percentages given.
US-11124681-B2.twist: Lower laminating heat suits heat-sensitive prints and saves energy.

US-11124937-B1.name: Porous pile soil drain
US-11124937-B1.hook: A ground improvement method that drives sand-filled pipes to leave porous piles, so water drains out of clay soil faster.
US-11124937-B1.twist: Building on soft ground near coasts and rivers is increasing.

US-11124953-B2.name: Leak-proof drain system
US-11124953-B2.hook: A waterproofing system for shower drains, floor drains and squat toilets that stops leaks without sticking the membrane down.
US-11124953-B2.twist: Curbless wet-room bathrooms are popular and need reliable drain waterproofing.

US-11124958-B1.name: Manhole debris basket
US-11124958-B1.hook: A basket with a reinforced flange and lifting hooks that sits in an open manhole to catch falling debris during work.
US-11124958-B1.twist: Cities face tighter rules on debris entering storm drains.

US-11124972-B2.name: Grooved wall panels
US-11124972-B2.hook: Rectangular wall or floor panels with grooves on the back so unskilled workers can mount them in rows quickly.
US-11124972-B2.twist: Prefab and click-fit finishing helps where skilled labor is short.

US-11124980-B1.name: Pool deep-end barrier
US-11124980-B1.hook: A mesh barrier strung between two rods set into deck sockets that keeps children out of a pool's deep end.
US-11124980-B1.twist: Fits rental homes and pool-share listings that need simple safety gear.

US-11124985-B1.name: Crank-in umbrella anchor
US-11124985-B1.hook: A ground spike with a locking umbrella socket and a hand crank to drive it deep enough to hold an umbrella.
US-11124985-B1.twist: Flying beach umbrellas have led some towns to require anchors.

US-11125004-B2.name: Garage sensor guard
US-11125004-B2.hook: An adjustable cover that shields a garage door safety sensor, fastened through a slot so it can be moved or removed.
US-11125004-B2.twist: Sold as an add-on for the millions of existing garage door openers.

US-11125015-B2.name: Ladder ground anchor
US-11125015-B2.hook: Hooked arms that clip into a ladder's leg holes, pinned to the ground with a stake and safety chain to stop slipping.
US-11125015-B2.twist: Workplace ladder falls draw insurer attention, so cheap anchoring aids sell.

US-11125054-B2.name: Downhole oil heater pump
US-11125054-B2.hook: A device fitted below an oil well pump that heats the oil and keeps wax from building up to lower its viscosity.
US-11125054-B2.twist: Aging heavy-oil wells look for cheap ways to keep producing.

US-11125199-B2.name: Remote car module power
US-11125199-B2.hook: A method to switch car components on or off remotely while checking battery levels and reporting each component's state.
US-11125199-B2.twist: Connected cars and over-the-air updates make remote power management a standard need.

US-11125237-B1.name: Fluid-driven booster pump
US-11125237-B1.hook: A booster where moving fluid spins outer blades on a rotor, and inner blades then push a still fluid along a pipeline.
US-11125237-B1.twist: Pumps without electric motors suit remote pipelines and hazardous sites.

US-11125246-B2.name: Quiet blower case
US-11125246-B2.hook: A case for an industrial blower with foam baffles and vibration mounts that also routes air over the motor to cool it.
US-11125246-B2.twist: Water-damage restoration crews need quieter drying gear in occupied homes.

US-11125260-B1.name: Light dowel furniture joints
US-11125260-B1.hook: A dowel and joint system that lets wooden furniture be assembled and taken apart easily while using less wood.
US-11125260-B1.twist: Flat-pack and CNC-cut furniture makers want tool-free joints that survive repeated moves.

US-11125380-B2.name: Multi-remote caddy
US-11125380-B2.hook: A hand-held holder that grips several remote controls of different sizes so you carry one object instead of many.
US-11125380-B2.twist: 3D printing makes custom-fit slots for any remote cheap to produce.

US-11125398-B1.name: Curvable LED channel
US-11125398-B1.hook: An LED strip in a curved channel with a lens, mounted so the lights sit along the channel floor and bend sideways.
US-11125398-B1.twist: Cheap addressable LED strips make curved accent lighting a common DIY and retail fixture.

US-11125452-B2.name: Top-fill submersible humidifier
US-11125452-B2.hook: A humidifier with a detachable top cover holding the fan and controls, filled with water from above.
US-11125452-B2.twist: Top-fill designs are what buyers now expect; cheap ultrasonic modules lower the parts cost.

US-11125500-B2.name: Vapor-recycling dryer
US-11125500-B2.hook: A drying process that reuses the exhaust air and vapor mix, compressed in a heat exchanger, to heat the product through each drying phase.
US-11125500-B2.twist: Cheap heat pumps and sensors make energy-recovering food and lumber dryers practical at small scale.

US-11125557-B1.name: Self-levelling laser divider
US-11125557-B1.hook: A tripod-mounted self-levelling laser that projects evenly spaced division marks on a wall, with switches to pick how many.
US-11125557-B1.twist: Low-cost line lasers and diffractive optics make this a cheap add-on for tilers and picture hangers.

US-11125777-B1.name: Sealed probe RF link
US-11125777-B1.hook: A sealed, adjustable coaxial link between test instruments and angled wafer probes that keeps RF shielding while the probe moves.
US-11125777-B1.twist: Growth in mmWave and GaN chip testing raises demand for shielded hot-chuck load-pull setups.

US-11126160-B1.name: Scaled-up surface replica
US-11126160-B1.hook: Scan a worn metal surface with a profilometer, then build an enlarged 3-D model with depth exaggerated more than width.
US-11126160-B1.twist: Desktop 3D printers turn the enlarged scans into hands-on teaching and failure-analysis models.

US-11126214-B1.name: Auto-shutoff stove knob
US-11126214-B1.hook: A stove knob with adapters and a pivot joint so a heat-triggered shutoff unit can fit many different stoves.
US-11126214-B1.twist: Aging-in-place and kitchen fire prevention create buyers for retrofit stove safety kits.

US-11126642-B2.name: Distributed minority oversampling
US-11126642-B2.hook: A method to create synthetic samples for rare classes in huge datasets split across many machines, using pivots, bins and M-Trees.
US-11126642-B2.twist: Fraud and defect detection on large data still suffers from class imbalance; Spark-scale versions are in demand.

US-11126995-B2.name: Radio-powered biometric card
US-11126995-B2.hook: A battery-free biometric smart card that harvests power from nearby radio waves so it can enroll a fingerprint and exchange data.
US-11126995-B2.twist: Fingerprint payment cards are entering banks; enrollment without a sleeve or reader is still a pain point.

US-11127274-B1.name: Shake-alert child tracker
US-11127274-B1.hook: A child's GPS bracelet that sends location and an alert to a caregiver's phone when it senses strong shaking.
US-11127274-B1.twist: Cheap LTE-M modules and phone apps make small trackers affordable for parents and care homes.

US-11128156-B2.name: Phone-to-phone power bank
US-11128156-B2.hook: A charger that moves charge from one device to another through USB cables and an inductive pad.
US-11128156-B2.twist: USB-C power delivery and Qi2 make device-to-device charging simple to build from stock chips.

US-11128167-B1.name: Portable site power hub
US-11128167-B1.hook: A portable box that takes power from an outside supply and spreads it to many outlets, with power-loss and emergency alerts.
US-11128167-B1.twist: Events, film sets and construction sites need networked temporary power that reports faults by phone.

US-11128759-B2.name: Toll-free exchange routing
US-11128759-B2.hook: Routes toll-free calls through one dedicated toll-free exchange to cut the number of handoffs and the cost per call.
US-11128759-B2.twist: VoIP and SIP trunks make a small, software-only toll-free exchange cheap to run.

US-11129241-B2.name: Multi-zone ceramic heater
US-11129241-B2.hook: A rolled ceramic tube heater with printed circuits and separate leads so different zones can run at different temperatures.
US-11129241-B2.twist: Vape, 3D printer and lab heating makers want compact heaters with independently controlled zones.

US-11129340-B1.name: Plant training clip
US-11129340-B1.hook: A curved clip with two arms and walls that holds a plant stem in place to train its growth.
US-11129340-B1.twist: Home growers and indoor gardens buy low-stress training clips in bulk; injection molding is cheap.

US-11129360-B1.name: Leash handle ground stake
US-11129360-B1.hook: A leash handle that splits into a stake and sheath so you can drive it into the ground to tie up your dog.
US-11129360-B1.twist: Dog owners at parks and campsites buy compact tie-out gear online.

US-11129370-B1.name: Bee box heat treatment
US-11129370-B1.hook: A heater-and-fan unit that mounts on a bee box and circulates hot air to kill mites and parasites inside.
US-11129370-B1.twist: Varroa mites keep killing colonies; beekeepers want chemical-free treatments with cheap temperature control.

US-11129371-B1.name: Connected mini terrarium
US-11129371-B1.hook: A small internet-connected terrarium with LED lights, a water sensor and reservoir that runs for weeks without care.
US-11129371-B1.twist: Cheap Wi-Fi microcontrollers make app-monitored desk plants an easy gift product.

US-11129372-B1.name: Deep sea fish cage
US-11129372-B1.hook: An offshore fish farming cage with a float support, counterweight bars, net walls and an escape-proof funnel plate.
US-11129372-B1.twist: Offshore aquaculture is growing as near-shore sites fill up and face stricter rules.

US-11129400-B2.name: Whole silver carp processing
US-11129400-B2.hook: A process that turns all of a silver carp into canned surimi, bone powder, protein powder and liquid fertilizer.
US-11129400-B2.twist: Invasive carp in US rivers are a free feedstock that states pay to remove.

US-11129411-B2.name: Lighter sleeve pipe snuffer
US-11129411-B2.hook: A lighter sleeve with a flexible cap that fits over a pipe bowl to put it out, plus a small storage chamber.
US-11129411-B2.twist: Legal cannabis markets support a large accessory trade sold through dispensaries.

US-11129425-B1.name: Layered nose-wipe glove
US-11129425-B1.hook: An absorbent glove with stacked layers so a patient can wipe their nose and peel away used layers one at a time.
US-11129425-B1.twist: Care homes and parents of sick kids want simple disposable hygiene aids.

US-11129430-B2.name: Stud setting press plates
US-11129430-B2.hook: Three stacked plates with soft-tipped pins that press many decorative studs onto strips of material at once without damage.
US-11129430-B2.twist: Small leather and pet-collar makers selling online need cheap batch tooling.

US-11129454-B1.name: Umbrella pole fan
US-11129454-B1.hook: A battery fan with folding blades that slides onto a patio umbrella pole and spins around it.
US-11129454-B1.twist: Cheap brushless motors and USB-C batteries make cordless patio fans a strong summer product.

US-11129456-B2.name: Piggyback suitcase plate
US-11129456-B2.hook: A plate that slides out from a suitcase's base so a second suitcase can ride on top while you roll both.
US-11129456-B2.twist: Travelers with multiple bags want hands-free stacking without straps.

US-11129457-B2.name: Bluetooth flat iron
US-11129457-B2.hook: A hair straightener with a built-in speaker, Bluetooth controls and a battery so you can stream audio while styling.
US-11129457-B2.twist: Bluetooth audio modules cost under a dollar now.

US-11129459-B2.name: Wearable bonnet dryer
US-11129459-B2.hook: A bowl you wear on your head, fed by a detachable blower and heater, to dry hair hands-free.
US-11129459-B2.twist: Natural-hair and travel markets buy portable hooded dryers online.

US-11129462-B2.name: Retractable brush bottle
US-11129462-B2.hook: A container whose cap holds a brush that extends to apply fluid and retracts into a sheath when stored.
US-11129462-B2.twist: Nail, adhesive and touch-up paint brands want mess-free applicators.

US-11129471-B1.name: Rolling sit-stand workstation
US-11129471-B1.hook: A cart with a telescoping post and pivoting desk so a computer can move between rooms and be used sitting or standing.
US-11129471-B1.twist: Hybrid work and classrooms want movable height-adjustable desks.

US-11129481-B2.name: Air mattress hose repair
US-11129481-B2.hook: A spare hose segment and fitting that replaces a broken inflation hose or fitting on an air mattress.
US-11129481-B2.twist: Repair kits keep mattresses out of landfills and sell as cheap add-ons.

US-11129496-B2.name: Grill grate oiler
US-11129496-B2.hook: A handled roller of absorbent material that scrapes grill grates and applies oil fed through a hole in the head.
US-11129496-B2.twist: Home grilling and griddle cooking keep growing; accessory sales follow.

US-11129558-B2.name: Acid-rinse urine bag
US-11129558-B2.hook: A urine collection bag with a one-piece tube that is periodically rinsed with sterile acetic acid to reduce catheter infections.
US-11129558-B2.twist: Hospitals are penalized for catheter infections and want cheap prevention steps.

US-11129759-B2.name: Body carrying strap net
US-11129759-B2.hook: A grid of adjustable crossing straps with a bearing bed for lifting and carrying a person.
US-11129759-B2.twist: Rescue teams and home caregivers need light, packable patient carriers.

US-11129768-B1.name: Prone foot massager
US-11129768-B1.hook: A device for someone lying face down that massages, warms and electrically stimulates both feet.
US-11129768-B1.twist: Cheap TENS circuits and heating pads put home foot therapy in reach.

US-11130100-B1.name: Adjustable venturi aerator
US-11130100-B1.hook: A water nozzle that draws in outside air through an adjustable inlet by venturi suction and mixes it into the flow.
US-11130100-B1.twist: Pond, pool and hydroponics owners want aeration without extra pumps.

US-11130120-B2.name: Droplet-making pipette tip
US-11130120-B2.hook: A pipette tip with flat micro-channels that turns a sample into tiny droplets in oil for digital PCR.
US-11130120-B2.twist: Disposable droplet tips could make digital PCR possible without expensive droplet generators.

US-11130214-B2.name: Low-profile wrench bit
US-11130214-B2.hook: A short adapter holding a screwdriver or hex bit that fits inside a standard box wrench to reach tight spots.
US-11130214-B2.twist: Machinists and mechanics buy compact bit adapters; magnets keep them in place cheaply.

US-11130255-B2.name: Heat-treated impregnated wood
US-11130255-B2.hook: Thermally modify wood, shape it, then impregnate it with treatment agents under pressure or heat without warping.
US-11130255-B2.twist: CNC shops making outdoor and kitchen goods want durable wood without tropical hardwoods.

US-11130304-B2.name: Cold seed oil press
US-11130304-B2.hook: A slow screw press that squeezes oil from seeds without grinding them, keeping the oil under 130 F so it needs no filtering.
US-11130304-B2.twist: Small-batch cold-pressed oils sell at a premium at farmers markets and online.

US-11130365-B1.name: Lit skull display kit
US-11130365-B1.hook: A battery-powered, remote-controlled light kit that mounts inside an animal skull on a wall plaque to make it glow.
US-11130365-B1.twist: Cheap addressable LEDs and phone-controlled lighting make color effects easy to add.

US-11130434-B2.name: Under-seat car cooler
US-11130434-B2.hook: A cooler that fits under a vehicle seat, with fold-down legs and a system that blows cold air inside.
US-11130434-B2.twist: 12-volt compressor fridges have become small and cheap enough for compact versions.

US-11130451-B2.name: Tailgate toolbox
US-11130451-B2.hook: A pickup tailgate with built-in storage compartments behind a fold-down lid, plus electrical outlets in one compartment.
US-11130451-B2.twist: Electric pickups can feed tailgate outlets from their big batteries.

US-11130477-B2.name: Body damage repair planner
US-11130477-B2.hook: Software that compares a damaged vehicle's measurements with factory specs to show how far and which way the body is bent, then drafts a repair plan.
US-11130477-B2.twist: Phone lidar and photo-based 3D scanning could supply the damage measurements.

US-11130513-B2.name: Wheelchair hitch cart
US-11130513-B2.hook: A cart, such as a shopping cart, that attaches to a wheelchair so the user can collect and move groceries more easily.
US-11130513-B2.twist: Stores face growing accessibility expectations and could stock these for customers.

US-11130514-B1.name: Cart handle sanitary cover
US-11130514-B1.hook: A cover that wraps a shopping cart handle as a germ barrier, with attached gloves and a pocket for small items.
US-11130514-B1.twist: Shoppers stayed more hygiene-minded after 2020; washable fabric versions are easy to sell online.

US-11130538-B1.name: Motorcycle groin guard
US-11130538-B1.hook: A rigid padded shell that clips onto a motorcycle fuel tank to protect the rider's groin.
US-11130538-B1.twist: 3D-printed shells could be shaped to fit specific tank models.

US-11130629-B1.name: Side-mount bin tipper
US-11130629-B1.hook: Hydraulic or electric lifting arms on the passenger side of a garbage truck that grab a trash can and tip it into the truck.
US-11130629-B1.twist: Electric linear actuators suit the electric refuse trucks cities are now buying.

US-11130716-B2.name: Psyllium slow-release fertilizer
US-11130716-B2.hook: An organic fertilizer that soaks psyllium seed husk in nutrients extracted from oil cake, blood meal, fish by-products, shells and minerals so they release slowly.
US-11130716-B2.twist: Demand for organic inputs keeps rising and food-waste streams are easier to source.

US-11131072-B2.name: Rigid floating breakwater
US-11131072-B2.hook: A stiff floating plate at least one wavelength wide, anchored in place, that calms waves by stopping them from bending it.
US-11131072-B2.twist: Rising seas and more marinas make low-cost floating wave barriers attractive.

US-11131119-B2.name: Resettable locker dial lock
US-11131119-B2.hook: A combination dial lock for lockers whose knob turns to a reset position, so the combination can be checked or changed simply.
US-11131119-B2.twist: Gyms and schools reassigning lockers often want quick combination changes without a locksmith.

US-11131138-B2.name: Multi-drop parcel box
US-11131138-B2.hook: A delivery box with several separately lockable compartments and movable dividers, so multiple couriers can each leave a package securely.
US-11131138-B2.twist: Package theft and same-day deliveries from several services keep growing.

US-11131255-B1.name: Sliding-head piston engine
US-11131255-B1.hook: An engine whose cylinder head contains a moving upper piston with ports, replacing valves and allowing variable compression ratio.
US-11131255-B1.twist: Small engines for range extenders and generators still reward simpler, cheaper valvetrains.

US-11131372-B2.name: Planetary universal transmission
US-11131372-B2.hook: A transmission that joins a planetary-gear transfer case with inner and outer outputs to a commutator and an actuator.
US-11131372-B2.twist: Simulation software and printed prototypes make testing gear layouts cheap.

US-11131413-B2.name: Two-stage safety cam lock
US-11131413-B2.hook: A hose cam lock fitting with outer and inner levers, so opening the outer ones only cracks the joint and trapped pressure shows before it fully opens.
US-11131413-B2.twist: Tighter plant safety rules make a fitting that warns of trapped pressure easy to justify.

US-11131426-B1.name: Over-door mannequin mount
US-11131426-B1.hook: A panel that hangs on top of a door with hooks and holds a mannequin, for displaying or staging clothes.
US-11131426-B1.twist: Home resellers photographing clothes for online marketplaces need quick staging setups.

US-11131598-B2.name: Wind tunnel balance guard
US-11131598-B2.hook: Mating features with adjustable clearances between a wind tunnel model and its mounting sting that limit how far the model can move, protecting the force balance.
US-11131598-B2.twist: Actuated clearances could be run by software to cut downtime from damaged balances.

US-11131731-B2.name: Multi-channel MRI transmitter
US-11131731-B2.hook: An integrated system that generates, modulates, amplifies and distributes radio signals separately to each coil of a multi-channel MRI transmit array.
US-11131731-B2.twist: Cheaper software-defined radio parts help research groups build parallel-transmit MRI.

US-11131904-B2.name: Coil-fold LED light panel
US-11131904-B2.hook: A round photo light panel of LEDs between fabric layers on spring rings that coil into small loops for packing.
US-11131904-B2.twist: Creators filming video at home want lights that fold flat into a bag.

US-11131987-B2.name: Cockpit display integrity check
US-11131987-B2.hook: A method that tags each safety-critical item on a display with an ID color, then checks its position, shape, color and visibility to catch misleading graphics output.
US-11131987-B2.twist: Glass cockpits are spreading to cars, drones and air taxis that need certified display checks.

US-11132424-B2.name: Low-power body sensor network
US-11132424-B2.hook: Wearable sensors that each talk only to one central wearable, which processes their data and relays it to a phone and cloud to save power.
US-11132424-B2.twist: Small Bluetooth LE chips and cheap cloud storage make such networks affordable for remote patient monitoring.

US-11132519-B1.name: AR asset tag app
US-11132519-B1.hook: A phone app that lets you point the camera at equipment, tap it to create a virtual tag with location and data, and see tags overlaid later.
US-11132519-B1.twist: Phone AR frameworks now anchor virtual labels to places reliably.

US-11132674-B2.name: Picture-key trust network
US-11132674-B2.hook: A method where several participants each hide an RSA-encrypted secret in their own area of a shared picture, then use it to validate each other.
US-11132674-B2.twist: Small groups wanting private verification without a central authority could use it.

US-11132703-B2.name: Game-style AR product ads
US-11132703-B2.hook: An AR platform that shows a virtual product in an app, streams game-like content about its features, and tracks how users interact.
US-11132703-B2.twist: Phone AR and browser 3D now let brands run such ads without a dedicated app.

US-11134770-B2.name: Strap-loop carrying handle
US-11134770-B2.hook: A handle on a rigid channel that guides a strap into a loop around an object and fastens it, so bulky items can be carried without other gear.
US-11134770-B2.twist: Sells easily as an online accessory for moving furniture, drywall or lumber.

US-11134794-B2.name: Convertible child carrier pack
US-11134794-B2.hook: A backpack with a sling for carrying a child that clips to several points on the pack, plus a seat pad and safety strap.
US-11134794-B2.twist: Parents hiking with toddlers want one pack that carries both gear and child.

US-11135606-B1.name: Leaf blower mister nozzle
US-11135606-B1.hook: A nozzle that fits a leaf blower and uses its air stream to atomize and spray liquids onto surfaces or into spaces.
US-11135606-B1.twist: Battery leaf blowers make a cordless sprayer for disinfecting or garden treatments.

US-11135640-B2.name: Drum bung thread press
US-11135640-B2.hook: A press tool with expanding and contracting collets that forms internal and external threads on a drum bung in one stroke.
US-11135640-B2.twist: Reconditioned and reused drums keep demand for bung fittings steady.

US-11135696-B1.name: Glass keepsake for ashes
US-11135696-B1.hook: A method of grinding a hollow into a glass object with a spinning, diamond-coated metal ball and coolant, to hold cremated remains.
US-11135696-B1.twist: Personalized memorial products sell well online and cremation rates keep climbing.

US-11135738-B2.name: Coffee-ground pellet lubricant
US-11135738-B2.hook: Wood pellets made with 0.5 to 10 percent dried spent coffee grounds, which lubricate the pellet mill instead of other lubricants.
US-11135738-B2.twist: Coffee chains want uses for their waste grounds and pellet stoves stay popular.

US-11135791-B2.name: Vacuum glass crack repair
US-11135791-B2.hook: A tool that creates a vacuum over a crack in glass and applies a sealed restoring fluid in a straight line before air reaches it.
US-11135791-B2.twist: Mobile repair services for windshields and windows can sell repair over replacement.

US-11136168-B2.name: Tamper-evident band package
US-11136168-B2.hook: A container whose lid is held by a visible outer band crimped around both rims, which must be torn off to open the package.
US-11136168-B2.twist: Food delivery apps have raised demand for obvious tamper evidence.

US-11136181-B2.name: Popcorn tub with cupholder tab
US-11136181-B2.hook: A popcorn container with a reinforcing strip, handles, and a tab that tucks into a cup holder to hold the tub beside it.
US-11136181-B2.twist: Theaters and stadiums sell larger snack combos that need somewhere to sit.

US-11136236-B2.name: Pivoting shank horse bit
US-11136236-B2.hook: A horse bit with two pivoting side shanks with purchase and leverage bars, meant to be gentler on the horse's mouth.
US-11136236-B2.twist: Riders increasingly look for welfare-focused tack and buy it online.

US-11136247-B2.name: Zeolite-silver softening gel
US-11136247-B2.hook: A hydrogel of cross-linked polymer holding zeolite and silver nanoparticles, made to reduce water hardness.
US-11136247-B2.twist: Salt-free softening is wanted where brine discharge from softeners is restricted.

US-11136518-B2.name: Light fraction clean gasoline
US-11136518-B2.hook: A method that desulfurizes a light hydrocarbon fraction, then raises its octane with what the patent calls a hormone-modified additive.
US-11136518-B2.twist: Refiners still need low-sulfur blending streams under tightening fuel standards.

US-11136774-B1.name: Open-core pool vacuum
US-11136774-B1.hook: A battery pool cleaner with a sleeve-shaped impeller around an open central passage, so debris flows straight into a filter bag.
US-11136774-B1.twist: Better lithium batteries make cordless handheld pool vacuums practical.

US-11136824-B2.name: Roof edge ladder guard
US-11136824-B2.hook: A flat grate with hand-grip openings that screws to a roof edge and stops a leaning ladder from sliding sideways or falling back.
US-11136824-B2.twist: Roofers and solar installers face stricter fall protection rules.

US-11137192-B2.name: Ice-cooled mat circulator
US-11137192-B2.hook: A simple pump unit that cools water against a frozen refrigerant pack and circulates it through tubing in a mat to cool the person on it.
US-11137192-B2.twist: Hotter summers and sleep-cooling gadgets have created buyers for cheap versions.

US-11139621-B2.name: Locking plug housing
US-11139621-B2.hook: A housing that slips over a cord's plug and holds it firmly in an accessory outlet so it cannot work loose.
US-11139621-B2.twist: Vehicle and boat USB-C and 12V outlets now power more devices that vibrate loose.

US-11140872-B2.name: Modular smart pet collar
US-11140872-B2.hook: A dog collar with a microcontroller base, add-on electronic modules, and an automatic release so it cannot choke the pet.
US-11140872-B2.twist: Cheap BLE and LTE-M modules make swappable tracker and light pods practical.

US-11140886-B1.name: Floating fish livewell
US-11140886-B1.hook: A floating frame with a hinged lid, trapdoor and nesting mesh net that keeps caught fish alive, staked to shore by a cord.
US-11140886-B1.twist: Kayak and bank anglers want light gear that packs flat.

US-11140952-B2.name: Key-and-notch jewelry clasp
US-11140952-B2.hook: A jewelry clasp where a key slides into a notched receiver and a pivoting lock snaps closed over it.
US-11140952-B2.twist: 3D-printed metal and resin let small makers prototype clasps in days.

US-11140958-B1.name: Suitcase with fold-out table
US-11140958-B1.hook: A suitcase with a swivel tray and telescoping legs that turns into a small table, plus a removable battery for charging devices.
US-11140958-B1.twist: Airport gate waits and remote work make a charging laptop stand handy.

US-11140968-B1.name: Wrinkle-lifting eyeglass pads
US-11140968-B1.hook: Eyeglasses with small chambers on the inside of the temples that gently pull and tuck loose facial skin upward.
US-11140968-B1.twist: Consumer beauty gadgets now sell well direct through social video.

US-11141003-B1.name: Backpack baby carrier
US-11141003-B1.hook: A backpack whose straps and buckles also hold a baby on the parent's chest, with the back used for diapers and supplies.
US-11141003-B1.twist: Parents favour one hands-free piece over a carrier plus a diaper bag.

US-11141009-B1.name: Adjustable mini-pillow pillow
US-11141009-B1.hook: A pillow casing filled with many small pillows you add or remove to tune its height and firmness.
US-11141009-B1.twist: Direct-to-consumer sleep brands sell on customisable fit.

US-11141012-B1.name: Pool float cooler
US-11141012-B1.hook: A pool float with a built-in two-compartment ice cooler and a cup hole on top.
US-11141012-B1.twist: Rotomolded and drop-stitch materials make sturdier floats cheap.

US-11141041-B2.name: Bumpy lint roller
US-11141041-B2.hook: A lint roller with a non-round roller, so the helical perforated tape has a wavy or dimpled surface to reach into fabric.
US-11141041-B2.twist: Pet owners buy lint rollers in bulk and want ones that grab more hair.

US-11141188-B2.name: Double-ended safety scalpel
US-11141188-B2.hook: A scalpel with a retractable blade at each end, each sliding out of a protective sleeve only when used.
US-11141188-B2.twist: Hospitals push sharps-injury prevention and single-use safety devices.

US-11141193-B1.name: Guarded episiotomy tool
US-11141193-B1.hook: A duckbill-shaped housing that places a hidden blade between a baby's head and pelvic floor muscle to make a controlled incision during birth.
US-11141193-B1.twist: Interest in reducing severe tearing in childbirth is growing.

US-11141241-B2.name: Vibrating orthodontic headgear
US-11141241-B2.hook: Orthodontic headgear whose bow carries vibration from an attached device directly to the upper molars.
US-11141241-B2.twist: Small vibration motors are cheap and patients want faster orthodontic treatment.

US-11141304-B1.name: Elastic back-assist suit
US-11141304-B1.hook: A wearable with elastic bands and a tension winch that takes load off the lower back when bending or lifting.
US-11141304-B1.twist: Warehouses are buying passive exosuits to cut back injuries.

US-11141307-B2.name: Female urine collector
US-11141307-B2.hook: A non-invasive device with a small balloon anchor and a membrane pouch that covers the urethra to collect urine from women.
US-11141307-B2.twist: External female catheters became standard care to reduce infections.

US-11141337-B2.name: Surgical arm board
US-11141337-B2.hook: A grooved arm support that holds a patient's arm and hand securely while they lie on their back during an operation.
US-11141337-B2.twist: Radial-access procedures need steady arm positioning.

US-11141344-B2.name: Leg-lift joint helper
US-11141344-B2.hook: A bendable three-section frame with leg-lifting mechanisms that helps people with worn knees or hips move their legs.
US-11141344-B2.twist: Ageing populations drive demand for home mobility aids.

US-11141351-B2.name: Bypass suction syringe
US-11141351-B2.hook: A syringe with a separate suction channel that skips the needle, so drawing up medicine is easier.
US-11141351-B2.twist: Viscous biologic drugs make filling through a fine needle slow.

US-11141571-B2.name: Cannula and guidewire set
US-11141571-B2.hook: A safety puncturing system made of a cannula paired with a guidewire.
US-11141571-B2.twist: Ultrasound-guided vascular access is now routine at the bedside.

US-11141575-B2.name: Slotted cream applicator
US-11141575-B2.hook: A medicine applicator with a hollow shaft, slots along its length and a lip, used to apply cream internally.
US-11141575-B2.twist: Telehealth prescriptions shift buyers toward easy self-care tools.

US-11141624-B2.name: Hybrid exercise bike brake
US-11141624-B2.hook: An exercise bike resistance unit with a brake pad and magnets that can be set by a manual knob or by a motor.
US-11141624-B2.twist: App-driven indoor cycling needs motorised resistance with a manual fallback.

US-11141643-B2.name: Moving fencing target
US-11141643-B2.hook: A computer-controlled arm that extends and retracts a target so a fencer can practise hitting it.
US-11141643-B2.twist: Cheap actuators and microcontrollers make reactive training rigs affordable for clubs.

US-11141648-B1.name: Billiard ball ramp trainer
US-11141648-B1.hook: A folding base with ramps that rolls billiard balls into the same spot every time for repeat practice shots.
US-11141648-B1.twist: Pool coaching is booming on video platforms.

US-11141653-B2.name: Game controller finger cushions
US-11141653-B2.hook: Grip cushions that clip onto a game controller and press the buttons through projections, easing strain on the fingers.
US-11141653-B2.twist: Accessibility gaming accessories now have real retail shelf space.

US-11141702-B1.name: Magnetic hollow fiber membrane
US-11141702-B1.hook: A two-layer hollow fiber membrane: one layer separates water from solutes, the other holds magnetic particles that pull magnetic draw solutes close.
US-11141702-B1.twist: Forward osmosis research is looking for recoverable draw solutes.

US-11141806-B2.name: Auto nut tapping machine
US-11141806-B2.hook: A machine that clamps a nut and feeds it one thread pitch for every turn of a motor-driven tap.
US-11141806-B2.twist: Small shops automate repetitive steps with cheap steppers and controllers.

US-11141833-B1.name: Excavator sandblasting head
US-11141833-B1.hook: A rotating blast nozzle on an excavator boom, driven by the excavator's hydraulics, that aims abrasive media at large surfaces.
US-11141833-B1.twist: Bridge and tank repainting faces labour shortages and safety pressure.

US-11141836-B2.name: Rolled flap sandpaper
US-11141836-B2.hook: A method of cutting, perforating, winding and gluing sandpaper into a roll for grinding industrial parts.
US-11141836-B2.twist: Robotic finishing cells need consistent consumable abrasives.

US-11141867-B2.name: Modular knuckle robot hand
US-11141867-B2.hook: A robot hand built from many identical knuckle pieces, with each finger flexed by its own actuator to grip objects.
US-11141867-B2.twist: Humanoid robot makers need cheap repeatable hands.

US-11142018-B2.name: Multi-angle carpenter square
US-11142018-B2.hook: An L-shaped square with framing marks on all sides, cutting templates and adjustable arms for rafters, stairs and plumb lines.
US-11142018-B2.twist: Laser-cut aluminium makes short runs of precise tools affordable.

US-11142164-B2.name: Starter interrupt override
US-11142164-B2.hook: A vehicle immobilizer for loan repayment with a wireless interface and a way to send an emergency override if that interface is lost.
US-11142164-B2.twist: Buy-here-pay-here lenders use connected starter interrupt devices widely.

US-11142259-B2.name: Breakaway mud flap hanger
US-11142259-B2.hook: A mud flap that hangs through a slotted bracket and pulls free when struck instead of tearing.
US-11142259-B2.twist: Fleet operators look for parts that cut roadside repairs.

US-11142277-B2.name: Folding cargo sidecar
US-11142277-B2.hook: A detachable motorcycle sidecar whose base, side and rear plates fold up or out to carry different loads.
US-11142277-B2.twist: Delivery riders in dense cities want more cargo on two-wheelers.

US-11142289-B1.name: Boat seat umbrella mount
US-11142289-B1.hook: A flat plate that fits between a boat seat and its pedestal, with a tube for holding an umbrella post.
US-11142289-B1.twist: Fishing boat owners spend heavily on bolt-on accessories.

US-11142430-B2.name: Attic storage lift
US-11142430-B2.hook: A motorised platform that rises through the attic floor opening to carry boxes up and down, with a closing panel underneath.
US-11142430-B2.twist: Homeowners using attics for storage want to avoid ladder falls.

US-11142450-B2.name: Magnetic safety stirrup
US-11142450-B2.hook: A riding stirrup whose one side branch swings open and is held shut by a magnet, so a foot can come free in a fall.
US-11142450-B2.twist: Strong neodymium magnets make reliable breakaway latches cheap.

US-11142627-B2.name: Tissue culture barrier gel
US-11142627-B2.hook: A coating of polyvinyl acetate, glycerin, polyglycerol acrylate and diluted hyaluronic acid used as an insulation layer in plant tissue culture.
US-11142627-B2.twist: Vertical farms and plant labs scale up micropropagation.

US-11142695-B2.name: Triazine antioxidants
US-11142695-B2.hook: A family of trisubstituted triazine compounds used as antioxidants.
US-11142695-B2.twist: Formulators look for new stabilisers as older antioxidants face regulation.

US-11142866-B2.name: Triangle quilt block template
US-11142866-B2.hook: Two cutting templates, a trapezoid and a triangle, used to cut four pieces that sew into a triangle quilt block.
US-11142866-B2.twist: Quilters buy acrylic templates online and laser cutting makes them cheap.

US-11142913-B2.name: Fold-out balcony railing
US-11142913-B2.hook: A wall-mounted balustrade that is actuated outward to unfold a balcony platform with the railing around it.
US-11142913-B2.twist: Small city apartments look for extra outdoor space without permanent balconies.

US-10039267-B1.name: Animal health tracking tag
US-10039267-B1.hook: A tag worn by an animal that reads its vital signs and location and alerts the owner when a server spots a problem.
US-10039267-B1.twist: Cheap LoRa radios and GPS chips make herd-wide tagging affordable for small farms.

US-10039270-B2.name: Two-boat carp harvester
US-10039270-B2.hook: A net rig strung between two boats with a motorized lift, bait basket and optical sensors that show how many fish are caught.
US-10039270-B2.twist: States now pay bounties to remove invasive Asian carp from rivers.

US-10039317-B1.name: Threadless hookah stem
US-10039317-B1.hook: A hookah stem that seals by twisting into place without screw threads, so parts are easier to manufacture.
US-10039317-B1.twist: Desktop 3D printing and small-batch casting suit unthreaded twist-seal joints.

US-10039359-B2.name: Floating locator suitcase
US-10039359-B2.hook: A travel case with a built-in inflatable float and a locator beacon that can signal rescuers with its position.
US-10039359-B2.twist: Satellite messaging chips now fit inside consumer luggage trackers.

US-10039371-B2.name: Paint brush flush cleaner
US-10039371-B2.hook: Cleans brushes and rollers with a fluid that pushes on the paint, breaks it apart and carries it out of the bristles.
US-10039371-B2.twist: Water-based paint rules push painters toward cleaning methods that use less solvent.

US-10039379-B1.name: Fold-flat lumber rack
US-10039379-B1.hook: A storage rack with swing-out arms that stands on its own or folds into a single post that hangs on a wall bracket.
US-10039379-B1.twist: Garage workshops and small apartments want storage that packs away when not in use.

US-10039393-B1.name: Photo pocket calendar frame
US-10039393-B1.hook: A standing frame around a calendar with clear photo pockets and removable strips you can write notes on.
US-10039393-B1.twist: Print-on-demand services make personalized family calendars cheap to sell.

US-10039395-B2.name: Framed nursing cushion
US-10039395-B2.hook: A cushion with rigid inner frames that holds mother and baby in a steady position during feeding.
US-10039395-B2.twist: Direct-to-parent brands sell baby gear online with low startup costs.

US-10039399-B2.name: Sauce-dispensing fork
US-10039399-B2.hook: A fork with channels inside it that release liquid from a small container in the handle to the tines as you eat.
US-10039399-B2.twist: Food-safe resin printing lets small makers prototype internal channels cheaply.

US-10039402-B1.name: Artificial tree display insert
US-10039402-B1.hook: A C-shaped insert that spreads apart the trunk sections of an artificial tree to hold a display panel and branches.
US-10039402-B1.twist: Retailers and streamers want themed holiday trees that show off products or screens.

US-10039415-B2.name: Dual-element baking mould
US-10039415-B2.hook: A baking mould with two heating elements that a controller powers at different levels for more even or targeted baking.
US-10039415-B2.twist: Cheap microcontrollers make per-zone heat control easy in countertop appliances.

US-10039420-B2.name: Fold-away sink colander
US-10039420-B2.hook: A colander that hangs on the sink wall and folds flat on hinges when you are not straining food.
US-10039420-B2.twist: Small-kitchen gadgets sell well on marketplaces like Amazon and TikTok Shop.

US-10039486-B1.name: Stress recovery heart trainer
US-10039486-B1.hook: Shows the user stressful video, tracks their heartbeat to measure how far and how long the nervous system is thrown off, then guides recovery.
US-10039486-B1.twist: Smartwatches already record heart rate variability that this method relies on.

US-10039999-B2.name: Zeolite ethanol separator
US-10039999-B2.hook: Pulls ethanol out of an ethanol-water mix using zeolites that grab ethanol in preference to water.
US-10039999-B2.twist: Distilleries and biofuel plants want lower-energy alternatives to distillation.

US-10040039-B2.name: Baffled static mixer
US-10040039-B2.hook: A mixer that blends two materials by routing them through alternating curved guide plates between two walls.
US-10040039-B2.twist: Metal 3D printing makes complex internal baffles cheap in small runs.

US-10040074-B2.name: Self-tuning flotation valve
US-10040074-B2.hook: A flotation tank whose valve adjusts automatically based on a measurement of the size of the gas bubbles it produces.
US-10040074-B2.twist: Low-cost cameras and image analysis can now measure bubble sizes inline.

US-10040189-B2.name: Magnetic tool holder board
US-10040189-B2.hook: A board with clamps for hand tools and magnetic bases on each side so it sticks to a metal surface.
US-10040189-B2.twist: Tool brands and makers sell custom organizers to tradespeople online.

US-10040190-B2.name: Glovebox ball-joint manipulator
US-10040190-B2.hook: A manipulator arm mounted through a sealed ball joint so it can move objects inside a gas-tight chamber.
US-10040190-B2.twist: Battery and semiconductor startups buy many small inert-gas gloveboxes.

US-10040402-B1.name: Lift-assist roof bike rack
US-10040402-B1.hook: A roof rack with a gas-spring boom that swings down, clamps a bike and lifts it upright onto the car roof.
US-10040402-B1.twist: Heavier e-bikes make lifting onto a roof harder for riders.

US-10040410-B2.name: Smart starter battery monitor
US-10040410-B2.hook: A module that measures a car battery's voltage, current and temperature at rest and while driving and reports its health.
US-10040410-B2.twist: Bluetooth chips let a phone app show battery health for any car.

US-10040470-B1.name: Folding wagon with canopy
US-10040470-B1.hook: A folding wagon with a sun canopy on telescoping rods that adjusts in height and detaches.
US-10040470-B1.twist: Beach and sports-family wagons are a busy online category.

US-10040500-B2.name: Pivot-frame adjustable bike
US-10040500-B2.hook: A bike whose frame halves pivot at a lockable joint, along with a separate seat post, so it fits riders of very different heights.
US-10040500-B2.twist: Shared bike fleets and growing kids need one frame that fits many riders.

US-10040517-B2.name: Self-locking gimbal
US-10040517-B2.hook: A gimbal that locks automatically when something pushes on the mounted object and frees itself once the force is gone.
US-10040517-B2.twist: Camera rigs and ship-mounted sensors need mounts that resist bumps.

US-10040523-B2.name: Anti-sinking air bag
US-10040523-B2.hook: A compressed air tank that fills an air pocket in a flooding cabin to give a ship extra buoyancy.
US-10040523-B2.twist: Small boat owners and ferries face tighter safety rules.

US-10040531-B1.name: Ultracapacitor boat brake
US-10040531-B1.hook: A brake pedal for a boat that dumps a burst of stored ultracapacitor power into the motors to spin the propellers in reverse.
US-10040531-B1.twist: Electric boats already carry the motors and power electronics this needs.

US-10040554-B1.name: Drone detection and takedown
US-10040554-B1.hook: Uses radio plus sound or optical sensor arrays to locate a drone, aim a camera at it and fire a short-range projectile.
US-10040554-B1.twist: Stadiums, prisons and airports face rising drone incursions.

US-10040600-B1.name: Convertible pallet kit
US-10040600-B1.hook: A shipping pallet with a built-in compartment holding the parts to take it apart and rebuild it as other items, including sports gear.
US-10040600-B1.twist: Brands want packaging that customers reuse instead of throwing away.

US-10040612-B2.name: Stacking shelf dividers
US-10040612-B2.hook: Flat dividers placed between folded clothes or papers, with raised bumps that lock into the divider above to keep stacks neat.
US-10040612-B2.twist: Closet organization content drives sales of small storage products.

US-10041109-B2.name: Toehold switch DNA test
US-10041109-B2.hook: Detects a target genetic sequence by pairing a DNA strand-displacement part with an RNA toehold switch that never touch directly.
US-10041109-B2.twist: Paper-based cell-free diagnostics have become cheap enough for field testing.

US-10041208-B1.name: Foil-coated thread textile
US-10041208-B1.hook: Makes shimmering multicolor fabric panels by bonding foil to thread wound on a board, then unwinding so the foil breaks into pieces.
US-10041208-B1.twist: Small fashion and decor makers sell textured textiles online.

US-10041219-B2.name: Hand-strap waste scrapers
US-10041219-B2.hook: A pair of strapped hand scrapers that push waste into a bag, with a sensor that alerts the user to hazardous material.
US-10041219-B2.twist: Pet owners and cleaning crews buy hands-free cleanup tools.

US-10041249-B1.name: Adjustable partition wall
US-10041249-B1.hook: Room dividers with sliding upper panels for height and hinged joints for angles, plus filler panels for odd widths.
US-10041249-B1.twist: Offices and schools keep reconfiguring space for hybrid use.

US-10041273-B2.name: Flip-out door limiter
US-10041273-B2.hook: A replacement strike plate with a flip-out arm that catches the door knob so a door can open only partway.
US-10041273-B2.twist: Renters want security add-ons that need no drilling into the door.

US-10041317-B1.name: Vortex drilling circulator
US-10041317-B1.hook: A spinning sleeve on a drill string whose angled ports create a fluid vortex that lifts debris up the well.
US-10041317-B1.twist: Geothermal drilling is expanding with coiled tubing methods.

US-10041439-B2.name: Cylindrical-pulse ignition chamber
US-10041439-B2.hook: An engine combustion chamber where a depression in the piston or head redirects a cylindrical ignition pulse along the chamber.
US-10041439-B2.twist: Hydrogen and lean-burn engines need stronger, more even ignition.

US-10041446-B2.name: Tamper-proof carburetor needle
US-10041446-B2.hook: A carburetor idle needle with an eccentric fitting that only a matching special tool can turn, keeping emissions settings fixed.
US-10041446-B2.twist: Small-engine emissions rules require settings users cannot easily change.

US-10041468-B2.name: Low-head river turbine
US-10041468-B2.hook: A water turbine for rivers with little drop, with guide walls and a sliding cylindrical gate that sets how much water reaches it.
US-10041468-B2.twist: Small hydro on irrigation canals now qualifies for clean energy incentives.

US-10041478-B2.name: Swing-blade vertical windmill
US-10041478-B2.hook: A vertical-axis windmill whose hinged airfoils swing open on one side of the turn and close against the frame on the other.
US-10041478-B2.twist: Rooftop and off-grid buyers look for small turbines that handle shifting wind.

US-10041630-B1.name: Test-port pipe coupling
US-10041630-B1.hook: A pipe coupling with a plugged side opening for inserting an inflatable test balloon, then sealing up for normal use.
US-10041630-B1.twist: Plumbing inspections require pressure tests on new drain lines.

US-10041853-B2.name: Tubing collar leak tester
US-10041853-B2.hook: Tests threaded joints of oil well tubing by pressurizing them with tracer gas and water, then sniffing outside the collar for escaping gas.
US-10041853-B2.twist: Cheap helium and hydrogen sensors make portable field rigs practical for smaller operators.

US-10043089-B2.name: Hand and face size ID
US-10043089-B2.hook: Identifies a person from photos of their hand or face by measuring real-world dimensions of features in the image.
US-10043089-B2.twist: Every phone now has depth sensing that can measure true scale without a reference object.

US-10043165-B2.name: Cloud account checkout
US-10043165-B2.hook: Lets users buy certificate services by logging in with a cloud account and paying through that cloud platform's payment flow.
US-10043165-B2.twist: Single sign-on plus wallet billing is now standard; useful as prior art for marketplace payments.

US-10043200-B2.name: Friends who bought this
US-10043200-B2.hook: When you browse a product, shows which people in your contacts have also bought or used it.
US-10043200-B2.twist: Contact-graph APIs and small shops' customer lists make social proof easy to add to any store.

US-10043380-B2.name: Multi-protocol sensor fob
US-10043380-B2.hook: A small hub that plugs into monitoring and control devices speaking different protocols, tags their data by source, and forwards it to a computer.
US-10043380-B2.twist: Cheap ESP32 boards handle several radios at once, making a DIY version a weekend job.

US-10043495-B1.name: Jeweled pick holder
US-10043495-B1.hook: A decorative accessory for a guitar that holds several picks of different sizes so they are always within reach.
US-10043495-B1.twist: Resin printing and small-batch jewelry shops make custom versions easy to sell online.

US-10044249-B2.name: Stacked twin-rotor motor
US-10044249-B2.hook: An electric motor that alternates two stators and two rotors along one shaft to pack more torque into the same diameter.
US-10044249-B2.twist: Axial-flux motors for e-bikes and drones are a fast-growing market looking for compact layouts.

US-10044684-B2.name: Public-key card check
US-10044684-B2.hook: A server that verifies a smart card by using the card's ID as a public key and checking it can decrypt a challenge.
US-10044684-B2.twist: NFC phones can now act as both reader and card, making this flow possible without dedicated hardware.

US-10044817-B2.name: Coverage-aware car apps
US-10044817-B2.hook: Predicts where a car will lose signal on a trip and decides which apps and downloads to prioritize before the gaps.
US-10044817-B2.twist: Crowdsourced coverage maps are free now, so any navigation app could prefetch around dead zones.

US-11142943-B2.name: Filtered window frame vent
US-11142943-B2.hook: A window frame with an internal channel and filter layers that lets fresh air pass while the window stays shut.
US-11142943-B2.twist: Indoor air quality and wildfire smoke have created demand for passive filtered ventilation.

US-11142967-B2.name: Internal-break pipe wrench
US-11142967-B2.hook: An adjustable wrench with swappable dies that limit jaw opening, plus a jointed handle for breaking stuck internal connections.
US-11142967-B2.twist: Small toolmakers can now prototype custom jaws with CNC services in days.

US-11143001-B2.name: Layered well screen pack
US-11143001-B2.hook: Supports a water well's borehole wall with alternating sand and seal layers so water flows in without migrating up the gravel pack.
US-11143001-B2.twist: Groundwater monitoring and geothermal wells are growing and need cleaner sampling zones.

US-11143095-B2.name: Split-timing turbo intake
US-11143095-B2.hook: An engine that takes in natural air first, then adds boosted air through a separate passage after the piston bottoms out.
US-11143095-B2.twist: Hybrid range extenders still need efficient small engines, and simulation tools make testing cheap.

US-11143148-B2.name: Ribbed air diffuser grid
US-11143148-B2.hook: A grid of angled ribs and shaped diffusers that breaks up and redirects air passing through it.
US-11143148-B2.twist: 3D printing makes it easy to test intake grid shapes on small engines and fans.

US-11143225-B2.name: Hidden panel latch
US-11143225-B2.hook: A concealed connector that joins furniture or wall panels with a sliding latch, so fasteners stay out of sight.
US-11143225-B2.twist: Flat-pack furniture brands want tool-free joints that print or mold cheaply.

US-11143346-B2.name: Sealant pump check valve
US-11143346-B2.hook: A spring check valve in the hose of a portable tire compressor with a sealant can, so sealant and air flow one way into the tire.
US-11143346-B2.twist: Spare-free cars ship with sealant kits; a better valve is an easy upgrade sale.

US-11143366-B1.name: LED strip ring lamp
US-11143366-B1.hook: Turns a flexible LED strip into an even ring light by weaving it over bumps and grooves on a round base.
US-11143366-B1.twist: Ring lights for video calls and streaming sell in huge numbers; this cuts the parts count.

US-11143369-B2.name: Hidden cove LED rail
US-11143369-B2.hook: A reflective rail for walls or ceilings that hides a string of individually controllable LEDs and bounces their light indirectly.
US-11143369-B2.twist: Addressable LED strips and smart-home control are now cheap enough for any room.

US-11143397-B2.name: Submerged combustion heater
US-11143397-B2.hook: Burns fuel in an open-bottom chamber sitting in water so the hot exhaust bubbles straight into the water, with no heat-exchanger surface.
US-11143397-B2.twist: Industrial heat users want higher efficiency and condensing exhaust capture to cut emissions.

US-11143408-B2.name: Portable warm-air stove
US-11143408-B2.hook: A camping wood stove with a baffle that splits incoming air so part preheats and feeds the fire from below, giving cleaner burning and warm air.
US-11143408-B2.twist: Hot-tent camping has grown fast and buyers compare stoves on clean burn.

US-11143409-B1.name: Flip-over campfire rack
US-11143409-B1.hook: A fire rack with a basin on each side; flip it over to fit small kindling or big logs.
US-11143409-B1.twist: Backyard fire pits are popular and a simple welded rack sells well direct to consumers.

US-11143551-B2.name: IR ink proximity sensor
US-11143551-B2.hook: A proximity sensor that fills the gap between its light emitter and detector with infrared ink to block stray light.
US-11143551-B2.twist: Every earbud and phone uses proximity sensors; cheaper crosstalk blocking matters at that volume.

US-11143556-B1.name: Rotating crystal spectrometer
US-11143556-B1.hook: A compact Fourier transform spectrometer that scans by rotating a birefringent crystal plate instead of moving a mirror.
US-11143556-B1.twist: Low-cost spectrometers for food, farm, and plastic sorting are a growing market.

US-11143668-B2.name: Dual-syringe GC autosampler
US-11143668-B2.hook: A gas chromatography sampler that moves a holder with two syringes and presses both plungers at once to take or inject samples.
US-11143668-B2.twist: Open-source lab automation makes custom autosamplers a realistic project for small labs.

US-11144787-B2.name: Segmentation object locator
US-11144787-B2.hook: Finds objects in images by training a fully convolutional network on labeled photos from the actual working scene.
US-11144787-B2.twist: Pretrained segmentation models now let you fine-tune this on a laptop with a few hundred images.

US-11144940-B2.name: Expert-guided forest models
US-11144940-B2.hook: Builds random forest prediction models about a product with screens that let a domain expert add their own knowledge.
US-11144940-B2.twist: Low-code ML tools are adding human-in-the-loop features; this is a clear template.

US-11145178-B1.name: Left-behind passenger alarm
US-11145178-B1.hook: Sounds and flashes alarms if a passenger, like a child, is still in the car after the driver gets out.
US-11145178-B1.twist: New US rules push rear-seat reminders; cheap radar sensors make aftermarket kits easy.

US-11145229-B1.name: Swappable color light sign
US-11145229-B1.hook: A lit sign with a slot behind the front panel for a colored insert that changes the glow color.
US-11145229-B1.twist: Small shops sell custom LED signs online; swappable colors add a cheap variant option.

US-11146019-B1.name: Sliding outlet rail
US-11146019-B1.hook: A wall-mounted rail with built-in contacts where plug-in outlet units slide along and twist to lock wherever you need power.
US-11146019-B1.twist: Workbenches and kitchens with many gadgets need flexible outlet placement.

US-11146047-B2.name: Cable tray pulling trolley
US-11146047-B2.hook: A wheeled trolley that rides along a cable tray's edges and pulls a cable behind it, by hand line or remote motor.
US-11146047-B2.twist: Data center build-outs need miles of cable laid fast with fewer workers.

US-11146759-B1.name: Motion-triggered car camera
US-11146759-B1.hook: Cameras built into a car that wake when a motion sensor detects someone approaching, recording anyone who damages it.
US-11146759-B1.twist: Cheap camera modules and phone alerts make an aftermarket version simple.

US-11147210-B2.name: String trimmer edging wheel
US-11147210-B2.hook: A clip-on roller for a string trimmer that holds the cutting head vertical so it edges lawns cleanly along a straight line.
US-11147210-B2.twist: Battery trimmers dominate now, and a light snap-on accessory suits them well.

US-11147218-B2.name: Rodent-proof bulb tube
US-11147218-B2.hook: A tough tapered tube with a top cage that you push into the ground around a flower bulb so rodents cannot eat it.
US-11147218-B2.twist: Home gardening boomed and 3D printed or molded garden aids sell well online.

US-11147247-B2.name: Electric fish delouser
US-11147247-B2.hook: Passes farmed fish through a chute with electrodes and water sprays that knock off parasites like sea lice without harming the fish.
US-11147247-B2.twist: Salmon farms spend heavily on sea lice and want alternatives to chemicals.

US-11147251-B1.name: Autonomous fishing drone
US-11147251-B1.hook: An air and underwater drone that sets ropeless fishing gear, sorts the catch with AI, and brings it back.
US-11147251-B1.twist: Ropeless gear is being required to protect whales, and small underwater drones are now affordable.

US-11147253-B2.name: Motorized camera fishing reel
US-11147253-B2.hook: A fishing reel with a motor that reels in automatically and a built-in video camera to record the catch.
US-11147253-B2.twist: Action-camera parts are cheap and fishing content is big on social video.

US-11147265-B2.name: Magnetic tail-flap decoy
US-11147265-B2.hook: A duck decoy whose tail wags from a magnet and coil pulsed at the spring's natural frequency, using little power.
US-11147265-B2.twist: Tiny microcontrollers and lithium cells can run this for a whole season.

US-11147270-B2.name: Slow-release formic pesticide
US-11147270-B2.hook: A pesticide that keeps formic acid at an effective level by generating it over time from calcium formate with citric acid.
US-11147270-B2.twist: Beekeepers use formic acid against varroa mites and want steadier dosing.

US-11147287-B2.name: Multi-chamber drink pod
US-11147287-B2.hook: A dissolvable pod with separate compartments for concentrate, sweetener, creamer, and flavor that all release when dropped in water.
US-11147287-B2.twist: Edible films are improving and plastic-free single servings appeal to buyers.

US-11147317-B2.name: Pocket incontinence brief
US-11147317-B2.hook: Underwear with a waterproof front pocket that holds a shaped absorbent insert you can swap out.
US-11147317-B2.twist: Reusable incontinence wear is a growing market as populations age.

US-11147329-B2.name: Swap-bill hat
US-11147329-B2.hook: A cap whose bill slides onto the crown on rails, so one crown can take different bills.
US-11147329-B2.twist: Print-on-demand and 3D printing make short runs of custom bills cheap.

US-11147334-B2.name: Rotation-damping helmet liner
US-11147334-B2.hook: A liner of compressible pads on a flexible base that lets the head shift inside a helmet and absorbs blows from many directions.
US-11147334-B2.twist: Concussion awareness has made rotational-impact protection a selling point in youth sports.

US-11147361-B2.name: Modular carrying straps
US-11147361-B2.hook: A set of straps with a handle that slides along them, plus add-ons, for one or more people to lift and carry bulky objects.
US-11147361-B2.twist: Home-delivery of furniture means more people moving heavy boxes without help.

US-11147373-B1.name: Bedside intimacy cabinet
US-11147373-B1.hook: A rolling cabinet with drawers, lubricant dispensers and speakers for storing adult products by the bed.
US-11147373-B1.twist: Direct-to-consumer wellness brands sell furniture alongside their products.

US-11147380-B2.name: Adjustable posture stool
US-11147380-B2.hook: A stool with an adjustable footrest, back support and lumbar pad on one central post.
US-11147380-B2.twist: Standing desks created demand for tall seats that still support the back.

US-11147387-B2.name: Swing-out under-bed shelf
US-11147387-B2.hook: A round platform under the bed that rotates out to show what is stored on it, then tucks flush with the frame.
US-11147387-B2.twist: Small apartments and flat-pack furniture make clever bed storage an easy sell.

US-11147401-B2.name: Stash-inside travel pillow
US-11147401-B2.hook: A neck pillow that collapses into a tube holding your belongings and extends to wrap around the neck.
US-11147401-B2.twist: Airline fees for carry-ons push travelers to pack into anything they can wear.

US-11147404-B1.name: Over-door garment boxes
US-11147404-B1.hook: Stackable boxes that hang on a door, with troughs for pulling out clothes and hooks for hats.
US-11147404-B1.twist: Dorm and rental living favor storage that needs no drilling.

US-11147416-B2.name: Kit counter frame
US-11147416-B2.hook: A box frame of end, front and rear panels with adjustable legs for building a free-standing counter or island.
US-11147416-B2.twist: Outdoor kitchens and DIY islands are popular home projects.

US-11147417-B2.name: Assisted kamado lid hinge
US-11147417-B2.hook: A hinge with a telescoping ram that helps lift and lower the heavy ceramic lid of a kamado grill.
US-11147417-B2.twist: Kamado grills have gone mainstream, and owners buy upgrade hinges.

US-11147493-B2.name: ECG heart-disease screen
US-11147493-B2.hook: A software method that cleans a resting ECG with wavelet filters and analyzes the ST segment to flag coronary artery disease.
US-11147493-B2.twist: Cheap wearable ECG patches could run this kind of screen outside the clinic.

US-11147704-B2.name: Neck and upper-back stretcher
US-11147704-B2.hook: A device with a fixing structure that holds the body while chest, abdominal and back muscles relax to help correct posture.
US-11147704-B2.twist: Phone-neck complaints have grown a large home-posture-gadget market.

US-11147712-B2.name: Light-emitting eye shield
US-11147712-B2.hook: An eye shield with built-in lights that flash into the eye to produce visual evoked potentials for testing the visual pathway.
US-11147712-B2.twist: Bright, tiny LEDs and coin batteries make a disposable version practical.

US-11147933-B2.name: Magnetic-cap e-cigarette
US-11147933-B2.hook: An e-cigarette whose atomizer and battery parts are held together with magnets and a buckle.
US-11147933-B2.twist: Refillable devices are regaining interest as some regions restrict disposables.

US-11147943-B1.name: Car seat nightlight
US-11147943-B1.hook: A dim magnetic light that attaches to a child's car seat to soothe the child without spoiling the driver's night vision.
US-11147943-B1.twist: Cheap warm LEDs and USB-C charging make this a simple accessory.

US-11148029-B1.name: Swim leg band trainer
US-11148029-B1.hook: A band that holds a swimmer's legs in position and limits knee bend to train a better kick.
US-11148029-B1.twist: Online swim coaching sells simple drill tools to adult beginners.

US-11148216-B1.name: Table saw depth gauge
US-11148216-B1.hook: A handheld holder with a sliding scale that sits in the throat plate to measure how deep the saw blade will cut.
US-11148216-B1.twist: Maker and woodworking video audiences buy small shop jigs.

US-11148267-B2.name: Geared coil spring tensioner
US-11148267-B2.hook: A gear drive that winds the free end of a coil spring on a shaft to set its tension and then holds it.
US-11148267-B2.twist: Garage door and roller-door installers want safer tensioning than winding bars.

US-11148463-B2.name: Paint lid keeper
US-11148463-B2.hook: A hinged case that seals over a paint can lid and sticks magnetically to the can so the lid stays clean and nearby.
US-11148463-B2.twist: Cheap injection molding and DIY painting boom make small helper products viable.

US-11148587-B2.name: Tilt-switch hazard light
US-11148587-B2.hook: A light that mounts on a car and turns on by tilting, warning other drivers without wiring into the car.
US-11148587-B2.twist: Rechargeable LED beacons are cheap enough to keep in every glovebox.

US-11148598-B1.name: Sliding truck bed extension
US-11148598-B1.hook: A box extension on rails that slides out of a pickup bed to add length and back in when not needed.
US-11148598-B1.twist: Short-bed crew-cab trucks are now the norm and owners want extra length.

US-11148699-B1.name: Stroller canopy screen mount
US-11148699-B1.hook: A pocket or mount inside a stroller canopy that holds a phone or tablet where the child can see it.
US-11148699-B1.twist: Every parent already owns the screen; the mount is the whole product.

US-11148744-B2.name: Bike cable lube cup
US-11148744-B2.hook: A reusable cup with a slot and cinch flap that seals around a bicycle cable housing so lubricant can be pushed through.
US-11148744-B2.twist: Home bike maintenance grew sharply with the cycling boom.

US-11148745-B1.name: Hydraulic track motorcycle
US-11148745-B1.hook: A motorcycle running on front and rear endless tracks driven by hydraulic motors fed from an engine-driven pump.
US-11148745-B1.twist: Snow and swamp recreation riders pay for unusual all-terrain machines.

US-11148757-B2.name: Take-apart fiberglass paddleboard
US-11148757-B2.hook: A board made of fiberglass plates joined by T-shaped slots and connectors, so it can be taken apart for transport.
US-11148757-B2.twist: Apartment dwellers want boards that fit in a car trunk.

US-11148763-B2.name: Quick-release hydrofoil mount
US-11148763-B2.hook: A coupling that lets a lifting foil under a floating board pivot and detach, then lock in place for riding.
US-11148763-B2.twist: Foil boarding and e-foils have become a fast-growing water sport.

US-11148765-B2.name: Two-piece swim float platform
US-11148765-B2.hook: An inflatable lounge with a mesh-bottomed recess for sitting in filtered water, plus a smaller float that fills the recess.
US-11148765-B2.twist: Lake and boat owners buy large inflatable lounge pads.

US-11148791-B2.name: Hybrid three-rotor helicopter
US-11148791-B2.hook: A helicopter with a gas generator charging batteries that run two electric lift propellers and a nose propeller.
US-11148791-B2.twist: Electric aviation startups are testing hybrid powertrains for quieter flight.

US-11148795-B1.name: Downwash lift disc
US-11148795-B1.hook: A disc of twisted radial airfoils placed under a drone or helicopter rotor to gain extra lift from its downwash.
US-11148795-B1.twist: Cheap 3D printing and hobby drones make testing airfoil shapes easy.

US-11148800-B2.name: Tilt-rotor VTOL plane
US-11148800-B2.hook: A fixed-wing aircraft with two front and one rear propeller that tilt between vertical lift and forward flight.
US-11148800-B2.twist: Flight controllers like ArduPilot already support tilt-rotor drones.

US-11148869-B2.name: Stackable rainproof tote
US-11148869-B2.hook: A tote box with a domed two-piece lid and drain channels so water runs off and boxes still stack.
US-11148869-B2.twist: Outdoor storage for packages and farm stands needs cheap weatherproof bins.

US-11148965-B2.name: Plant-and-critter water cleaner
US-11148965-B2.hook: Wastewater passes through tanks where small animals and bacteria break down waste, then through plant roots that take up nutrients.
US-11148965-B2.twist: Fertilizer prices and water reuse rules make nutrient recovery valuable.

US-11149394-B2.name: Leaky pond sealer mix
US-11149394-B2.hook: A treatment of bentonite clay, absorbent polymer, cellulose gum and flocculant spread on a pond bed to stop water loss.
US-11149394-B2.twist: Drought-hit farms and ranches need to keep stock ponds full.

US-11149634-B2.name: Split-syngas power plant
US-11149634-B2.hook: A process that splits syngas into a carbon monoxide stream for an oxyfuel CO2 turbine and a hydrogen stream for a gas turbine.
US-11149634-B2.twist: Carbon capture credits reward plants that produce pure CO2 streams.

US-11149876-B2.name: Sled-carried pipeline on slopes
US-11149876-B2.hook: A method of laying pipe down steep slopes by pushing the joined pipe on connected sleds that keep it off the trench bottom.
US-11149876-B2.twist: New hydrogen and CO2 pipelines will cross rough terrain.

US-11149898-B1.name: Taxidermy head stand
US-11149898-B1.hook: A portable base with a yoke and adjustable rods that holds a game animal's head in position for taxidermy.
US-11149898-B1.twist: Hunting content creators sell gear for home trophy work.

US-11149904-B1.name: Post-top cup holder
US-11149904-B1.hook: Two cut-out plates on a tube that slips over a post to hold a drink or container.
US-11149904-B1.twist: Pickleball courts and fence-line hangouts need somewhere to set a drink.

US-11149915-B2.name: Self-leveling lamp shade
US-11149915-B2.hook: A bearing and sliding weight on the shade's spoke let a crooked lamp shade be leveled.
US-11149915-B2.twist: Vintage lamp restorers sell cheap fix-it parts online.

US-11149961-B1.name: Rolling range hood
US-11149961-B1.hook: A range hood on a wheeled frame with fan, filter and lights that can stand anywhere, with or without a duct.
US-11149961-B1.twist: Induction hot plates and indoor grills leave many rental kitchens without ventilation.

US-11150040-B1.name: Sealed heat channel
US-11150040-B1.hook: A long top plate with two side plates and seals between them, forming a channel that carries heat along its length.
US-11150040-B1.twist: Cheap thermal cameras and sensors make simple heat-routing hardware easy to test at home.

US-11150372-B2.name: Velocity-free seismic imaging
US-11150372-B2.hook: A seismic processing workflow that builds a zero-offset image of complex rock layers without first fixing a velocity model.
US-11150372-B2.twist: Cloud GPUs let small teams run migration and demigration cubes once limited to big oil companies.

US-11151153-B2.name: Data-to-object generator
US-11151153-B2.hook: Software that converts input data into a digital object format, manipulates its data points, and outputs instructions for making the object.
US-11151153-B2.twist: Fits today's text-to-CAD and 3D printing pipelines that turn data into printable parts.

US-11151187-B2.name: Emoji mood recommender
US-11151187-B2.hook: A recommendation app where you pick an emoji for the mood you want and it suggests music, video, reading or activities.
US-11151187-B2.twist: Streaming APIs and small language models make mood-matched playlists a weekend project.

US-11151852-B2.name: Gunshot sound detector
US-11151852-B2.hook: A detector that reports unusually loud audio and compares it with stored gunshot signatures to flag possible gunfire.
US-11151852-B2.twist: Cheap microphones and on-device audio classifiers can run this on a low-cost board.

US-11151869-B2.name: Token-based intersection booking
US-11151869-B2.hook: A roadside device lets connected vehicles reserve an intersection using time-token balances, then sets the traffic light for them.
US-11151869-B2.twist: Vehicle-to-infrastructure radios are now being deployed, giving this scheme real hardware to run on.

US-11152146-B2.name: Split-core magnetic power unit
US-11152146-B2.hook: A ring-shaped magnetic core made of two halves with air gaps, an inner coil in a groove, and separate outer coils on the sides.
US-11152146-B2.twist: Wide-bandgap power electronics run at high frequencies where compact gapped magnetics pay off.

US-11153247-B1.name: Effort-rated email
US-11153247-B1.hook: An email system where senders estimate how much effort a reply will take, and inboxes sort and alert based on it.
US-11153247-B1.twist: Language models could pre-fill the effort estimate, and email clients now accept add-ons.

US-11153729-B2.name: Updatable NFC tags
US-11153729-B2.hook: NFC tags with dynamic data that push notifications and broadcast messages to people's phones when they tap.
US-11153729-B2.twist: Every modern phone reads NFC natively, and tags cost cents.

US-11153955-B1.name: Remote electronic birthday candles
US-11153955-B1.hook: Reusable electronic birthday candles with lights under translucent covers, controlled by a remote with an air sensor.
US-11153955-B1.twist: Tiny LEDs and coin-cell radios make a reusable, germ-free candle set cheap to make.

US-11153978-B2.name: Angled display enclosure
US-11153978-B2.hook: A compact enclosure for a small electronic display and rotary encoder, with cutouts and face angles chosen for easy viewing.
US-11153978-B2.twist: Home 3D printers and cheap OLED knob modules suit small control boxes like this.

US-11154033-B2.name: Two-tier pet food bowl
US-11154033-B2.hook: A pet food container with an upper bowl, a lower bowl and an inner base with openings between them.
US-11154033-B2.twist: Direct-to-consumer pet brands sell niche bowl designs well online.

US-11154037-B2.name: One-line harness leash
US-11154037-B2.hook: A single line with two crimps and a ring that forms both a collar loop and a girth loop, making harness and leash one piece.
US-11154037-B2.twist: Climbing-grade rope and hardware are cheap, so small makers can sell these online.

US-11154098-B2.name: Hinged collar stays
US-11154098-B2.hook: Collar stays with multiple hinges that change length along more than one axis.
US-11154098-B2.twist: Small-batch metal and resin printing makes tiny hinged parts affordable.

US-11154131-B2.name: Side-deploying keyboard tray
US-11154131-B2.hook: A keyboard tray that swings out from the side of a desk and can include height adjustment.
US-11154131-B2.twist: Home offices and standing desks created a big market for desk add-ons.

US-11154161-B2.name: Automated burger grill line
US-11154161-B2.hook: A grill system that dispenses raw food, cooks it on a two-sided grill, and moves it on an indexed conveyor to a staging area.
US-11154161-B2.twist: Restaurant labor costs have pushed kitchen automation from novelty to purchase.

US-11154165-B1.name: Portable hand-washing station
US-11154165-B1.hook: A water tank with a spigot, a lid with a paper towel holder, and a soap dispenser for washing anywhere.
US-11154165-B1.twist: Outdoor events, job sites and camping created steady demand for handwashing without plumbing.

US-11154177-B1.name: Mop bucket caddy
US-11154177-B1.hook: A holder that hangs on the front edge of a mop bucket with compartments for spray bottles and rags, and a handle to lift it off.
US-11154177-B1.twist: Easy to 3D print or injection mold and sell to cleaning crews.

US-11154328-B1.name: Tick scoop and trap
US-11154328-B1.hook: A tool with a V-groove scoop that lifts a tick off whole and sweeps it into a removable live trap for testing.
US-11154328-B1.twist: Mail-in tick testing for Lyme disease makes capturing the tick intact more useful.

US-11154440-B2.name: Anti-spin rescue litter
US-11154440-B2.hook: An air-thruster unit clamped to a rescue litter basket that senses spin and blows air to stop it rotating under a helicopter.
US-11154440-B2.twist: Drone-grade ducted fans, IMUs and batteries make this kind of stabilizer small and cheap.

US-11154455-B2.name: Vibrating acupressure pad
US-11154455-B2.hook: A handheld massager with acupressure bumps on top, vibrated by a motor-driven rotating member with detachable magnets.
US-11154455-B2.twist: Massage gadgets sell well online, and small motors and batteries are cheap.

US-11154456-B2.name: Needle-free IV bag valve
US-11154456-B2.hook: A valve on an IV bag's single port that opens and closes so a luer-lock syringe connects directly, without needles or spikes.
US-11154456-B2.twist: Needlestick prevention rules keep hospitals looking for needle-free connectors.

US-11154732-B2.name: Speed-controlled rope lifter
US-11154732-B2.hook: A rope lifter with cam-adjusted stop pads that control descent speed and a separate brake in the moving plate.
US-11154732-B2.twist: Arborists, riggers and climbers all want controlled-descent hardware.

US-11154739-B2.name: Plyometric climbing ladder
US-11154739-B2.hook: A frame with adjustable fixed arms, a removable pull-up bar, and spring-loaded arms released by electromagnets, or removable pegs.
US-11154739-B2.twist: Home gyms and climbing training have grown into a large equipment market.

US-11154741-B2.name: Assisted push-up trainer
