US-11154741-B2.hook: A movable support that the user rests on, with a tensile assist that pulls it back to the starting position during push-ups.
US-11154741-B2.twist: Home strength gear and rehab programs want ways to scale bodyweight exercises.

US-11154751-B2.name: Rotating foot-plate trainer
US-11154751-B2.hook: An exercise base whose rotating plate has holes, with a foot plate that pins into a chosen hole so both rotate together.
US-11154751-B2.twist: Compact rotational trainers suit golf, hockey and physical therapy at home.

US-11154768-B2.name: Rolling-ball decision game
US-11154768-B2.hook: A game board where a ball rolls along guided paths and players set movable switches that send it to one of several goals.
US-11154768-B2.twist: Laser cutters and 3D printers make small runs of mechanical games easy to sell.

US-11155176-B2.name: Autonomous electric carrier platform
US-11155176-B2.hook: A battery-powered platform with hub motors that carries cargo containers, housing units or vehicles, driven remotely or autonomously.
US-11155176-B2.twist: Hub motors and open-source autonomy stacks have dropped a lot in cost.

US-11155218-B2.name: Vehicle rack with fuel tank
US-11155218-B2.hook: A vehicle utility rack with rails and a storage surface, plus housings underneath for a fuel container and equipment.
US-11155218-B2.twist: Overlanding has made vehicle storage racks a popular aftermarket category.

US-11155237-B2.name: Perimeter alert system
US-11155237-B2.hook: A system and method for alerting on a defended perimeter; the patent's summary gives few further details.
US-11155237-B2.twist: Cheap radar and camera modules make perimeter sensing affordable.

US-11155313-B2.name: Explosion-proof robot wheel drive
US-11155313-B2.hook: A sealed drive for a robot wheel: servo motor, reduction box, and a coupling with bearing and seal inside a step sleeve.
US-11155313-B2.twist: Inspection robots for mines, tanks and chemical plants need sealed drivetrains.

US-11155411-B2.name: Rail-guided warehouse picker
US-11155411-B2.hook: Storage cabinets with guide rails, conveyors, gripping modules and code readers that use mechanical then optical positioning to fetch items.
US-11155411-B2.twist: Small warehouses can now buy compact automation that once only big distributors could afford.

US-11155516-B2.name: Aminoethoxyethanol synthesis
US-11155516-B2.hook: A chemical route to 2-(2-aminoethoxy) ethanol through a phthalimide intermediate that is then cleaved with hydrazine.
US-11155516-B2.twist: This small molecule is a common linker in drug conjugates and PEG chemistry.

US-11155736-B2.name: Deicer pellets on film
US-11155736-B2.hook: Deicing pellets attached to a water-soluble film base, so snow melter can be laid down in a controlled way.
US-11155736-B2.twist: Pet- and concrete-safe deicers sell at a premium, and dissolvable films are now cheap.

US-11155953-B2.name: Washing machine rinse recycler
US-11155953-B2.hook: A tank beside a washing machine that saves rinse water and feeds it back for the next wash cycle.
US-11155953-B2.twist: Drought rules and water prices make greywater reuse at home more attractive.

US-11155969-B2.name: Non-slip foam tiles
US-11155969-B2.hook: Polystyrene structural tiles coated with epoxy and aggregate so they stay grippy, losing little traction when wet.
US-11155969-B2.twist: Lightweight non-slip tiles suit pool decks, boats and quick floor upgrades.

US-11155986-B2.name: Tank-lid toilet deodorizer
US-11155986-B2.hook: A battery-powered unit under the toilet tank lid that pulls air through a filter with a small fan and exhausts it.
US-11155986-B2.twist: Small, quiet fans and rechargeable cells make a retrofit kit easy.

US-11155991-B2.name: Traffic warning shelter
US-11155991-B2.hook: A shelter that also works as a roadside warning sign, with a sign panel that docks onto it and can be released.
US-11155991-B2.twist: Roadside crews and stranded drivers need visible protection, and light composites cut weight.

US-11156007-B2.name: Stay-in-place formwork spacers
US-11156007-B2.hook: Spacers that hold two cement panels apart as permanent formwork, fastened through the panels so they stay attached.
US-11156007-B2.twist: Stay-in-place forms speed up concrete work where labor is short.

US-11156010-B1.name: Drone delivery tower
US-11156010-B1.hook: A tower that stores delivery drones and packages inside and launches drones through internal shafts when a customer orders.
US-11156010-B1.twist: Drone delivery is now licensed in several cities, and hubs need dense launch sites.

US-10045510-B2.name: Shaded outdoor dog feeder
US-10045510-B2.hook: A long feeder with food and water bowls at opposite ends under an overhanging roof, standing on legs in cups of insect repellent.
US-10045510-B2.twist: Small-batch rotomolding and 3D-printed molds make short runs of pet products cheap.

US-10045524-B2.name: Swaying hawk bird scarer
US-10045524-B2.hook: A decoy shaped like a hawk in flight that slides and pivots on a mount so its movement stays unpredictable to birds.
US-10045524-B2.twist: Vineyards and solar farms now pay for humane, chemical-free bird control.

US-10045560-B2.name: Waterless vacuum smoking device
US-10045560-B2.hook: A sliding cartridge in a sleeve pulls smoke or vapor into a chamber, then pushes it out to inhale, with intake tracking.
US-10045560-B2.twist: Legal cannabis markets want dose tracking built into the device itself.

US-10045576-B2.name: Adjustable phone pocket
US-10045576-B2.hook: A garment pocket whose depth and width can be adjusted so different phones sit snugly.
US-10045576-B2.twist: Phones keep growing, and on-demand apparel makers can add custom pockets per order.

US-10045643-B2.name: Two-height ridge pillow
US-10045643-B2.hook: A foam pillow with a raised ridge along each side at different heights and a trough between, with channels for inserts.
US-10045643-B2.twist: CNC foam cutting lets sleep brands sell pillows tuned to body measurements.

US-10045650-B2.name: Cordless spinning fruit peeler
US-10045650-B2.hook: A rechargeable handheld peeler with a fast spinning cutter that shaves skin off produce, with a safe-start interlock and cutter guard.
US-10045650-B2.twist: Cheap brushless motors and USB-C lithium packs make small kitchen tools easy to power.

US-10045662-B2.name: Heat-proof grill decal
US-10045662-B2.hook: A flexible, heat-resistant printed sticker that sticks to the outside of a barbecue grill to change its look.
US-10045662-B2.twist: Print-on-demand shops can sell custom team and brand grill wraps.

US-10045665-B1.name: Bathtub lift seat
US-10045665-B1.hook: A powered seat that lifts a person over the side of a bathtub and lowers them in, then reverses to help them out.
US-10045665-B1.twist: An aging population wants to stay home longer without remodeling the bathroom.

US-10045876-B2.name: Laced adjustable wrist brace
US-10045876-B2.hook: A wrist brace for fractures with top and bottom panels joined across gaps by laces that tighten each side separately.
US-10045876-B2.twist: Phone scans and 3D printing make custom-fit braces possible in a clinic visit.

US-10045984-B2.name: Zinc and trimethoprim release
US-10045984-B2.hook: A drug mix of zinc and the antibiotic trimethoprim in a set ratio, including a slow-release form in a biodegradable polymer.
US-10045984-B2.twist: Antibiotic resistance renews interest in boosting old, cheap antibiotics.

US-10046108-B2.name: IV pump carry holder
US-10046108-B2.hook: A flat base with walls that holds an infusion pump, an arm that hangs the medication bag, and a strap.
US-10046108-B2.twist: More infusions now happen at home, where patients need to move around with the pump.

US-10046186-B2.name: Helicopter gel firefighting pod
US-10046186-B2.hook: A pod slung under an aircraft above a water bucket that stores fire-retardant gel and mixes it into the water.
US-10046186-B2.twist: Longer wildfire seasons are pushing more agencies to contract aerial firefighting.

US-10046218-B2.name: Angled table tennis paddle
US-10046218-B2.hook: A table tennis racket whose handle meets the blade at an offset angle, making it asymmetric so players can add more spin.
US-10046218-B2.twist: Pickleball and table tennis growth makes small paddle makers viable.

US-10046399-B2.name: Hydraulic lathe tool clamp
US-10046399-B2.hook: A block with two connected pistons that uses hydraulic fluid to press and hold a lathe cutting tool in place.
US-10046399-B2.twist: Small CNC shops want faster tool changes without buying a full quick-change system.

US-10046423-B2.name: Adjustable pipe welding jig
US-10046423-B2.hook: A jig that holds a pipe fitting in place for welding, with swappable adapters for flanges and 45 or 90 degree elbows.
US-10046423-B2.twist: Welder shortages raise the value of fixtures that let less experienced hands do clean work.

US-10046431-B2.name: Two-belt deburring machine
US-10046431-B2.hook: A machine with upper and lower abrasive belts that deburr and chamfer both sides of a part twice in one pass.
US-10046431-B2.twist: Laser and waterjet cutting are now common in small shops, and every cut part needs deburring.

US-10046440-B1.name: Pool cue shaft sander
US-10046440-B1.hook: A flexible C-shaped sleeve lined with abrasive that clamps around a pool cue shaft to smooth it.
US-10046440-B1.twist: Billiards accessories sell well direct to players through online shops.

US-10046475-B2.name: Table saw copying jig
US-10046475-B2.hook: A sliding cart on a table saw that holds a master piece and a blank side by side, so the blank is cut to match the master.
US-10046475-B2.twist: Woodworking content creators sell shop-made jig plans and kits to a big audience.

US-10046595-B2.name: Belt-worn paint cup holder
US-10046595-B2.hook: A belt-mounted holder with a hinged handle and spacers that carries a paint can or tray so both hands stay free.
US-10046595-B2.twist: DIY home painting keeps growing, and simple holders sell well online.

US-10046687-B2.name: Swap-off truck load bed
US-10046687-B2.hook: A removable frame and platform that hoist on and off a vehicle, with legs so the platform can stand on its own.
US-10046687-B2.twist: Electric pickups and delivery vans make one chassis serving several job beds more useful.

US-10046785-B2.name: Framed stroller cover
US-10046785-B2.hook: A flexible cover held in shape by a frame of rigid and flexible supports that fastens onto a stroller.
US-10046785-B2.twist: Parents in hot or wet cities buy weather covers that fit many stroller brands.

US-10046832-B1.name: Pop-up boat cleat
US-10046832-B1.hook: A spring and piston cleat that rises from its base when needed and retracts flush, with a drain groove.
US-10046832-B1.twist: Boat owners pay for flush deck hardware that removes trip and snag points.

US-10046861-B2.name: Engine intake debris guard
US-10046861-B2.hook: A cone of rods mounted in front of an airplane engine that deflects birds and debris while letting air through.
US-10046861-B2.twist: Drones and small aircraft with exposed intakes face growing bird and debris risk.

US-10046910-B2.name: Remote trash bin tug
US-10046910-B2.hook: A small two-wheeled remote-controlled tug that latches onto a trash bin handle, lifts its front and drives it to the curb.
US-10046910-B2.twist: Cheap motor controllers and phone control make small helper robots affordable.

US-10046920-B1.name: Self-cleaning conveyor belt
US-10046920-B1.hook: A unit pressed against a conveyor belt that wipes it with cleaning solution fed from a float-controlled reservoir and a roller.
US-10046920-B1.twist: Food plants face stricter sanitation rules and fewer workers to clean lines.

US-10046937-B2.name: Masking tape applicator
US-10046937-B2.hook: A handheld tool with a spool and two shoes that lays painter's tape flat on a surface, with an optional spacing stop.
US-10046937-B2.twist: Faster prep work helps the growing number of small painting businesses.

US-10046961-B2.name: Upside-down growler tap
US-10046961-B2.hook: A cap with a valve and a collapsing bladder that lets an inverted beer growler pour through a normal tap without air touching the beer.
US-10046961-B2.twist: Craft breweries and home brewers want growlers that stay fresh after opening.

US-10046982-B2.name: Gray water filter valve
US-10046982-B2.hook: A screened filter valve between a drain and a gray water tank that backwashes caught debris to the sewer with a motor valve.
US-10046982-B2.twist: Drought rules in western states now encourage home gray water reuse.

US-10046997-B2.name: Nested nitrogen removal tank
US-10046997-B2.hook: A water treatment tank with an oxygen-rich zone inside an oxygen-poor zone so ammonia and nitrates are removed together.
US-10046997-B2.twist: Aquaculture and fish farms need compact nitrogen removal to recirculate water.

US-10047039-B2.name: Anti-metastasis platelet compound
US-10047039-B2.hook: Small-molecule compounds meant to slow tumor spread by blocking tumor cells from making platelets clump.
US-10047039-B2.twist: Cheap screening services let small teams test old compounds against new cancer targets.

US-10047442-B2.name: Metal and enamel heat coating
US-10047442-B2.hook: A protective coating for hot parts made from a mix of nickel-based alloy powder and enamel powder, with its recipe.
US-10047442-B2.twist: Hydrogen and high-heat industrial burners need cheaper protective coatings.

US-10047464-B2.name: Marked hand sewing needle
US-10047464-B2.hook: A hand sewing needle with evenly spaced markings so beginners can make stitches of equal length.
US-10047464-B2.twist: Visible mending and hand sewing are popular again with beginners online.

US-10047521-B2.name: Hanging partition wall track
US-10047521-B2.hook: A wall frame that hangs from a suspended ceiling track to hold panels for a non-load-bearing interior wall.
US-10047521-B2.twist: Offices being split into smaller spaces need walls that go up and come down fast.

US-10047536-B2.name: Rolling pool brush frame
US-10047536-B2.hook: A frame with a float, wheels, removable brushes and a screen that is pushed along a pool floor to scrub and catch debris.
US-10047536-B2.twist: Pool owners want simple manual cleaners as an alternative to costly robots.

US-10047724-B2.name: Flat disc wind generator
US-10047724-B2.hook: A wind turbine whose generator uses flat parallel rotor discs spinning around a flat stator between them.
US-10047724-B2.twist: Cheap neodymium magnets and DIY axial-flux designs suit off-grid builders.

US-10047822-B1.name: Pendulum driveline damper
US-10047822-B1.hook: A torque transfer part with a clock spring and swinging pendulum weights that cut vibration between an engine and the driveline.
US-10047822-B1.twist: Hybrid drivetrains that start and stop engines often need better vibration damping.

US-10047998-B2.name: Cooler lid insulation pad
US-10047998-B2.hook: A foam pad cut to fit inside a cooler that seals against the walls to keep cold air in.
US-10047998-B2.twist: Premium cooler buyers spend on accessories, and foam is cheap to cut to size.

US-10048283-B2.name: Lipoprotein particle calculator
US-10048283-B2.hook: A method that calculates cholesterol ester, free cholesterol and lipoprotein particle counts from standard cholesterol and triglyceride readings.
US-10048283-B2.twist: Software can add particle estimates to routine lab panels at no extra test cost.

US-10048746-B2.name: Multi-mode entertainment kiosk
US-10048746-B2.hook: A kiosk with touch screens and a rotating display that switches between photo booth, karaoke, VR and game modes.
US-10048746-B2.twist: Cheap VR headsets and rental event businesses make kiosks easy to deploy.

US-10048769-B2.name: Hand-gesture 3D CAD
US-10048769-B2.hook: A 3D design interface where one- and two-handed free-hand gestures shape and constrain parts, with parts auto-adjusted to rules.
US-10048769-B2.twist: Mixed reality headsets now track hands well enough for this to work.

US-10049767-B2.name: Blood neurotoxin test panel
US-10049767-B2.hook: A blood test panel that measures aluminum, arsenic, lead, mercury, manganese and selenium to set a personal baseline for brain-related risk.
US-10049767-B2.twist: Multi-element blood tests by ICP-MS now cost far less and ship as mail-in kits.

US-10049786-B2.name: Airborne wind power tether
US-10049786-B2.hook: A power cable for kite or drone wind turbines with two wound conductor layers around a stretchy core and a load-bearing outer layer.
US-10049786-B2.twist: Airborne wind prototypes are now testing at sea, where tether fatigue is the main failure.

US-10049835-B2.name: Stage curtain limit switch
US-10049835-B2.hook: A sprocket rides along a curtain's drive chain and trips a switch when it hits an insert clipped into a chosen link.
US-10049835-B2.twist: Small theaters and schools are motorizing rigging with cheap motor drives that still need hard stops.

US-10050269-B2.name: Nano-oxide lead-acid plates
US-10050269-B2.hook: Lead oxide is mixed with a nano-oxide made by a sol-gel reaction to make the paste for lead-acid battery plates.
US-10050269-B2.twist: Lead-acid still dominates backup and starter batteries, so small gains in plate life matter at scale.

US-10050397-B1.name: Wall outlet tablet mount
US-10050397-B1.hook: A base that plugs into a wall outlet, holds and charges a tablet over USB, and rotates it between portrait and landscape.
US-10050397-B1.twist: Cheap tablets now serve as smart home panels, and this hides the outlet and cable.

US-10050511-B2.name: Magnetic linear-to-rotary drive
US-10050511-B2.hook: Magnets on an oscillating part couple to magnets on a rotor to turn back-and-forth motion into continuous rotation without contact.
US-10050511-B2.twist: Strong neodymium magnets and 3D-printed frames make contactless couplings easy to prototype.

US-10050544-B2.name: Soft-switching high-power converter
US-10050544-B2.hook: A phase-shifted full-bridge DC/DC converter that adds a load-controlled saturable inductor and a buffer circuit so switches turn on and off with less loss.
US-10050544-B2.twist: Fast EV chargers and electrolyzers need efficient high-power DC/DC stages.

US-10050786-B2.name: Random sample elections
US-10050786-B2.hook: A method to pick a verifiable random sample of voters to decide a vote, with a publicly checkable tally and protection against vote selling.
US-10050786-B2.twist: Citizens' assemblies and DAO governance are trying sortition and need auditable random selection.

US-10050933-B2.name: One-way data ferry
US-10050933-B2.hook: An offline computer sends data one way to a buffer computer that shares it on the network, so the offline machine is never directly connected.
US-10050933-B2.twist: Ransomware has made one-way links popular for backups and plant control systems.

US-10050956-B2.name: Barcode-coded network addressing
US-10050956-B2.hook: Two 13-digit numbers checked against barcode coding rules are encrypted into addresses that an authentication center must decrypt before data passes.
US-10050956-B2.twist: Zero-trust networks look for simple per-device identity schemes.

US-10051117-B2.name: DSL cable fault finder
US-10051117-B2.hook: Compares each line's current physical readings against its baseline across all lines in a cable to spot faults in the shared cable.
US-10051117-B2.twist: Copper networks are being retired, and operators want cheap ways to find which cables fail first.

US-10051362-B2.name: Seven-driver column speaker
US-10051362-B2.hook: A loudspeaker with seven drivers stacked along one axis, five facing different directions, with low and high frequencies split between them.
US-10051362-B2.twist: Smart speakers compete on room-filling sound from one small column.

US-10051836-B1.name: Enclosed dog wash box
US-10051836-B1.hook: A see-through box a dog walks into, with glove holes in the hinged roof and sprinklers that spray soapy water.
US-10051836-B1.twist: Self-serve pet wash stations are spreading at pet stores and apartment complexes.

US-10051844-B2.name: Submersible aquaculture raft
US-10051844-B2.hook: A mussel farming raft that can be sunk to a set depth to ride out storms, then raised again.
US-10051844-B2.twist: Offshore shellfish farming is growing and storms are the main loss.

US-10051849-B2.name: Bait fish rigging tube
US-10051849-B2.hook: A tube pushed into a bait fish's mouth guides and clamps the line, with an adjustable weight arm to make the bait sink.
US-10051849-B2.twist: 3D printing makes small runs of fishing tackle cheap to sell online.

US-10051855-B2.name: Slippery trap mat
US-10051855-B2.hook: A thin low-friction mat fits around an existing trap's trigger so an animal slips back onto it instead of escaping.
US-10051855-B2.twist: A cheap add-on can be sold to owners of traps they already have.

US-10051886-B2.name: Modular screw-together pipe
US-10051886-B2.hook: A smoking pipe built from threaded tubes joined by threaded rings and a threaded base, so its length can be changed.
US-10051886-B2.twist: Small brands sell modular glass and metal pieces direct online.

US-10051899-B2.name: Magnetic split lap apron
US-10051899-B2.hook: A two-piece apron held on with magnets at the neck, waist and legs, with straps that slide to adjust.
US-10051899-B2.twist: Barbers, potters and makers want aprons that go on and off fast.

US-10051909-B2.name: Rear-view camera helmet
US-10051909-B2.hook: A helmet with a rear camera whose image shows on a small display in front of the rider, plus a front camera for recording.
US-10051909-B2.twist: Tiny cameras and displays are cheap, and cyclists and e-scooter riders want rear awareness.

US-10051934-B1.name: Layered heat-shedding case
US-10051934-B1.hook: A layered protective case for a tablet or laptop shaped to absorb impacts and let heat escape.
US-10051934-B1.twist: Thinner devices run hotter, and rugged cases often trap heat.

US-10051937-B1.name: Plunger hair clip
US-10051937-B1.hook: A hair clip closed by a spring-loaded plunger, with rubber-coated jaws and a side plate that extends down past one jaw.
US-10051937-B1.twist: Claw clips are back in fashion and sold through small online brands.

US-10051952-B2.name: Fold-out brush hanger
US-10051952-B2.hook: A rod that folds out of a groove in a paintbrush handle and hooks onto a paint can rim.
US-10051952-B2.twist: DIY painting supplies sell well through online marketplaces and short videos.

US-10051967-B2.name: Adjustable travel pillow
US-10051967-B2.hook: A travel pillow with removable inserts so the thickness can be changed, including different thickness in different sections.
US-10051967-B2.twist: Direct-to-consumer sleep brands sell on customizable fit.

US-10051969-B2.name: Bed sheet body positioner
US-10051969-B2.hook: A bed sheet with a padded body-shaped positioner sewn in, with head, torso, arm and optional leg sections.
US-10051969-B2.twist: Pregnancy and side-sleeper pillows are a big category, and this keeps one from sliding around.

US-10051971-B2.name: Duvet cover helper clips
US-10051971-B2.hook: Clips grip the duvet and cover corners while straps tucked under the mattress hold them, so one person can put a cover on.
US-10051971-B2.twist: A small, easily shipped product for a common household annoyance.

US-10051979-B2.name: Stackable gravity can rack
US-10051979-B2.hook: Modular racks with sloped shelves let cans roll forward, and humped side bars lock racks together when stacked.
US-10051979-B2.twist: Bulk buying and home pantries make rolling can organizers popular.

US-10052181-B2.name: Additive dental mockup process
US-10052181-B2.hook: Defects are corrected by adding material to a cast of the teeth, a mold is made from it, and the mold shapes material applied to the real teeth.
US-10052181-B2.twist: Intraoral scanning and 3D printed molds can replace the physical cast step.

US-10052233-B2.name: Multi-hazard protective visor
US-10052233-B2.hook: A head-mounted visor with face shield, goggles and a shading screen with a lattice shutter, for dust, impact, chemical and radiation protection.
US-10052233-B2.twist: Lab and industrial safety gear buyers want one headset for many hazards.

US-10052254-B2.name: Wheelchair-walker coupler
US-10052254-B2.hook: Two couplings join a wheelchair behind a walker at a fixed gap so a patient can sit whenever they tire during walking therapy.
US-10052254-B2.twist: Aging populations and short-staffed rehab clinics need one-therapist walking aids.

US-10052255-B2.name: One-hand lever massage roller
US-10052255-B2.hook: A roller pad on an adjustable pole mounted to a base or rail, so you can roll deep pressure into a muscle with one hand.
US-10052255-B2.twist: Home recovery tools sell well alongside massage guns and foam rollers.

US-10052511-B2.name: Adjustable triceps dip stand
US-10052511-B2.hook: A dip stand with handgrips that adjust in height and width, each locked with pins.
US-10052511-B2.twist: Home gyms favor compact, adjustable bodyweight equipment.

US-10052517-B2.name: Adjustable exercise platform
US-10052517-B2.hook: A step-style platform that slots into a base at different heights to give progressive resistance for different muscle groups.
US-10052517-B2.twist: Physical therapy at home needs simple gear that scales with progress.

US-10052523-B2.name: Sensor swim float
US-10052523-B2.hook: A floating ring worn around part of the body that holds a swimmer up and measures posture, effort and body signals.
US-10052523-B2.twist: Waterproof IMUs and phone apps make swim coaching data cheap.

US-10052533-B1.name: Screw-stiffened golf driver face
US-10052533-B1.hook: Screws set into a metal club face are claimed to reduce face flex and add distance.
US-10052533-B1.twist: Custom club builders could test it quickly with launch monitors now common at retail.

US-10052565-B2.name: Oilfield treater combo unit
US-10052565-B2.hook: One portable unit that combines a heater treater with gas heaters, a dryer, a two-phase separator and a free water knockout.
US-10052565-B2.twist: Small wells and short-life pads favor skid units that move from site to site.

US-10052593-B2.name: Counterflow liquid aerator
US-10052593-B2.hook: Air and liquid flow in opposite directions through side-by-side channels that meet in an aeration chamber.
US-10052593-B2.twist: Aquaponics, ponds and wastewater all want cheap, low-clog aeration.

US-10052664-B2.name: Wet-dry mask wiper
US-10052664-B2.hook: A machine feeds a clean-room wiper over rollers to first wipe a mask wet with sprayed cleaner, then wipe it dry.
US-10052664-B2.twist: Display and chip fabs keep adding automated cleaning steps.

US-10052787-B1.name: Spirit-infused wooden picks
US-10052787-B1.hook: Toothpicks, stir sticks, skewers and chopsticks made from wood soaked in spirits or taken from used spirit barrels.
US-10052787-B1.twist: Craft distilleries have used barrels to spare and sell branded merchandise.

US-10052859-B2.name: Cold display screen reclaimer
US-10052859-B2.hook: Liquid nitrogen vapor freezes the adhesive in a curved or bendable display so its layers can be separated for reuse.
US-10052859-B2.twist: Phone repair and refurbishing shops want to save expensive curved OLED panels.

US-10052981-B2.name: Car seat stroller frame
US-10052981-B2.hook: A car seat with folding cross supports, wheels and an extending handle so it becomes a stroller when lifted from its base.
US-10052981-B2.twist: Parents favor all-in-one travel gear for small cars and city living.

US-10053029-B2.name: License plate sign frame
US-10053029-B2.hook: A frame around a car's license plate with side panels that hold swappable messages, logos or ads.
US-10053029-B2.twist: Cheap thin e-paper or printed magnetic panels could make the messages easy to change.

US-10053049-B1.name: Travel sleep head strap
US-10053049-B1.hook: Elastic straps that attach to a seat and hold a sleeping passenger's head upright, with a wide strap covering the eyes.
US-10053049-B1.twist: Long-haul flights and overnight buses keep growing; a soft-goods maker could sell it online.

US-10053104-B2.name: Truck weight from driving data
US-10053104-B2.hook: Estimates a truck's total loaded weight from its acceleration and engine drive force while it drives, without a scale.
US-10053104-B2.twist: Fleet telematics boxes already log this data, so it could run as a software update.

US-10053126-B2.name: Tipping three-wheel utility cart
US-10053126-B2.hook: A yard cart with three front wheels on one axle, swivel rear wheels, a tub that tips to dump, and a handle that flips from push to towing hitch.
US-10053126-B2.twist: Pairs well with small electric yard tractors and garden robots that could tow it.

US-10053199-B2.name: Collapsible pedal watercraft
US-10053199-B2.hook: A small boat built from a base frame and two clip-on side floats, driven by pedal propellers or the rider's legs, with an optional rudder.
US-10053199-B2.twist: Flat-pack shipping and cheap rotomolded floats suit direct-to-consumer sales.

US-10053270-B2.name: Folded card bottle carrier
US-10053270-B2.hook: A bottle carrier folded from one flat sheet of card, with a reinforced double-wall handle and dividers between bottles.
US-10053270-B2.twist: Brewers and shops want plastic-free packaging; die-cut card fits that.

US-10053278-B2.name: Chained dispenser gloves
US-10053278-B2.hook: Disposable gloves linked fingertip to cuff in a chain, so pulling one out readies the next for quick one-handed grabbing.
US-10053278-B2.twist: Glove use in food service and clinics stayed high after 2020.

US-10053329-B2.name: Motorized wedding aisle runner
US-10053329-B2.hook: A motorized roller that unrolls and rewinds an aisle runner in a straight line, with lights along the runner.
US-10053329-B2.twist: Event rental companies could offer it as a remote-controlled reveal for weddings.

US-10053391-B2.name: Food-safe polymer clay glaze
US-10053391-B2.hook: A coating of food-safe plastic particles in water or oil that makes oven-bake clay objects safe for food and drink.
US-10053391-B2.twist: Polymer clay crafting is big on social media, and makers want usable mugs and plates.

US-10053829-B2.name: Automated pond outflow gate
US-10053829-B2.hook: A riser with a hinged gate that a controller rotates step by step to set how much water spills out of a pond.
US-10053829-B2.twist: Cheap cellular sensors let farms and mines run settling ponds remotely.

US-10053846-B1.name: Plunger with stored sheath
US-10053846-B1.hook: A toilet plunger whose hollow handle stores disposable sleeves that cover the cup so it stays clean.
US-10053846-B1.twist: A simple add-on product for online cleaning-supply brands.

US-10053867-B2.name: Roof water diverter
US-10053867-B2.hook: A shaped piece that sits on a roof, catches running rainwater and steers it to a drain opening.
US-10053867-B2.twist: Rainwater collection for gardens makes directing roof runoff more useful.

US-10053965-B1.name: Lipless oil well seal
US-10053965-B1.hook: A tube-shaped seal for oil well pumping that presses lightly on the casing and has no lip that can fold under and jam.
US-10053965-B1.twist: Small stripper-well operators want cheap parts that cut downtime.

US-10054143-B2.name: Self-punching brace connector
US-10054143-B2.hook: A connector body with a slot and a threaded punch-bolt that punches through a thin-walled brace and locks it in one step.
US-10054143-B2.twist: Faster scaffold and shoring assembly matters with construction labor shortages.

US-10054199-B2.name: Cam-adjusted belt tensioner
US-10054199-B2.hook: A stand-alone frame with a pivoting arm and wheel, set by a cam, that keeps a drive belt tight.
US-10054199-B2.twist: Makers building belt-driven machines could buy it as a bolt-on part.

US-10054204-B2.name: Eddy-brake variable gearbox
US-10054204-B2.hook: A planetary gear set whose output speed is changed by an eddy current brake slowing one of its input gears.
US-10054204-B2.twist: Cheap motor controllers make the brake easy to drive from a microcontroller.

US-10054268-B2.name: Drainage composite mat
US-10054268-B2.hook: A composite material made of crossing members that form connected channels for water to drain through.
US-10054268-B2.twist: Green roofs and sports fields both need lightweight drainage layers.

US-10054297-B1.name: Salt lamp bulb holder
US-10054297-B1.hook: A salt lamp with a hollow crystal and a light plate that clips through the base, so the bulb can be swapped easily.
US-10054297-B1.twist: Cheap LED modules could replace the hot incandescent bulb these lamps usually use.

US-10054369-B2.name: One-sided heat exchange pad
US-10054369-B2.hook: A pad with a fluid channel that transfers heat through one face and is insulated on the other, attached to an object to warm or cool it.
US-10054369-B2.twist: Battery packs and electronics enclosures need simple add-on liquid cooling.

US-10054451-B2.name: Crowd-updated cloud map
US-10054451-B2.hook: Navigation units collect road data and send it to a server where an operator updates a shared map for all users.
US-10054451-B2.twist: Phone sensors and cheap cloud hosting make crowd-sourced maps easy for niche users like trail riders.

US-10054465-B2.name: Magnet gesture phone input
US-10054465-B2.hook: A phone's magnetic sensor tracks a magnet on a nearby object and triggers actions based on how the object moves.
US-10054465-B2.twist: Every phone has a magnetometer, so this works as an app plus a cheap magnet accessory.

US-10054559-B2.name: Compact steam quality meter
US-10054559-B2.hook: Measures how wet steam is and how fast it flows using a nozzle and an orifice plate in series, with little pressure loss.
US-10054559-B2.twist: Plants cutting energy use want to monitor steam lines without long straight pipe runs.

US-10055708-B2.name: Remote car lot inventory check
US-10055708-B2.hook: A lender or dealer requests a check online, and a base station at the lot pings receivers in each car to confirm it is there.
US-10055708-B2.twist: Cheap BLE tags and LTE gateways make the hardware side inexpensive now.

US-10055943-B2.name: Remote camera arcade game
US-10055943-B2.hook: An arcade game the player controls by watching a video feed, which can come from a remote location over the internet.
US-10055943-B2.twist: Online claw-machine apps showed people pay to play real machines remotely.

US-10056083-B2.name: Lecture slide transcript builder
US-10056083-B2.hook: Pulls keywords from regions of video frames, filters off-topic ones and builds a keyword graph to produce a text transcript of the content.
US-10056083-B2.twist: Modern OCR and language models make this far more accurate and cheap to run.

US-10056184-B2.name: Segmented toroid core cap
US-10056184-B2.hook: Non-conducting cap segments that snap together into a ring covering a toroidal transformer core of any size.
US-10056184-B2.twist: 3D printing makes small runs of custom-size segments practical.

US-10056213-B1.name: Light-touch switch cutoff
US-10056213-B1.hook: An off key inside an electromagnetic switch that separates the contacts with a light press, so deep presses don't damage it.
US-10056213-B1.twist: A low-cost safety improvement for power tool and appliance switch makers.

US-10056697-B2.name: See-through EMI absorbing film
US-10056697-B2.hook: A plastic film with a thin metal layer full of tiny laser-drilled holes that absorbs nearby electromagnetic noise, with clear windows to see through.
US-10056697-B2.twist: Dense wireless gadgets need thin noise suppression; fiber lasers are now affordable.

US-10056937-B1.name: Code shift key generator
US-10056937-B1.hook: Generates sets of binary codes from shuffled prime number sequences, stored in memory, where each code carries 4 bits over a wireless link.
US-10056937-B1.twist: Software-defined radios let hobbyists test custom spread-spectrum schemes cheaply.

US-10057263-B2.name: Per-client app version routing
US-10057263-B2.hook: A web system that picks which version of an application to serve each client based on markers attached to the client or request.
US-10057263-B2.twist: Feature flags and canary releases are standard practice; this is a self-hosted take.

US-10057405-B2.name: User-triggered call handoff
US-10057405-B2.hook: Lets a phone user trigger a handoff to fix a bad call, switch networks, reconnect a dropped call or log a quality problem.
US-10057405-B2.twist: Phones now switch between Wi-Fi calling and cellular, so a user button fits.

US-10057542-B2.name: Speaker-tracking meeting video
US-10057542-B2.hook: A meeting system with cameras and microphones that detects which participant is speaking and shows video of them.
US-10057542-B2.twist: Cheap USB cameras and on-device voice detection make it a small software project.

US-11156257-B1.name: Air-cooled inboard brake
US-11156257-B1.hook: A vehicle brake mounted inboard inside an enclosure, with ducts that route outside air through it to keep it at its best temperature.
US-11156257-B1.twist: Small electric race cars and buggies benefit from moving brakes inboard to cut unsprung weight.

US-11156265-B2.name: Lag screw cable railing
US-11156265-B2.hook: Deck railing cables with hollow lag screws on the ends that screw straight into the posts to anchor each cable.
US-11156265-B2.twist: Cable railing is popular with DIY deck builders who want fewer special tools.

US-11156352-B1.name: Star projector speaker lamp
US-11156352-B1.hook: A battery lamp with LEDs above and below a reflector, a motor-turned patterned disc that projects moving light, and a speaker.
US-11156352-B1.twist: Kids' room and sleep products sell well online in this form.

US-11156656-B1.name: Rotating-disc waveguide tuner
US-11156656-B1.hook: A low-profile impedance tuner for wafer testing that adjusts a waveguide with rotating metal discs instead of vertically moving probes.
US-11156656-B1.twist: mmWave 5G and radar chip testing needs compact tuners at wafer probe stations.

US-11156799-B2.name: Three-axis camera lens actuator
US-11156799-B2.hook: Moves a small camera lens on three axes with magnets and three sets of coils, for focusing and shake correction.
US-11156799-B2.twist: Drones, robots and machine-vision cameras want small stabilized lenses.

US-11156845-B2.name: ID card magnifier stand
US-11156845-B2.hook: A stand that holds an ID or card in a slot behind a magnifying lens so small print is easy to read.
US-11156845-B2.twist: Bars and shops checking IDs, and older users, are clear buyers; easy to 3D print.

US-11156856-B2.name: Wear-detecting eyewear
US-11156856-B2.hook: Glasses with a sensor that detects whether they are being worn.
US-11156856-B2.twist: Smart glasses can use it to save battery when taken off.

US-11157631-B1.name: Hashed secure data index
US-11157631-B1.hook: Software that creates computing nodes using hashing and ciphers, and stores data securely in tree-like indexes across a network.
US-11157631-B1.twist: Open-source crypto libraries make a prototype a small software project.
